zh.tag: 开源AI代理团队管理平台，像运营公司一样管理代理。
zh.what: Paperclip 是一个开源应用，用于在工作场景中管理 AI 代理团队。它通过 Node.js 服务器和 React UI 编排多个代理，让用户设定业务目标、分配任务并跟踪工作与成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Node.js 服务器和 React 前端，提供仪表板、组织架构、预算和治理功能，支持多种代理提供商。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Node.js 和 React 构建，依赖现代前端和后端技术。
zh.hot: 凭借 84963 颗星和今日新增 2109 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第一，反映出对 AI 代理团队管理工具的强烈需求。
uses: AI 团队负责人 —— 需要统一管理多个代理并跟踪进度与成本。
创业公司 —— 想用 AI 代理自动化运营，从目标设定到执行监控。
开发者 —— 希望集成不同代理提供商，构建自定义工作流。
产品经理 —— 通过仪表板监控代理工作，确保与业务目标对齐。

en.tag: Open-source orchestration for teams of AI agents, manage like a company.
en.what: Paperclip is an open-source app for managing AI agent teams at work. It orchestrates multiple agents via a Node.js server and React UI, letting users set business goals, assign tasks, and track work and costs.
en.content: The repo includes a Node.js server and React frontend, offering dashboards, org charts, budgets, and governance, with support for multiple agent providers.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on Node.js and React, leveraging modern frontend and backend technologies.
en.hot: With 84,963 stars and 2,109 added today, it tops GitHub Trending daily, reflecting strong demand for AI agent team management tools.
uses: AI team leads — need to manage multiple agents and track progress and costs.
Startups — want to automate operations with AI agents, from goal setting to execution monitoring.
Developers — wish to integrate various agent providers and build custom workflows.
Product managers — monitor agent work via dashboard to ensure alignment with business goals.

zh.tag: Anthropic 官方维护的 Claude Code 插件精选目录
zh.what: 这是 Anthropic 官方维护的 Claude Code 插件市场目录，收录经过筛选的高质量插件。用户可通过 Claude Code 的插件系统直接安装内部与第三方插件，扩展斜杠命令、Agent、技能与 MCP 服务能力。
zh.content: 仓库分为 /plugins（Anthropic 自研）与 /external_plugins（第三方与社区）两大目录，每个插件遵循标准结构，含 plugin.json、可选的 .mcp.json、commands、agents、skills 与 README。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主语言，核心是 Claude Code 插件系统与 MCP 协议；插件通过 marketplace.json 清单定义，支持 git-subdir 源、skill 打包与重命名迁移映射。
zh.hot: 作为 Anthropic 官方出品的插件目录，它踩中了 Claude Code 生态爆发与 MCP 标准化的双重风口，近 3.7 万 stars、日榜第 2，说明开发者急需官方可信的插件入口。
uses: Claude Code 用户：想快速发现并安装官方与第三方插件扩展工作流
插件开发者：希望按标准结构提交插件进入官方市场
团队与平台工程师：需要评估、审计并统一管理 Claude Code 插件依赖
AI 工具链研究者：关注 MCP 与 Agent 技能生态的标准化演进

en.tag: Anthropic's official curated directory of Claude Code plugins
en.what: This is Anthropic's officially maintained marketplace directory of curated, high-quality plugins for Claude Code. Users can install internal and third-party plugins directly through Claude Code's plugin system to extend slash commands, agents, skills, and MCP server capabilities.
en.content: The repo is split into /plugins (built by Anthropic) and /external_plugins (partners and community), with each plugin following a standard layout of plugin.json, optional .mcp.json, commands, agents, skills, and README.
en.stack: Python is the primary language, built around the Claude Code plugin system and MCP protocol; plugins are defined via marketplace.json manifests supporting git-subdir sources, skill bundles, and rename migration maps.
en.hot: As an official Anthropic directory, it rides the dual wave of Claude Code's ecosystem boom and MCP standardization; nearly 37k stars and #2 on the daily trending list show developers urgently want a trusted official plugin entry point.
uses: Claude Code users who want to discover and install official and third-party plugins to extend their workflow
Plugin developers looking to submit plugins into the official marketplace following the standard structure
Teams and platform engineers who need to evaluate, audit, and centrally manage Claude Code plugin dependencies
AI tooling researchers tracking the standardization of MCP and agent skill ecosystems

zh.tag: 让智能体真正学会学习的长期记忆系统
zh.what: Hindsight 是一个面向 AI 智能体的记忆系统，目标不是简单回放对话历史，而是让智能体随时间积累经验、持续学习。它声称克服了 RAG 和知识图谱在长期记忆任务上的缺陷，并在相关基准上达到领先水平。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 服务端与客户端 SDK、NPM 客户端包、文档站点（hindsight-docs）、集成示例与 Cookbook，并提供 MCP 服务器、LLM Wrapper 及编码智能体接入方式。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，发布到 PyPI（hindsight-api、hindsight-client）与 NPM（@vectorize-io/hindsight-client），采用 MIT 许可，支持独立服务器、嵌入式运行及多种平台集成。
zh.hot: 上线即获 27785 颗星、单日新增 1668 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 2，说明智能体长期记忆正是当下最受关注的痛点方向。
uses: 构建需要跨会话记住用户偏好并持续进化的 AI 智能体开发者
希望替代 RAG 或知识图谱方案、提升长期记忆准确率的团队
为编码助手、客服机器人等产品接入记忆能力的工程团队
想通过 MCP 或 LLM Wrapper 快速试水智能体记忆的研究者

en.tag: Agent memory system that makes agents learn, not just remember
en.what: Hindsight is an agent memory system designed to make agents learn over time rather than merely recall conversation history. It claims to overcome the shortcomings of RAG and knowledge graphs, delivering state-of-the-art results on long-term memory benchmarks.
en.content: The repo ships a Python server and client SDK, an NPM client package, a docs site (hindsight-docs), integration examples and a cookbook, plus an MCP server, an LLM wrapper, and coding-agent integrations.
en.stack: Primarily Python, published on PyPI (hindsight-api, hindsight-client) and NPM (@vectorize-io/hindsight-client) under MIT license, supporting standalone server, embedded mode, and multi-platform integrations.
en.hot: With 27,785 stars and 1,668 added in a single day, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending daily, it shows agent long-term memory is one of today's hottest pain points.
uses: Developers building AI agents that must remember user preferences across sessions and keep improving
Teams looking to replace RAG or knowledge-graph approaches with higher long-term memory accuracy
Engineering teams adding memory to coding assistants, support bots, and similar products
Researchers wanting to try agent memory quickly via MCP or the LLM wrapper

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的技能框架与完整软件开发方法论
zh.what: Superpowers 是一套面向编码代理的完整软件开发方法论，建立在可组合的 skills 和初始指令之上。它让代理在动手写代码前先追问真实需求、产出规格与实现计划，再以子代理驱动开发的方式逐项完成任务并自我审查。
zh.content: 仓库以 Shell 脚本和技能定义为主，包含安装说明、基础工作流、故障处理、哲学理念等文档，并针对 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Copilot CLI 等十余种代理工具提供分平台安装指引。
zh.stack: 以 Shell 为主要语言，核心是可组合的 skills 定义与初始指令，依赖各编码代理平台自身的插件或 CLI 机制，无重型外部依赖。
zh.hot: 它切中了“代理写代码不靠谱”的痛点，用 TDD、YAGNI、DRY 和子代理审查把代理变成有纪律的工程流程，已获约 29.1 万 star，今日新增 611，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜第 10。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等编码代理的开发者，希望代理按规范流程工作
团队想为 AI 辅助开发引入可复用的技能与工程纪律
对代理驱动开发、TDD 与子代理协作模式感兴趣的研究者
需要跨多个代理平台统一开发方法论的工程组织

en.tag: An agentic skills framework and complete software development methodology for coding agents
en.what: Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for coding agents, built on composable skills plus initial instructions that ensure the agent actually uses them. Instead of jumping straight into code, the agent teases out a spec, presents it in digestible chunks, builds an implementation plan, then runs a subagent-driven development process that inspects and reviews each task.
en.content: The repo is mostly Shell scripts and skill definitions, with docs covering installation, the basic workflow, troubleshooting, philosophy, and per-harness setup guides for a dozen-plus agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and Copilot CLI.
en.stack: Primarily Shell, centered on composable skill definitions and initial instructions; it relies on each coding agent's own plugin or CLI mechanism rather than heavy external dependencies.
en.hot: It targets the pain of unreliable agent-written code by enforcing TDD, YAGNI, DRY, and subagent review as a disciplined engineering process, drawing ~291k stars with 611 added today and ranking #10 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Developers using coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor who want disciplined workflows
Teams seeking reusable skills and engineering discipline for AI-assisted development
Researchers interested in agent-driven development, TDD, and subagent collaboration
Engineering orgs wanting one methodology across multiple agent platforms

zh.tag: 面向真实工程的可组合 AI 代理技能集
zh.what: 这是 Matt Pocock 从自己 .agents 目录中整理出的日常 AI 代理技能集合，用于辅助真实软件工程而非“氛围编程”。它刻意做得小而可改、可组合，不接管流程，从而把控制权留给开发者。
zh.content: 仓库以 Shell 脚本形式存放一组可安装的技能文件，并附带安装说明、ADR 决策记录以及 skills.sh 徽章等元信息，整体是一个可被 Claude Code、Codex 等代理加载的技能包。
zh.stack: 以 Shell 为主，通过 Claude Code 插件市场或 npx skills 安装器分发，可运行在 Claude Code、Codex 等多种编码代理上，不绑定特定模型。
zh.hot: 今日新增 583 star、总星数约 27 万并冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 5，说明开发者对“可控、可改、不夺权”的代理技能方案需求强烈，也受益于作者在 TypeScript 社区的影响力。
uses: 希望用 AI 代理辅助真实项目开发、而非只做演示原型的工程师
想按自己习惯改造和组合代理技能、保留流程控制权的开发者
使用 Claude Code、Codex 等编码代理并寻找现成技能包的团队
关注 AI 辅助工程实践、想学习可组合技能设计思路的技术负责人

en.tag: Composable agent skills for real engineering, not vibe coding
en.what: A collection of Matt Pocock's daily agent skills, pulled straight from his .agents directory, aimed at real engineering rather than vibe coding. They are deliberately small, adaptable and composable, so they assist the process instead of owning it.
en.content: The repo holds a set of installable skill files written mostly in Shell, along with installation docs, ADR decision records and skills.sh metadata, forming a skill bundle loadable by Claude Code, Codex and other agents.
en.stack: Primarily Shell, distributed via the Claude Code plugin marketplace or the npx skills installer, and runnable across Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents without binding to a specific model.
en.hot: With 583 stars added today, roughly 269k total and a #5 spot on GitHub Trending daily, it shows strong demand for controllable, editable agent skills that don't hijack the workflow, amplified by the author's TypeScript community reach.
uses: Engineers who want AI agents to assist real project development, not just demo prototypes
Developers who prefer to hack, adapt and compose skills while keeping control of the process
Teams using Claude Code, Codex or similar coding agents and looking for ready-made skill bundles
Tech leads studying composable skill design for AI-assisted engineering practices

zh.tag: 面向 AI 代理的一体化 Office 运行时 SDK
zh.what: Univer 是一个开源 Office SDK，让开发者把电子表格、文档、演示、看板、关系表与 PDF 等办公能力嵌入到自己的产品中。它定位为「AI 代理的 Office 载体」，为智能体提供可编程的办公文档运行时。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 包形式组织，包含核心引擎、插件模块、公式引擎、Canvas 渲染层与统一 Facade API，并配有 docs 文档、示例与多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，基于 Canvas 渲染与插件化架构，提供浏览器与 Node.js 通用的 Facade API，依赖 pnpm 工作区与 CI/CD 工具链。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1082 star、总数 17654，冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 3，AI 代理与办公自动化结合是当前热点，Univer 正好卡住这一需求。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为智能体提供可读写电子表格与文档的运行时
SaaS 产品团队：在自有应用中嵌入表格、文档与演示编辑能力
低代码/协作平台：基于插件架构定制办公组件
研究者与学习者：研究 Canvas 渲染、公式引擎与 Office 文档模型

en.tag: The Office Harness for AI Agents — one runtime for docs, sheets, slides
en.what: Univer is an open-source Office SDK that lets developers embed spreadsheet, document, presentation, board, relational-table and PDF experiences directly into their own products. Positioned as the Office Harness for AI Agents, it gives agents a programmable runtime for office documents.
en.content: The repo is organized as TypeScript packages: a core engine, plugin modules, a formula engine, a Canvas rendering layer and a unified Facade API, plus docs, examples and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript with Canvas-based rendering and a plugin architecture, exposing one Facade API for both browser and Node.js, managed via pnpm workspaces and CI/CD tooling.
en.hot: With 1,082 stars added today and 17,654 total, it hit #3 on GitHub Trending daily — riding the hot intersection of AI agents and office automation.
uses: AI agent developers: give agents a runtime to read and write spreadsheets and docs
SaaS product teams: embed spreadsheet, document and presentation editing in their apps
Low-code/collaboration platforms: customize office components via the plugin architecture
Researchers and learners: study Canvas rendering, formula engines and office document models

zh.tag: Anthropic 官方 Agent Skills 示例与规范仓库
zh.what: 这是 Anthropic 为 Claude 打造的 Agent Skills 官方实现仓库，用文件夹形式封装指令、脚本与资源，让 Claude 能动态加载并稳定完成特定任务。它同时给出 Agent Skills 规范与模板，是理解该机制的标准参考。
zh.content: 仓库分为 skills（创意设计、开发技术、企业通信、文档处理等示例）、spec（Agent Skills 规范）和 template（技能模板）三部分，每个技能自包含一个 SKILL.md 文件。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主语言，技能由 Markdown 指令、脚本和资源文件组成，可注册为 Claude Code 插件并在 Claude.ai 与 API 中使用。
zh.hot: 作为 Anthropic 官方仓库，它公开了驱动 Claude 文档能力的 docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx 技能，叠加 Agent Skills 标准热度，已累积约 17.8 万 star，今日仍新增 155 星。
uses: 想为 Claude 或自研 Agent 编写自定义技能包的开发者
需要参考官方规范与模板来设计 Agent Skills 的团队
研究 Claude 文档生成与编辑能力实现细节的工程师
希望把企业品牌、通信或数据工作流封装成可复用技能的组织

en.tag: Anthropic's official Agent Skills examples and specification repo
en.what: This is Anthropic's official implementation of Agent Skills for Claude, packaging instructions, scripts, and resources into folders that Claude loads dynamically to reliably perform specialized tasks. It also ships the Agent Skills specification and a template, serving as the canonical reference for the mechanism.
en.content: It contains skills (examples for creative & design, development & technical, enterprise & communication, and document skills), spec (the Agent Skills specification), and template (a skill template), with each skill self-contained in a folder with a SKILL.md file.
en.stack: Python is the primary language; skills consist of Markdown instructions, scripts, and resource files, and can be registered as a Claude Code plugin and used in Claude.ai and the API.
en.hot: As an official Anthropic repo, it open-sources the docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx skills powering Claude's document capabilities, and with the Agent Skills standard hype it has reached about 178k stars, still adding 155 today.
uses: Developers who want to author custom skill packs for Claude or their own agents
Teams needing the official spec and template to design Agent Skills
Engineers studying how Claude's document generation and editing capabilities are implemented
Organizations wanting to package branding, communications, or data workflows into reusable skills

zh.tag: 像素风空间站里的本地优先 AI 代理工作台
zh.what: StarNet 是一个本地优先的桌面代理运行框架，让你创建多个 AI 代理、把它们安置在像素风空间站里，并真实地调用模型和工具干活。空间站不是装饰，而是运行时状态的可视化投影：房间代表有权限边界的小队，走廊是授权的交接通道，摆放的物件就是真实的能力授权。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用本体（JavaScript 主语言）、安装与隐私文档、docs 文档索引、贡献指南，以及发布版下载入口；核心是代理运行时、像素空间站渲染与多通道消息集成。
zh.stack: 以 JavaScript 为主，桌面端本地运行，密钥存放在操作系统钥匙串中；支持 OpenRouter、Anthropic、OpenAI、Google 等模型接入，并可通过 MCP 连接器扩展工具能力。
zh.hot: 今日新增 113 星、总数 259 星并登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第 6，靠的是「像素空间站 + 真实代理执行」这一反差感极强的本地优先玩法。
uses: 想同时运行多个有独立工作区与权限边界的 AI 代理的开发者
偏好本地优先、自带 API Key、不愿把数据交给云端的隐私敏感用户
喜欢像素风界面、希望把工作流可视化编排的创意型玩家
需要通过 Telegram、Discord、Slack 等渠道远程指挥代理干活的团队

en.tag: A local-first desktop agent harness set in a living pixel-art space station
en.what: StarNet is a local-first desktop harness where you create AI agents, arrange them in a pixel-art space station, and watch them do real work with real models and tools. The station is not decoration but a projection of live runtime state: a room is a capability-scoped team, a hallway is an authorized handoff lane, and a placed object is a real capability grant.
en.content: The repo contains the desktop app itself (JavaScript-first), install and privacy docs, a docs index, contributing guide, and release download links; at its core are the agent runtime, the pixel-station renderer, and multi-channel messaging integrations.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, running locally on the desktop with keys stored in the OS keychain; it supports OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google model access, and extends tool reach via MCP connectors.
en.hot: It gained 113 stars today for 259 total and hit #6 on GitHub Trending (JavaScript) daily, driven by the striking contrast of a pixel-art station paired with genuinely real agent execution, all local-first.
uses: Developers who want to run several AI agents concurrently, each with its own workspace and permission boundary
Privacy-conscious users who prefer local-first operation with their own API keys
Creative tinkerers drawn to pixel-art interfaces and visual workflow arrangement
Teams that want to command agents remotely via Telegram, Discord, Slack, Signal, or Matrix

zh.tag: 纯 USB 跨平台 Wi-Fi 安全审计工具
zh.what: wifit3 是一个独立的 Wi-Fi 安全审计工具，可在 Linux、Windows 和 macOS 上以相同方式运行。它通过 USB 无线网卡完成扫描、抓包与各类 WPA/WPS/WEP 攻击，无需依赖 aircrack-ng 或 reaver。
zh.content: 仓库为纯 Python 项目，包含实时扫描器、数据包仪表盘、握手/PMKID 抓取、EvilTwin WPA3 降级、WPS 恢复套件与 WEP 攻击模块，并附有截图与支持硬件列表。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，使用 PyUSB 直接驱动 USB 无线网卡，界面由 Textual 构建，内置无线协议栈以避开内核驱动与 NDIS 问题，零运行时依赖。
zh.hot: 项目今日新增 183 star，总 star 达 922，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 9 名，跨平台与免依赖特性吸引大量安全研究者关注。
uses: 无线安全测试人员与渗透测试工程师，用于授权环境下的 Wi-Fi 审计
跨平台安全研究者，希望在 Windows/macOS 上获得与 Linux 一致的无线测试体验
拥有受支持 USB 无线网卡、想学习 WPA/WPS/WEP 攻防原理的进阶用户

en.tag: A standalone USB-only cross-platform Wi-Fi auditor
en.what: wifit3 is a standalone Wi-Fi auditing tool that runs identically on Linux, Windows, and macOS. Using USB wireless adapters, it performs scanning, packet capture, and various WPA/WPS/WEP attacks without relying on aircrack-ng or reaver.
en.content: The repo is a pure Python project containing a real-time scanner, packet dashboard, handshake/PMKID capture, EvilTwin WPA3 downgrade, WPS recovery suite, and WEP attack modules, along with screenshots and a supported hardware list.
en.stack: Built in Python with PyUSB for direct USB adapter control and Textual for the UI, featuring a built-in wireless stack to avoid kernel driver and NDIS issues, with zero runtime dependencies.
en.hot: It gained 183 stars today, reaching 922 total and ranking 9th on GitHub Trending, drawing attention from security researchers for its cross-platform, dependency-free design.
uses: Wireless security testers and penetration testers conducting authorized Wi-Fi audits
Cross-platform security researchers wanting a consistent wireless testing experience on Windows/macOS as on Linux
Advanced users with supported USB adapters who want to learn WPA/WPS/WEP attack and defense principles

zh.tag: 手把手从零搭建 Kubernetes 集群的硬核教程
zh.what: 这是一个以学习为导向的 Kubernetes 教程，带你不用任何自动化脚本，手动一步步搭建一个完整的 Kubernetes 集群。它刻意选择「最长的路」，让你真正理解启动集群所需的每一项任务和核心组件之间的关系。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 docs/ 目录下的 13 个渐进式实验文档，从环境准备、证书生成、etcd 集群，到控制平面、工作节点、Pod 网络路由和冒烟测试。

准备 CKA/CKS 等认证、需要动手实践底层原理的考生
希望摆脱托管服务黑盒、掌握集群搭建细节的运维人员

en.tag: A hardcore, no-scripts tutorial for bootstrapping Kubernetes from scratch
en.what: This is a learning-oriented Kubernetes tutorial that walks you through manually bootstrapping a full Kubernetes cluster without any automation scripts. It deliberately takes the long route so you truly understand every task and how the core components fit together.

en.stack: The tutorial centers on Kubernetes v1.32.x, containerd v2.1.x, CNI v1.6.x, and etcd v3.6.x, and requires four ARM64 or AMD64 machines.
en.hot: As a classic by Kelsey Hightower, it has accumulated over 50k stars and gained another 119 today to rank 10th on the daily trending list, showing the enduring demand for learning that rejects black boxes and returns to fundamentals.

Candidates preparing for CKA/CKS certifications who need hands-on practice with underlying principles
Ops engineers who want to escape managed-service black boxes and master cluster setup details

zh.tag: 自托管零运维的 A 股选股监控回测量化工作台

en.tag: Google's open-source high-throughput declarative agent orchestration runtime
en.what: AX is a declarative orchestrator for running billions of autonomous agent workloads in a cluster. It provides sandboxed execution, pre-wired workspaces, and model configuration through three primitives: Task, Workspace, and Model, making agent tasks manageable like Kubernetes.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based CLI and control plane, along with example YAML manifests (e.g., task.yaml). Core components include custom resource definitions like Task, Workspace, and Model, plus commands such as ax apply/watch/ssh.
en.stack: Primarily built in Go, it depends on a Kubernetes cluster, Redis, and Agent Substrate for sandboxed execution. It uses ko for building and deploying container images.
en.hot: As Google's open-source agent orchestration project, AX quickly gained 10,451 stars on GitHub, with 1,373 added today, ranking 4th on the daily trending list. Its declarative approach and scalability attract many developers interested in AI agent infrastructure.
uses: AI platform engineers: teams needing to run and manage autonomous agent workloads at scale.
DevOps and SREs: those wanting to orchestrate agent tasks declaratively, similar to Kubernetes for apps.
AI researchers: requiring secure sandboxed environments to test and debug agent behavior.
Enterprise developers: building agent-based automation flows with isolation and resource control.

zh.tag: NVIDIA 官方模型压缩与推理加速统一库
zh.what: NVIDIA Model Optimizer 是一个模型优化技术统一库，集成了量化、剪枝、神经架构搜索、蒸馏、投机解码和稀疏化等 SOTA 方法。它接收 Hugging Face、PyTorch 或 ONNX 模型，输出优化后的量化 checkpoint，可直接部署到 TensorRT-LLM、TensorRT、vLLM、SGLang 等推理框架以提升推理速度。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python API、量化与蒸馏等优化算法实现、示例教程（如 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 NVFP4 W4A4 + QAD 端到端教程）、文档站点源码以及面向 Megatron-Bridge、Megatron-LM、Hugging Face Accelerate 的集成代码。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 PyTorch、Hugging Face Transformers/Accelerate、ONNX，并与 NVIDIA Megatron-Bridge、Megatron-LM、TensorRT-LLM、TensorRT、vLLM、SGLang 等生态深度集成。
zh.hot: 作为 NVIDIA 官方出品的模型优化统一库，它直接打通从训练到 TensorRT-LLM/vLLM 部署的量化链路，契合大模型推理降本增效的刚需，今日新增 44 star 登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 5，累计约 4081 star。
uses: 大模型推理部署工程师，需要将模型量化后接入 TensorRT-LLM、vLLM 等框架
模型压缩与优化研究者，想复现量化、蒸馏、剪枝、NAS 等 SOTA 技术
使用 NVIDIA GPU 生态的团队，希望在 Megatron 或 Hugging Face 流程中加入量化训练
需要降低显存占用与推理成本、同时尽量保持精度的应用开发者

en.tag: NVIDIA's unified library for model compression and inference acceleration
en.what: NVIDIA Model Optimizer is a unified library of state-of-the-art model optimization techniques including quantization, pruning, neural architecture search, distillation, speculative decoding, and sparsity. It takes Hugging Face, PyTorch, or ONNX models and exports optimized quantized checkpoints ready for deployment in inference frameworks like TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT, vLLM, and SGLang to speed up inference.
en.content: The repo contains Python APIs, implementations of optimization algorithms such as quantization and distillation, example tutorials (e.g., an end-to-end NVFP4 W4A4 + QAD tutorial for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B), documentation source, and integrations for Megatron-Bridge, Megatron-LM, and Hugging Face Accelerate.
en.stack: Primarily Python, depending on PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers/Accelerate, and ONNX, with deep integration into the NVIDIA ecosystem including Megatron-Bridge, Megatron-LM, TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT, vLLM, and SGLang.
en.hot: As an official NVIDIA library, it bridges training and deployment quantization pipelines for TensorRT-LLM/vLLM, meeting the pressing need to cut LLM inference costs. It gained 44 stars today to rank #5 on GitHub Trending, with about 4,081 stars total.
uses: LLM inference deployment engineers who need to quantize models for TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, and similar frameworks
Model compression and optimization researchers reproducing SOTA quantization, distillation, pruning, and NAS techniques
Teams in the NVIDIA GPU ecosystem adding quantization-aware training to Megatron or Hugging Face pipelines
Application developers aiming to reduce memory footprint and inference cost while preserving accuracy

zh.tag: 让 AI 编码代理产出专业级前端设计的技能包与检测工具
zh.what: Impeccable 是一套面向 AI 编码代理的设计指导系统，通过一个技能、24 条命令、实时浏览器迭代和 61 条确定性检测规则，帮助 AI 生成更专业的前端界面。它从 Anthropic 的 frontend-design 技能出发，解决 AI 生成设计千篇一律的问题。

zh.hot: 上线后迅速获得 70,803 颗星，今日新增 527 星，位列 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第一，反映出开发者对 AI 生成设计质量提升的强烈需求。

设计系统工程师，需要为团队建立可复用的 AI 设计规范与检测流程

zh.tag: 开源社区治理的密钥与证书管理平台，Vault 的开源继任者
zh.what: OpenBao 用于集中管理、存储和分发敏感数据，包括密钥、证书和各类凭据。它在写入持久化存储前对数据加密，因此即使拿到原始存储也无法直接读取机密。项目由 OpenSSF 下的开放治理社区运营，采用 OSI 认可的开源许可证。
zh.content: 仓库是完整的 Go 服务端代码库，包含核心密钥引擎、存储后端、认证方式、审计日志、CLI 与 API 等模块，并配有官网、邮件列表、Zulip 聊天频道和多个工作组。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，依赖插件化的存储与认证后端，可对接多种数据库、云 KMS 和 PKCS#11 硬件模块；构建与发布遵循 OpenSSF 最佳实践与 Scorecard 标准。
zh.hot: 在 HashiCorp 将 Vault 改为 BUSL 许可证后，社区需要一个真正开源、开放治理的替代品，OpenBao 因此快速聚集人气，已获 7731 星，今日新增 49 星并登上日榜第 16。
uses: 需要自托管密钥管理、又不想受商业许可证限制的运维与安全团队
希望用开放治理方案替代 HashiCorp Vault 的企业架构师
为微服务、数据库和云服务集中管理凭据与证书的平台工程师
关注供应链安全与开源合规的 DevSecOps 从业者

en.tag: Community-governed secrets, certificates and keys management platform, the open-source successor to Vault
en.what: OpenBao centrally manages, stores and distributes sensitive data such as secrets, certificates and keys. It encrypts data before writing to persistent storage, so raw storage access alone does not expose your secrets. The project is run by an open-governance community under OpenSSF with an OSI-approved license.
en.content: The repo is the full Go server codebase, covering core secret engines, storage backends, auth methods, audit logging, CLI and API, alongside a website, mailing list, Zulip channels and several working groups.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, it relies on pluggable storage and auth backends and integrates with databases, cloud KMS and PKCS#11 hardware modules; builds and releases follow OpenSSF best practices and Scorecard standards.
en.hot: After HashiCorp moved Vault to the BUSL license, the community needed a truly open-source, openly governed alternative, and OpenBao quickly gained traction: 7,731 stars, +49 today, ranking 16th on the daily trending list.
uses: Ops and security teams wanting self-hosted secret management without commercial license restrictions
Enterprise architects looking for an openly governed alternative to HashiCorp Vault
Platform engineers centralizing credentials and certificates for microservices, databases and cloud services
DevSecOps practitioners focused on supply-chain security and open-source compliance

zh.tag: 面向 AI 代理的工具版 OpenRouter，一个令牌调用 3000+ 工具端点

企业团队：希望统一管理自有 API 密钥、CLI 与 SKILL.md，并让全员代理安全复用
自托管用户：需要私有化部署工具网关并掌控凭证与计费

en.tag: OpenRouter for agent tools — one token, 3,000+ tool endpoints
en.what: Treg is a tool aggregation gateway for AI agents — OpenRouter, but for tools instead of models. Point an agent at one base URL with one token and it can call 3,000+ endpoints across 60+ providers, priced per call from a cent, with no provider signup.
en.content: The repo contains a Python proxy service, a CLI installer, and the tool catalog, supporting endpoints, CLIs, and skill/bundle registrations, with both a hosted treg.to and self-hosting.
en.stack: Written mainly in Python; it proxies upstream requests over HTTP and injects credentials server-side, with a shell-installed CLI, hosted on Render.
en.hot: It quickly reached 3,164 stars with 468 added today, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending daily, hitting the pain of fragmented, expensive agent tool access.
uses: AI agent developers who want agents to call search, scraping, and social tools without integrating each vendor
Indie developers and small teams unwilling to buy pricey Semrush or Apollo subscriptions for a single run

Engineers who want to integrate a CMS directly into a Next.js project

zh.tag: 并行多智能体编排的桌面级 ADE，自带订阅即可跑任意编码代理
zh.what: Orca 是一个面向编码代理的 ADE（Agent Development Environment），让你把 Codex、ClaudeCode、OpenCode、Pi 等代理并排运行，每个代理跑在独立的 git worktree 里并统一追踪。它支持桌面端、移动端伴侣 App 与远程运行时，用你自己的订阅即可驱动任意编码代理。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 编写的桌面应用为主体，包含 resources 图标与构建资源、docs 多语言 README（中/日/韩/西/法/葡）与功能演示 GIF、移动端伴侣 App（iOS/TestFlight/Android APK）以及远程运行时相关代码。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，基于 Electron 风格的跨平台桌面应用（macOS/Windows/Linux），配套 iOS/Android 移动端与远程运行时，MIT 许可，依赖各编码代理 CLI 与 git worktree 机制。
zh.hot: 本周新增 5362 star、总量约 6.95 万，冲上 GitHub Trending 周榜 TypeScript 第 14 名；多代理并行编排正是当下最热的开发范式，而 Orca 让用户用自己的订阅跑多个代理，切中成本与效率痛点。
uses: 同时使用多个编码代理、需要并行对比结果的开发者
希望用自有订阅而非额外付费来驱动代理的个人与团队
需要在手机上监控和跟进代理进度、随时发指令的工程师
想用 git worktree 隔离实验、再择优合并的工程团队

en.tag: A desktop ADE for orchestrating a fleet of parallel coding agents on your own subscription
en.what: Orca is an Agent Development Environment for running a fleet of coding agents in parallel. It runs Codex, ClaudeCode, OpenCode or Pi side-by-side, each in its own isolated git worktree, tracked in one place, and works on desktop, mobile companion app and remote runtime using your own subscription.
en.content: The repo centers on a TypeScript desktop app, with build resources and icons, multilingual docs (zh-CN, ja, ko, es, fr, pt) plus feature GIFs, a mobile companion app (iOS App Store, TestFlight, Android APK) and remote runtime code.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript as a cross-platform desktop app (macOS/Windows/Linux), paired with iOS/Android companions and a remote runtime, MIT-licensed, and relying on coding-agent CLIs plus git worktrees.
en.hot: It gained 5,362 stars this week to reach ~69.5k total, landing at #14 on GitHub Trending's weekly TypeScript chart. Parallel multi-agent orchestration is the hottest dev paradigm right now, and Orca's bring-your-own-subscription model hits both cost and efficiency pain points.
uses: Developers running multiple coding agents and comparing results in parallel
Individuals and teams wanting to drive agents with their own existing subscriptions
Engineers who need to monitor and steer agents from their phone on the go
Teams wanting isolated git worktree experiments and merging the winner

zh.tag: 带图形界面的 Nginx 反向代理与 SSL 管理容器
zh.what: Nginx Proxy Manager 是一个预构建的 Docker 镜像，让用户无需深入了解 Nginx 或 Let's Encrypt，就能通过可视化界面配置反向代理、重定向、TCP 流转发和 404 主机。它自动申请并续期免费 SSL 证书，也可上传自定义证书，是自托管家庭网络的常用入口网关。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的应用源码（TypeScript 后端与前端）、Docker 构建文件、docker-compose 示例、数据库迁移脚本以及官方文档站点内容，核心是管理界面与 Nginx 配置生成逻辑。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，后端基于 Node.js，前端采用 Tabler UI 框架，数据存储使用 SQLite/MySQL，依赖 Nginx 与 Let's Encrypt（certbot）实现代理和证书管理，通过 Docker 分发。
zh.hot: 该项目已积累 34,235 颗星，今日新增 21 星并登上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 日榜第 5 名，说明自托管与家庭实验室需求持续旺盛，其“傻瓜式”反向代理加免费 SSL 的定位精准击中了运维新手的痛点。
uses: 自托管爱好者：快速将家庭内网服务暴露到公网并自动配置 HTTPS
中小团队运维：用图形界面管理多个域名的反向代理和 SSL 证书
Docker 用户：通过 docker-compose 一键部署，作为所有 Web 服务的统一入口网关
需要基础访问控制与审计日志的场景：利用访问列表和用户权限管理保护内部服务

en.tag: Docker-based Nginx reverse proxy manager with a simple web UI and free SSL
en.what: Nginx Proxy Manager is a pre-built Docker image that lets users configure reverse proxies, redirections, stream forwarding, and 404 hosts through a visual interface, without needing deep Nginx or Let's Encrypt knowledge. It automatically issues and renews free SSL certificates, supports custom certificates, and serves as a common gateway for self-hosted home networks.
en.content: The repo contains the full application source (TypeScript backend and frontend), Docker build files, docker-compose examples, database migration scripts, and the official documentation site, centered on the admin UI and Nginx config generation logic.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, with a Node.js backend, Tabler UI frontend, SQLite/MySQL storage, and Nginx plus Let's Encrypt (certbot) for proxying and certificate management, distributed via Docker.
en.hot: With 34,235 stars and 21 added today, ranking 5th on GitHub Trending (TypeScript daily), it shows the sustained demand for self-hosting and homelabs, and its "monkey-simple" reverse proxy plus free SSL positioning precisely addresses ops beginners' pain points.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts: quickly expose home services to the internet with automatic HTTPS
Small team ops: manage reverse proxies and SSL certificates for multiple domains via a GUI
Docker users: deploy with docker-compose as a unified gateway for all web services
Scenarios needing basic access control and audit logs: protect internal services with access lists and user permissions

zh.tag: 把 Claude Code 与 Codex 编成一支持久化多智能体团队的编排工具
zh.what: OpenRig 是一个多智能体编排框架，用 YAML 定义智能体团队，一条命令即可启动。它把 Claude Code 和 Codex 放在同一个 rig 中统一管理，让 AI 编码代理从零散的终端会话变成有组织的常驻团队。你可以与 lead agent 沟通目标，由它协调各团队专家并汇总需要你决策的结果。
zh.content: 仓库提供 @openrig/cli 命令行工具、YAML 团队配置、内核与共享 TUI 仪表盘，以及 getting-started 等参考文档。核心形态是 rig 项目：包含 owner/checker 等席位、消息队列与任务队列。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 与 Node.js（要求 20/22/24），依赖 tmux 提供终端会话，并集成 Claude Code、Codex 等原生 harness 与 cmux 终端提供方。
zh.hot: 发布不久即获 449 star，今日新增 80，冲上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 日榜第 6。它切中多代理协作与 Claude Code/Codex 混用的真实痛点，且一条命令即可上手。
uses: 希望把多个 AI 编码代理组织成常驻团队的开发者
同时使用 Claude Code 与 Codex、想统一编排的工程师
需要 lead agent 协调专家并汇报决策的团队负责人
想用 YAML 声明式管理代理权限与工作流的自动化爱好者

en.tag: A multi-agent harness that runs Claude Code and Codex together as one persistent team
en.what: OpenRig is a multi-agent orchestration harness that defines agent teams in YAML and boots them with a single command. It runs Claude Code and Codex inside the same rig, turning scattered terminal sessions into a persistent, organized team. You talk to a lead agent about the outcome you want, and it coordinates specialists across teams and surfaces results and decisions needing your attention.
en.content: The repo ships the @openrig/cli command-line tool, YAML team configs, a kernel plus a shared TUI dashboard, and reference docs such as getting-started. The core unit is a rig project with seats like owner/checker, message queues, and task queues.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript on Node.js (20/22/24 required), depends on tmux for terminal sessions, and integrates native harnesses such as Claude Code and Codex plus the cmux terminal provider.
en.hot: It quickly reached 449 stars with 80 added today, landing at #6 on GitHub Trending's TypeScript daily chart. It hits the real pain of multi-agent collaboration and mixing Claude Code with Codex, while staying one-command simple to start.
uses: Developers who want to organize multiple AI coding agents into a persistent team
Engineers using both Claude Code and Codex who want unified orchestration
Tech leads who need a lead agent to coordinate specialists and report decisions
Automation fans who prefer declarative YAML for agent permissions and workflows

zh.tag: 开源 SEO 分析平台，支持 AI Agent 与 MCP 工具链集成
zh.what: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、外链审计与站点诊断等核心 SEO 工作流。它采用按量付费模式，用户只需接入自己的 DataForSEO API 密钥即可使用，无需订阅。同时，它内置 MCP 服务器和可复用的 Agent Skills，让 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等 AI 代理直接调用 SEO 数据完成自动化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的前后端应用代码与现代化 UI，支持 Docker 和 Cloudflare 自托管，内置 MCP 服务器以及预设的 Agent Skills（如 keyword-research、competitor-analysis、link-prospecting）。文档涵盖 API 密钥配置、Google Search Console 接入、SEO 成本参考及本地开发指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，前端采用现代 UI 框架，后端依赖 DataForSEO API 获取 SEO 数据，并通过 MCP 协议与外部 AI Agent 通信；支持 Docker 容器化部署与 Cloudflare 边缘托管。
zh.hot: 在 SEO 工具普遍昂贵且功能臃肿的背景下，它以开源、按量付费、可自托管的定位迅速获得关注；4,405 Stars 中本月新增 2,187 颗，登上 GitHub TypeScript 月榜第 17 名，其对 MCP 与 AI Agent 的原生集成进一步放大了开发者与增长团队的兴趣。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 无需订阅高价 SaaS，用自有 API 密钥低成本完成 SEO 监控与关键词研究。
AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。
隐私敏感企业 —— 支持 Docker/Cloudflare 自托管，完全掌控数据与成本。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.
en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

zh.tag: 开源无广告的安卓流媒体播放应用
zh.what: Vega 是一款面向安卓的流媒体播放应用，支持在线播放与下载，且完全无广告。用户可以自定义内容源、管理观看列表，并与桌面端同步数据。

zh.hot: 凭借无广告、多音轨字幕和自定义源等实用功能，该项目已收获 1428 颗星，今日新增 20 星，登上 TypeScript 日榜第 8 名。
uses: 想在安卓设备上无广告观看和下载流媒体内容的普通用户
需要自定义内容源、管理观看列表的进阶用户
希望研究 React Native 流媒体应用开发的开发者

en.tag: An open-source, ad-free media streaming app for Android
en.what: Vega is a media streaming app for Android that lets you stream and download content ad-free. It supports custom sources, watchlists, and syncing with the desktop app.
en.content: The repo holds the React Native Android client source, build configs, and release assets, with APK downloads and a Google Play release.
en.stack: Built with React Native and TypeScript, using NativeWind for styling, React Navigation, plus Expo Modules, react-native-video, and MMKV storage.
en.hot: With ad-free streaming, multi-audio/subtitle support, and custom sources, it has earned 1,428 stars, gaining 20 today and ranking 8th on the TypeScript daily trending list.

Power users who need custom sources and watchlist management
Developers studying React Native media app development

zh.tag: 修复 X/Twitter 与 Bluesky 链接预览的嵌入服务
zh.what: FxEmbed 通过在链接前加前缀（如 fixup、fx）把 X/Twitter 和 Bluesky 的帖子转换成富媒体嵌入，让 Discord、Telegram 等平台能显示多图、视频、投票、引用和翻译。它同时提供 FxTwitter、FixupX 和 FxBluesky 三个域名服务。
zh.content: 仓库是 TypeScript 编写的 Cloudflare Worker 项目，包含 API 路由、各域名 realm 处理、品牌与本地化配置，以及 Docker/Wrangler 自托管文件和测试工作流。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 与 Cloudflare Workers，使用 esbuild 构建，通过 Wrangler 部署，支持 Docker Compose 自托管，并接入 Crowdin 做多语言翻译。
zh.hot: 它解决了社交平台链接预览长期残缺的痛点，已获 5367 星，今日新增 182 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 6 名。
uses: Discord 与 Telegram 社区管理员，希望频道内 X/Bluesky 链接能完整显示媒体内容
普通用户想在不离开聊天软件的情况下查看推文的多图、视频和投票
开发者可基于其公开 API 或自托管方案，把嵌入能力集成进自己的应用
关注链接预览与社交数据抓取的技术爱好者，可参考其 Worker 架构与多域名路由设计

en.tag: Embed fixer for X/Twitter and Bluesky link previews
en.what: FxEmbed rewrites X/Twitter and Bluesky links with prefixes like fixup and fx to produce rich embeds, so Discord, Telegram and others can show multiple images, videos, polls, quotes and translations. It powers the FxTwitter, FixupX and FxBluesky domains.
en.content: The repo is a TypeScript Cloudflare Worker project with API routes, per-domain realm handling, branding and localization configs, plus Docker/Wrangler self-hosting files and test workflows.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Cloudflare Workers, bundled with esbuild, deployed via Wrangler, self-hostable with Docker Compose, and localized through Crowdin.
en.hot: It solves the long-standing pain of broken social link previews, with 5,367 stars, 182 added today, ranking 6th on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Discord and Telegram community admins who want X/Bluesky links to show full media in channels
Everyday users who want to view tweet images, videos and polls without leaving their chat app
Developers who can integrate embed capabilities into their own apps via the public API or self-hosting
Link-preview and social-scraping enthusiasts interested in its Worker architecture and multi-domain routing

zh.tag: Cursor 官方插件规范与插件集合
zh.what: 这是 Cursor 官方维护的插件规范与插件仓库，定义了 agent 插件如何以独立目录加 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json 清单的形式组织。仓库同时收录了一批面向开发者工具、框架和 SaaS 产品的官方插件，覆盖代码审查、任务编排、学习记忆等场景。
zh.content: 仓库根目录下每个插件是一个独立目录，各自带有 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json 清单，README 用表格列出插件名、作者、分类与描述。已收录 teaching、continual-learning、cursor-team-kit、thermos、create-plugin、ralph-loop、orchestrate、pstack、advisor、grok-voice 等十余个插件。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，插件以清单文件加目录结构的形式分发，部分插件依赖 Cursor SDK 与 CLI 能力。整体是围绕 Cursor agent 生态的插件化扩展方案。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4683 star，总 star 达 7254，冲上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 3 名。Cursor 官方亲自下场定义插件规范，加上 agent 工具链正处风口，让开发者迅速涌入关注。
uses: Cursor 深度用户：想用官方插件扩展 agent 的代码审查、编排与学习能力
插件开发者：需要遵循官方规范脚手架并发布自己的 agent 插件
团队工程负责人：关注 CI、代码评审与本地自动化的内部工作流插件
AI 工具链研究者：想了解 agent 插件规范与生态的组织方式

en.tag: Cursor plugin spec and official plugin collection
en.what: This is Cursor's official plugin specification and plugin collection, defining how agent plugins are structured as standalone directories with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest. It also ships a set of official plugins for popular developer tools, frameworks, and SaaS products, covering code review, task orchestration, and learning memory.
en.content: Each plugin lives in its own directory at the repo root with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest, and the README tabulates name, author, category, and description. It already includes a dozen-plus plugins such as teaching, continual-learning, cursor-team-kit, thermos, create-plugin, ralph-loop, orchestrate, pstack, advisor, and grok-voice.
en.stack: The primary language is TypeScript, and plugins are distributed as manifest files plus directory structures, with some relying on the Cursor SDK and CLI capabilities. Overall it is a plugin-based extension scheme around the Cursor agent ecosystem.
en.hot: It gained 4,683 stars this month for a total of 7,254, reaching No. 3 on GitHub Trending's monthly chart. Cursor itself stepping in to define the plugin spec, amid the agent tooling boom, quickly drew developer attention.
uses: Heavy Cursor users: extend agent code review, orchestration, and learning via official plugins
Plugin developers: scaffold and publish their own agent plugins following the official spec
Team engineering leads: interested in internal workflow plugins for CI, code review, and local automation
AI tooling researchers: want to understand how agent plugin specs and ecosystems are organized

zh.tag: 跑在你自己设备上的开源 AI 助手，接入 20+ 聊天平台
zh.what: OpenClaw 是一个开源个人 AI 助手，运行在你自己的电脑上，并通过 Discord、iMessage、Slack、Teams、Telegram、WhatsApp 等 20 多个聊天渠道以及 macOS/iOS/Android/Windows/Linux 原生应用与你交互。同一个 Gateway 既能当个人助手，也能做团队共享部署，差别只在配置。状态、记忆和凭证都留在你的硬件上，模型与代理框架（Claude、Codex、本地模型）都是可随时替换的插件。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 实现，包含 Gateway 服务、各聊天平台与原生应用的连接器、插件化的模型/代理框架适配层，以及 docs 目录下的架构说明、入门指南、FAQ 与展示案例。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，基于 Node.js，通过 npm 包 openclaw 分发，安装脚本覆盖 macOS、Linux 与 Windows；模型侧以插件形式接入 Claude、Codex 及本地模型。
zh.hot: 近 39 万 star 的体量加上日榜 TypeScript 第 11 名，说明它已从个人项目长成社区级基础设施；今日 +167 的稳定增量，反映出「数据自持 + 多平台接入」这一诉求持续吸引开发者。
uses: 想在自己设备上自托管 AI 助手、不愿把记忆和凭证交给第三方的个人用户
需要把助手接入 Slack、Teams、Telegram 等现有团队聊天工具的工程团队
希望替换或混用 Claude、Codex、本地模型等不同模型后端的开发者
关注可信网关 + 不可信执行 + 确定性策略这一安全架构的研究者

en.tag: Open-source AI assistant on your own devices, wired into 20+ chat platforms
en.what: OpenClaw is an open-source AI assistant that runs on your own computer and meets you in the channels you already use — Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, Telegram, WhatsApp and 20+ more, plus native apps for macOS, iOS, Android, Windows and Linux. One Gateway serves it as a personal assistant on a laptop or as a shared team deployment, with configuration the only difference. State, memory and credentials stay on your hardware, while models and agent harnesses (Claude, Codex, local models) are swappable plugins.
en.content: The repo is a TypeScript codebase containing the Gateway service, connectors for each chat platform and native app, a plugin layer for model/agent-harness adapters, and a docs folder with architecture notes, getting-started guides, FAQ and showcase.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript on Node.js, distributed as the npm package openclaw with an installer for macOS, Linux and Windows; models plug in via adapters for Claude, Codex and local models.
en.hot: With roughly 390k stars and a No. 11 spot on the TypeScript daily trending list, it has grown from a personal project into community-scale infrastructure; a steady +167 today shows the 'own your data, meet users in any chat app' pitch keeps pulling developers in.
uses: Individuals who want a self-hosted assistant and refuse to hand memory and credentials to a third party
Engineering teams that need the assistant inside existing chat tools like Slack, Teams or Telegram
Developers who want to swap or mix model backends such as Claude, Codex and local models
Researchers interested in its trusted-gateway, untrusted-execution, deterministic-policy security model

zh.tag: 让编码代理直接操控并调试真实 Chrome 浏览器的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: chrome-devtools-mcp 是 Chrome DevTools 团队推出的 MCP 服务器，让 Claude、Cursor、Copilot 等编码代理直接控制和检查一个真实的 Chrome 浏览器。它把 DevTools 的完整能力暴露给 AI 助手，用于可靠的浏览器自动化、深度调试和性能分析，同时也提供不依赖 MCP 的 CLI。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 实现，核心是 MCP 服务器与配套 CLI，并附有工具参考、更新日志、贡献指南、故障排查和设计原则等文档。

en.tag: An MCP server that lets coding agents control and debug a live Chrome browser

关注开源 AI 编程工具生态的研究者与爱好者

en.tag: The open source AI coding agent for your terminal
en.what: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that works in your terminal, understanding your codebase, writing and editing code, running commands, and completing development tasks. It ships as both a CLI and a desktop app (beta), with installs via many package managers.

zh.tag: 多引擎 AI 编程 CLI 的统一桌面图形客户端
zh.what: ccgui 是一个开源的多引擎 AI 编程桌面客户端，把 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Kimi CLI、Grok CLI、OpenCode、DeepSeek Harness 等命令行 AI 编程工具统一到一个图形界面里。用户打开应用、选择项目，就能用聊天方式让 AI 写代码、修 bug、提交 Git，无需再盯着黑色终端。

zh.stack: 技术栈为 Tauri 2 + React 18 + TypeScript + Rust，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 三平台，设置与状态本地持久化，内容按所配置的 CLI 通道边界发送给 AI 提供商。
zh.hot: 凭借 4382 颗星、今日新增 16 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 TypeScript 第 14 名，它切中了开发者厌倦多终端切换、希望统一管理各家 AI 编程 CLI 的痛点。
uses: 同时使用多个 AI 编程 CLI、希望统一图形界面的开发者
偏好可视化聊天而非终端操作、想降低上手门槛的编程新手
需要在 macOS/Windows/Linux 多平台间切换的跨平台开发者
关注流式输出、思考轨迹与 token 用量等过程可见性的 AI 编程用户

en.tag: A unified desktop GUI for multi-engine AI coding CLIs
en.what: ccgui is an open-source multi-engine AI coding desktop client that unifies command-line AI coding runtimes such as Claude Code, Codex CLI, Kimi CLI, Grok CLI, OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness into a single graphical interface. Users open the app, pick a project, and chat with AI to write code, fix bugs and commit to Git without staring at a black terminal.
en.content: The repo contains a Tauri 2 + React 18 frontend and a Rust backend, where each engine is wired in through a dedicated protocol adapter that natively handles streaming events, session history and provider channels; it also ships app icons, bilingual READMEs (English/Simplified Chinese) and badges.
en.stack: Built with Tauri 2 + React 18 + TypeScript + Rust, it runs on macOS, Windows and Linux, persists settings and state locally, and sends content to AI providers within the boundary of the channel configured for each CLI.
en.hot: With 4,382 stars, 16 added today and a No. 14 spot on GitHub Trending's daily TypeScript list, it hits the pain point of developers tired of juggling multiple terminals who want one place to manage various AI coding CLIs.
uses: Developers using multiple AI coding CLIs who want one unified GUI
Coding beginners who prefer a visual chat interface over terminal commands
Cross-platform developers working across macOS, Windows and Linux
AI coding users who value visibility into streaming output, thinking traces and token usage

zh.tag: 浏览器里跑的 x86 模拟器，运行时把机器码 JIT 编译成 WebAssembly
zh.what: v86 在浏览器中模拟一台 x86 兼容 PC，包含 CPU、内存与一整套外设，能直接启动 Linux、Windows 95/98/2000、FreeDOS、Haiku 等真实操作系统。它把 x86 机器码在运行时翻译成 WebAssembly 模块，从而获得可用的执行性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器核心（CPU、FPU、VGA、IDE、网卡、声卡等设备实现）、x86 到 wasm 的 JIT 编译器、浏览器端 UI 与调试工具，以及 docs 目录下的工作原理、网络与调制解调器文档。
zh.stack: 主要用 JavaScript 编写，核心热点用 Rust/C 编译为 WebAssembly，浮点依赖 Berkeley SoftFloat 库，构建与测试基于 Node.js 工具链。
zh.hot: 作为浏览器里最完整的开源 x86 模拟器之一，它已积累 23528 颗星，今日再增 8 星并登上 JavaScript 日榜第 4，长期被当作 Web 端虚拟化与复古计算的标杆项目。
uses: 想在网页里体验或演示老系统（Windows 95/98、DOS、Haiku）的复古计算爱好者
需要把 x86 虚拟机嵌入 Web 应用、做在线实验或教学演示的开发者
研究 JIT 编译、WebAssembly 与 CPU 模拟技术的工程师和学生
希望在浏览器中安全运行不可信二进制或做沙箱实验的安全研究者

en.tag: An x86 PC emulator running in the browser, JIT-compiling machine code to WebAssembly at runtime
en.what: v86 emulates an x86-compatible PC in the browser, including the CPU, memory and a full set of peripherals, and can boot real operating systems such as Linux, Windows 95/98/2000, FreeDOS and Haiku. It translates x86 machine code into WebAssembly modules at runtime to achieve usable performance.
en.content: The repo contains the emulator core (CPU, FPU, VGA, IDE, network card, sound card and other device implementations), the x86-to-wasm JIT compiler, the browser UI and debugging tools, plus docs covering how it works, networking and the dial-up modem.
en.stack: Written mainly in JavaScript, with hot paths compiled from Rust/C to WebAssembly; floating point relies on the Berkeley SoftFloat library, and the build/test tooling is Node.js-based.
en.hot: As one of the most complete open-source x86 emulators for the browser, it has accumulated 23,528 stars, adding 8 more today and ranking 4th on the JavaScript daily trending list, long regarded as a benchmark for web-based virtualization and retro computing.
uses: Retro-computing fans who want to run or demo old systems (Windows 95/98, DOS, Haiku) in a web page
Developers who need to embed an x86 VM in a web app for online labs or teaching demos
Engineers and students studying JIT compilation, WebAssembly and CPU emulation
Security researchers who want to safely run untrusted binaries or sandbox experiments in the browser

zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 1.91+，依赖 SlateDB 做持久化、SuiteSparse GraphBLAS 做稀疏遍历，支持 S3 兼容对象存储、Neo4j Bolt 5.x 驱动与 HTTPS JSON/NDJSON API，采用 AGPL-3.0 许可。
zh.hot: 它以“对象存储上的图数据库”这一新颖架构切中云原生图计算痛点，今日新增 1344 star 冲上 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 1 名，总 star 达 5906，热度极高。
uses: 需要云原生、低成本图数据库的架构师与后端工程师

en.tag: A Rust distributed graph database built on object storage
en.what: HydraDB is an object-store-native distributed graph database written in Rust, keeping durable graph data on S3-compatible object storage with fully disaggregated storage and compute. It offers snapshot-consistent OpenCypher queries, GraphBLAS traversal, Neo4j-compatible Bolt connectivity, and an HTTPS query API.
en.content: The repo contains two compute roles (graph-node and graph-indexer), a SlateDB storage layer, an OpenCypher query engine, GraphBLAS traversal, Bolt/HTTP interfaces, plus container images, OpenCypher TCK tests, and live benchmark setup.
en.stack: Built in Rust 1.91+, it relies on SlateDB for durability and SuiteSparse GraphBLAS for sparse traversal, supports S3-compatible object storage, Neo4j Bolt 5.x drivers, and HTTPS JSON/NDJSON APIs, under AGPL-3.0.
en.hot: Its novel "graph database on object storage" architecture addresses cloud-native graph computing pain points, and with 1,344 stars added today it tops the GitHub Trending Rust daily chart, reaching 5,906 total stars.
uses: Architects and backend engineers needing a cloud-native, low-cost graph database
Teams using the Neo4j ecosystem looking to move to an object-storage approach

en.tag: Windows taskbar widget that tracks usage limits and reset times for Claude Code and other AI coding tools
en.what: A lightweight open-source Windows taskbar widget that displays Claude Code usage limits and reset countdowns in real time, while also supporting Codex, Cursor, Grok Build and other AI coding services. It lets developers keep an eye on quota consumption without opening a browser or terminal.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust source for the Windows desktop app, WinGet packaging, a user guide (USER_GUIDE.md), a changelog (CHANGELOG.md), theme customization and updater verification docs, plus a demo GIF.
en.stack: Built in Rust for Windows 10/11 and distributed via WinGet; it reads usage through local provider credentials (CLI, desktop app, or WSL) and collects no telemetry.
en.hot: As usage limits become common in AI coding tools like Claude Code, developers need convenient quota monitoring; the project hit 532 stars with 10 added today, ranking 16th on the Rust daily trending list.
uses: Developers who heavily use Claude Code or Codex and need to check remaining quota at a glance
Users subscribed to multiple AI coding services who want unified usage monitoring
Windows users who prefer a lightweight, telemetry-free taskbar widget

zh.tag: 让 34 种编码代理共享同一份本地记忆的 Go 二进制
zh.what: deja-vu 直接索引磁盘上 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Copilot CLI 等 34 种编码代理已经写下的会话历史，把其中一个代理解决过的问题，在任意其他代理提问时原样还回去。它不需要 LLM、不需要 embedding、也没有采集步骤，装好即满血，连安装之前几个月的旧会话也能被检索到。
zh.content: 一个本地 Go 二进制加 MCP 服务，仓库内含检索基准测试工具（LongMemEval-S、LoCoMo 的 harness 随仓库发布）、安全模型文档 docs/SECURITY-MODEL.md 以及使用指南站点。
zh.stack: 主语言 Go，以本地二进制 + MCP 协议接入各代理；无模型、无向量库依赖，索引时剥离密钥与 token，毫秒级检索 GB 级历史。
zh.hot: 上线不久即破千星、今日 +39 并冲上 Go 日榜第 3，因为它戳中了多代理用户共同的痛点——同一个 bug 在不同代理里被反复重调，而它用零成本、零隐私外泄的本地方案解决，还给出 58% token 节省、88.1% hit@1 的硬指标。
uses: 同时使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等多个编码代理的开发者，想打通彼此的会话记忆
长期与 AI 结对编程、希望复用几个月前已解决问题的人
关注本地优先、无云端上传与隐私合规的团队
想研究或复现记忆检索基准（LongMemEval-S / LoCoMo）的工程师

en.tag: One shared local memory for 34 coding agents, in a single Go binary
en.what: deja-vu indexes the session history that Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI and 30 other coding agents have already written to disk, and hands the right past session back to whichever agent asks. No LLM, no embeddings, no capture step: it starts full, including months of sessions from before you installed it.
en.content: A local Go binary plus an MCP server, shipping the retrieval benchmark harnesses (LongMemEval-S and LoCoMo) in-repo, a docs/SECURITY-MODEL.md, and a companion guide site.
en.stack: Written in Go, exposed as a local binary and MCP server; no model or vector store dependencies, strips keys and tokens while indexing, and does millisecond lookups over gigabytes of history.
en.hot: It crossed 1,000 stars fast, gained 39 today and hit #3 on the Go daily trending list, because it solves a pain every multi-agent user shares — the same bug re-debugged in a different agent — locally and for free, backed by hard numbers like 58% fewer tokens and 88.1% hit@1.
uses: Developers running several coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) who want their memories to interoperate
Anyone pairing with AI long-term who wants fixes from months ago to resurface
Teams that need local-first, no-upload, privacy-conscious tooling
Engineers who want to study or reproduce memory-retrieval benchmarks like LongMemEval-S and LoCoMo

zh.tag: 生产级容器编排与集群管理的事实标准
zh.what: Kubernetes（K8s）是一个开源系统，用于跨多台主机管理容器化应用，提供部署、维护与扩缩容的基础机制。它源自 Google 十五年大规模生产经验（Borg 系统），并融合了社区最佳实践，现由 CNCF 托管。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kubernetes 核心控制平面与节点组件源码（apiserver、kubelet、scheduler、controller-manager 等）、命令行工具 kubectl、测试套件、文档与构建脚本，并含 staging 目录用于发布可复用的库组件。
zh.stack: 以 Go 语言开发，依赖 etcd 作为集群状态存储，使用容器运行时接口（CRI）对接 Docker/containerd 等，构建依赖 Go 工具链或 Docker 环境（make / make quick-release）。
zh.hot: 作为云原生领域的基石项目，K8s 长期稳居 GitHub 最受关注仓库之列，累计 127,840 颗星，本周再增 574 星并进入 Go 语言周榜第 19 名，热度源于其不可替代的行业地位与持续活跃的社区贡献。
uses: 平台与 DevOps 工程师：用于搭建和管理生产级容器集群
云原生应用开发者：借助 K8s API 部署、扩缩容与运维微服务
企业架构师：评估多云/混合云容器编排与标准化方案
开源贡献者：参与核心组件开发、文档与社区治理

en.tag: The de facto standard for production-grade container orchestration and cluster management
en.what: Kubernetes (K8s) is an open source system for managing containerized applications across multiple hosts, providing the basic mechanisms for deployment, maintenance, and scaling. It builds on a decade and a half of Google's production experience with Borg, combined with community best practices, and is hosted by the CNCF.
en.content: The repo contains the source for Kubernetes core control plane and node components (apiserver, kubelet, scheduler, controller-manager, etc.), the kubectl CLI, test suites, docs, build scripts, and a staging directory for publishing reusable library components.
en.stack: Written in Go, it relies on etcd for cluster state, uses the Container Runtime Interface (CRI) to integrate with Docker/containerd and others, and builds via a Go toolchain or Docker environment (make / make quick-release).
en.hot: As the cornerstone of cloud native, K8s remains one of GitHub's most-starred repos with 127,840 stars, adding 574 this week to rank 19th on the Go trending weekly list, driven by its irreplaceable industry role and a continuously active community.
uses: Platform and DevOps engineers: build and operate production-grade container clusters
Cloud native developers: deploy, scale, and operate microservices via the K8s API
Enterprise architects: evaluate multi-cloud/hybrid container orchestration and standardization
Open source contributors: work on core components, docs, and community governance

zh.tag: 开源自主渗透测试AI集群，支持漏洞利用与报告
zh.what: Pentest Swarm AI 是一个基于 Go 语言构建的开源自主渗透测试工具，利用多个 AI 代理组成的集群进行侦察、分类、漏洞利用和报告。它支持漏洞赏金、持续监控和 CTF 模式，旨在以机器速度发现并证明真实漏洞。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 源代码、文档、演示 GIF 和横幅，核心是协调多个 AI 代理的集群架构，集成 7 种以上原生安全工具，并提供 CLI 界面。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 Go 1.24、ReAct 推理框架、Claude 或 Ollama 等 AI 模型，以及 7 种以上原生安全工具，采用 AGPL 3.0 许可证。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 34 颗星，总星数达 2621，登上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 5 名，因其作为开源 XBOW 替代品和创新的 AI 集群渗透测试方法而受到关注。
uses: 渗透测试人员 —— 自动化漏洞发现与利用，提高测试效率
漏洞赏金猎人 —— 在漏洞赏金项目中快速识别和验证漏洞
红队成员 —— 模拟攻击以评估安全防御，支持持续监控模式
安全研究人员 —— 研究 AI 在渗透测试中的应用，支持 CTF 模式

en.tag: Open-source autonomous pentesting AI swarm with exploitation and reporting
en.what: Pentest Swarm AI is an open-source autonomous penetration testing tool built in Go that uses a swarm of AI agents for reconnaissance, classification, exploitation, and reporting. It supports bug bounty, continuous monitoring, and CTF modes, aiming to discover and prove real vulnerabilities at machine speed.
en.content: The repository contains Go source code, documentation, demo GIFs, and banners, with a core swarm architecture coordinating multiple AI agents, integrating 7+ native security tools, and offering a CLI interface.
en.stack: Tech stack includes Go 1.24, ReAct reasoning framework, AI models like Claude or Ollama, and 7+ native security tools, under AGPL 3.0 license.
en.hot: The project gained 34 stars today, reaching 2,621 total stars and ranking 5th on GitHub Trending (Go daily), attracting attention as an open-source XBOW alternative with an innovative AI swarm approach to pentesting.
uses: Penetration testers — automate vulnerability discovery and exploitation to improve efficiency
Bug bounty hunters — quickly identify and validate vulnerabilities in bug bounty programs
Red teamers — simulate attacks to assess security defenses, with continuous monitoring mode
Security researchers — study AI applications in pentesting, with CTF mode support

zh.tag: Datadog 官方监控 Agent 主仓库，采集指标、日志与链路数据
zh.what: 这是 Datadog Agent v6/v7 的官方源码仓库，负责在主机、容器和云环境中采集指标、日志、链路追踪与安全事件。采集到的数据会上报至 Datadog 平台，用于可观测性监控与告警。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Agent 核心代码、各类集成检查（checks）、eBPF 程序、开发者文档目录 doc 以及构建与打包脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，包含 BPF C 代码；依赖 Go 工具链与 Datadog 自研库，用户态组件采用 Apache 2.0 许可，BPF 部分为 GPL v2。
zh.hot: 作为 Datadog 可观测性体系的核心组件，它长期受到运维与 SRE 关注；今日登上 Go 日榜第 6 名，新增 9 star，总 star 数达 3752。
uses: 运维与 SRE 团队：部署 Agent 采集主机与容器指标，接入 Datadog 监控告警
云原生平台工程师：通过 eBPF 与集成检查实现深度可观测性
开发者与贡献者：基于该仓库开发自定义检查或参与 Agent 功能开发

en.tag: The main repository for the Datadog Agent, collecting metrics, logs and traces
en.what: This is the official source repository for Datadog Agent v6/v7, which collects metrics, logs, traces and security events from hosts, containers and cloud environments. The collected data is sent to the Datadog platform for observability monitoring and alerting.
en.content: The repo contains the Agent core code, integration checks, eBPF programs, the developer doc directory, and build/packaging scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go with BPF C code; it relies on the Go toolchain and Datadog's own libraries. User-space components are Apache 2.0 licensed, while BPF code is GPL v2.
en.hot: As the core component of Datadog's observability stack, it draws steady attention from ops and SRE teams; today it ranked 6th on the Go daily trending list with 9 new stars, reaching 3,752 total stars.
uses: Ops and SRE teams: deploy the Agent to collect host and container metrics and feed Datadog monitoring/alerting
Cloud-native platform engineers: achieve deep observability via eBPF and integration checks
Developers and contributors: build custom checks or contribute to Agent features based on this repo

zh.tag: 微软出品的 JavaScript 超集，为大型应用加上可选类型
zh.what: TypeScript 是 JavaScript 的超集，在 JS 之上加入可选的静态类型系统，并编译输出干净、可读、符合标准的 JavaScript。它面向任意浏览器、任意宿主、任意操作系统的大型 JavaScript 应用，提供类型检查与工具支持。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编译器与语言服务的完整源码、测试用例、语言规范与文档，并附带贡献指南、路线图以及 npm 发布配置。
zh.stack: 项目主体用 TypeScript 自举实现，构建与工具链基于 Node.js，通过 npm 发布 typescript 包，并提供 nightly 版本 typescript@next。
zh.hot: 作为前端与 Node 生态的基石项目，它已累积 111,206 颗星，今日再增 26 星，稳居 GitHub Trending 日榜 Go 分类第 7 名。
uses: 前端与 Node.js 开发者，用类型系统提升大型项目可维护性
团队协作场景，通过静态类型在编译期提前发现错误
库与框架作者，为使用者提供更友好的类型定义与提示
学习静态类型语言与编译器实现原理的工程师

en.tag: Microsoft's typed superset of JavaScript for application-scale development
en.what: TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript that adds optional static typing and compiles to clean, readable, standards-based JavaScript. It targets application-scale JavaScript for any browser, any host, and any OS, with tooling support for large codebases.
en.content: The repo holds the full source of the TypeScript compiler and language service, along with tests, language specs, docs, contribution guidelines, a roadmap, and npm publishing setup.
en.stack: The project is self-hosted in TypeScript, with a Node.js-based build and toolchain, distributed via the npm package typescript and a nightly build typescript@next.
en.hot: As a cornerstone of the frontend and Node ecosystem, it has accumulated 111,206 stars, gaining 26 more today and ranking 7th on GitHub Trending's daily Go list.
uses: Frontend and Node.js developers improving maintainability of large projects with types
Teams wanting static typing to catch errors at compile time
Library and framework authors shipping better type definitions and IntelliSense
Engineers studying static type systems and compiler implementation

zh.tag: 支持 S3、POSIX 与 Iceberg 的分布式存储系统，单机可扛数十亿文件
zh.what: SeaweedFS 是一个简单且高度可扩展的分布式文件系统，目标是存储数十亿文件并快速提供访问。单个 weed 二进制即可同时提供 S3 对象存储、POSIX 文件系统和基于 S3 Tables 的湖仓能力，所有数据共享同一份底层存储。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心服务与命令行工具（weed），以及 Docker、Helm/Kubernetes 部署配置、客户端 SDK（Java/Maven 等）、白皮书与 Wiki 文档。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，提供 Docker 镜像、Helm Chart 与 Maven 客户端；支持 S3 API、POSIX 挂载、Iceberg 表格式以及云存储分层缓存。
zh.hot: 34,651 颗星、本月新增 628，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Go 第 20 名；在对象存储与湖仓一体需求上升的背景下，其 O(1) 磁盘访问和横向扩展能力持续吸引关注。
uses: 需要自建 S3 兼容对象存储、替代 MinIO 的团队与运维工程师
为海量小文件、图片、视频等场景寻找高吞吐存储后端的开发者
希望用同一套存储同时支撑文件系统与 Iceberg 湖仓的数据平台团队
在 Kubernetes 上部署有状态存储、关注水平扩展与云分层缓存的架构师

en.tag: Distributed storage for S3, POSIX and Iceberg tables, scaling to billions of files
en.what: SeaweedFS is a simple, highly scalable distributed file system built to store billions of files and serve them fast. A single weed binary provides an S3 object store, a POSIX file system, and a lakehouse with S3 Tables, all over the same data.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based core services and the weed CLI, plus Docker and Helm/Kubernetes deployment configs, client SDKs (Java/Maven, etc.), whitepapers and wiki docs.
en.stack: Written in Go, shipped with Docker images, Helm charts and a Maven client; supports the S3 API, POSIX mounts, Iceberg table format, and cloud storage tiering/caching.
en.hot: With 34,651 stars and 628 added this month, it ranks 20th on GitHub's monthly Go trending list; as object storage and lakehouse needs grow, its O(1) disk access and horizontal scaling keep drawing attention.
uses: Teams and SREs building self-hosted S3-compatible object storage as a MinIO alternative
Developers needing a high-throughput storage backend for massive small files, images or videos
Data platform teams wanting one storage layer for both file systems and Iceberg lakehouse tables
Architects deploying stateful storage on Kubernetes with horizontal scaling and cloud tiering in mind

zh.tag: 基于 GitOps 的应用生命周期编排与渐进式发布平台
zh.what: Kargo 是 Akuity（Argo 的创建团队）推出的应用生命周期编排工具，基于 GitOps 原则管理和自动化软件制品在多个环境阶段间的晋级与发布。它把从开发、测试到生产的推广流程抽象为可声明、可观测的流水线，让部署晋级像代码一样被版本化和审查。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的控制器与 API 服务、基于 React 的 Web UI（ui/ 目录，含 Kargo Dashboard 界面），以及 docs/ 文档站点和 CI、Netlify 部署配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 开发，配合 Kubernetes CRD 与控制器模式，前端为 React/TypeScript，文档基于静态站点生成器并部署在 Netlify。
zh.hot: 作为 Argo 团队的新作，Kargo 已积累约 3.7k stars，今日登上 GitHub Go 语言日榜第 9 名，反映出社区对 GitOps 多阶段发布方案的强烈关注。
uses: 使用 Argo CD 等 GitOps 工具、需要管理多环境晋级流程的 Kubernetes 平台团队
希望把测试到生产的发布过程声明化、可审计的 DevOps/SRE 工程师
需要渐进式发布与制品推广编排的中大型研发组织

en.tag: GitOps-driven application lifecycle orchestration and progressive delivery platform
en.what: Kargo is an application lifecycle orchestration tool from Akuity, the creators of Argo, that manages and automates the promotion of software artifacts through the many stages of their lifecycle using GitOps principles. It turns promotion from dev to test to production into declarative, observable pipelines that are versioned and reviewed like code.
en.content: The repo contains Go-based controllers and API services, a React web UI (ui/ directory with the Kargo Dashboard), plus a docs/ site and CI/Netlify deployment configuration.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go with Kubernetes CRDs and controller patterns, a React/TypeScript frontend, and docs built with a static site generator deployed on Netlify.
en.hot: As a new project from the Argo team, Kargo has gathered about 3.7k stars and hit #9 on GitHub's daily Go trending list, reflecting strong community interest in GitOps multi-stage delivery.
uses: Kubernetes platform teams using Argo CD and other GitOps tools that need multi-environment promotion workflows
DevOps/SRE engineers who want declarative, auditable promotion from test to production
Mid-to-large engineering orgs needing progressive delivery and artifact promotion orchestration

zh.tag: 开源应用防火墙，拦截大规模监控、守护桌面隐私
zh.what: Portmaster 是一款免费开源的应用防火墙与隐私套件，面向 Windows 和 Linux 桌面。它在原始数据包层面拦截所有网络流量，自动屏蔽追踪器与恶意软件，并允许用户对每个应用进行精细的联网控制。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Portmaster 核心服务、Electron 桌面 UI、通知组件以及各平台的内核驱动与网络拦截模块，另附安装脚本、构建配置和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，Linux 端依赖 nfqueue 与 eBPF，Windows 端使用 WFP 内核驱动和 IP Helper API；UI 目前基于 Electron。
zh.hot: 凭借 13814 颗星和今日 15 颗新增登上 Go 日榜第 10，隐私与反监控话题持续升温，加上欧盟开发背景和媒体推荐，让它保持热度。
uses: 注重隐私、希望阻止追踪与监控的普通桌面用户
需要按应用精细控制联网权限的高级用户与开发者
在 Windows 或 Linux 上搭建安全网络环境的技术爱好者
关注开源安全工具、想审计网络流量的研究人员

en.tag: Open-source application firewall that blocks mass surveillance and protects desktop privacy
en.what: Portmaster is a free and open-source application firewall and privacy suite for Windows and Linux desktops. It intercepts traffic at the raw packet level, automatically blocks trackers and malware, and lets users control network access per app in fine detail.
en.content: The repo contains the Portmaster core service, an Electron desktop UI, a notifier component, plus per-platform kernel drivers and network interception modules, along with install scripts, build configs and docs.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, it relies on nfqueue and eBPF on Linux and a WFP kernel driver plus the IP Helper API on Windows; the UI currently uses Electron.
en.hot: With 13,814 stars and 15 added today, it ranks 10th on the Go daily trending list, fueled by growing privacy concerns, its EU-based development and media coverage.
uses: Everyday desktop users who care about privacy and want to block tracking and surveillance
Power users and developers needing fine-grained per-app network control
Tech enthusiasts building a secure network setup on Windows or Linux
Researchers and security folks who want to audit traffic with an open-source tool

zh.tag: 通用代理平台，一站式网络代理工具箱
zh.what: sing-box 是一个用 Go 编写的通用代理平台，把多种代理协议、路由规则和入站出站能力统一到一个内核里。它既能当客户端也能当服务端，覆盖从个人翻墙到自建节点分发的常见需求。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 源码为主体，包含协议实现、配置解析、路由引擎与多平台构建脚本，配套文档托管在 sing-box.sagernet.org。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，采用模块化协议抽象与 JSON 配置，依赖较少，可交叉编译到 Linux、macOS、Windows、Android 与 iOS。
zh.hot: 作为新一代代理内核，它凭统一配置和活跃维护积累了 38092 颗星，本月再增 1147，稳居 Go 月榜第 17 名。
uses: 需要统一管理多种代理协议的自建节点用户
希望用单一内核替代多款代理客户端的进阶玩家
在路由器或服务器上部署透明代理的网络爱好者
关注代理内核实现、想二次开发或集成的开发者

en.tag: The universal proxy platform for all-in-one network proxying
en.what: sing-box is a universal proxy platform written in Go that unifies multiple proxy protocols, routing rules, and inbound/outbound capabilities into a single core. It works as both client and server, covering everything from personal circumvention to self-hosted node distribution.
en.content: The repo is mainly Go source code with protocol implementations, config parsing, a routing engine, and multi-platform build scripts, with docs hosted at sing-box.sagernet.org.
en.stack: Primarily Go with a modular protocol abstraction and JSON configuration, minimal dependencies, cross-compilable to Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, and iOS.
en.hot: As a next-gen proxy core, its unified config and active maintenance have earned 38,092 stars, adding 1,147 this month and ranking 17th on the Go monthly trending list.
uses: Self-hosted node users who need to manage multiple proxy protocols in one place
Advanced users wanting a single core to replace several proxy clients
Network enthusiasts deploying transparent proxies on routers or servers
Developers interested in proxy core internals for integration or forks

zh.tag: 谷歌官方云原生微服务电商示例，11 个服务演示 K8s、Istio 与 gRPC
