zh.stack: 技术栈为 C/C++ 与 ggml 张量库，无外部依赖，可编译为独立可执行文件；支持 CPU 及多种后端加速。
zh.hot: 凭借 7246 星、日增 36 星登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 14 名，其持续 Day-0/Day-1 跟进 Qwen-Image、Flux、Wan 等新模型，让本地低配设备也能跑扩散模型，是热度主因。
uses: 想在本地或离线环境运行扩散模型、注重隐私与零依赖的开发者
需要在 C/C++ 项目中集成图像/视频生成能力的工程师
关注 ggml/llama.cpp 生态、希望复现轻量推理方案的研究者
在低配硬件或边缘设备上部署 AI 生成功能的爱好者

en.tag: Pure C/C++ diffusion inference engine for many model families
en.what: stable-diffusion.cpp implements diffusion model inference in pure C/C++, covering Stable Diffusion, Flux, Wan, Qwen Image, Z-Image and more image/video generation models. Built on ggml and modeled after llama.cpp, it aims for lightweight, dependency-free local deployment.
en.content: The repo contains the C/C++ inference core, a CLI tool, an embedded web UI, plus per-model docs (sd.md, flux.md, qwen_image.md, etc.) and assets.
en.stack: Tech stack is C/C++ with the ggml tensor library, no external dependencies, compilable into a standalone binary; supports CPU and multiple acceleration backends.
en.hot: With 7,246 stars and +36 today, it ranks #14 on GitHub Trending; its continuous Day-0/Day-1 support for new models like Qwen-Image, Flux and Wan lets low-end local devices run diffusion models, driving its popularity.
uses: Developers who want to run diffusion models locally or offline with privacy and zero dependencies
Engineers integrating image/video generation into C/C++ projects
Researchers following the ggml/llama.cpp ecosystem and lightweight inference
Hobbyists deploying AI generation on low-end or edge hardware

zh.tag: 跨厂商 3D 高斯泼溅训练器：视频一键转 splat 与网格
zh.what: Spirula Studio 是一个自包含的 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）训练工具，能把原始照片或视频一路处理成 splat 模型和带纹理网格。它内置 SfM、AI 遮罩和视频抽帧，无需安装 Python/PyTorch 或单独的 COLMAP。
zh.content: 仓库以 C++ 源码为主，附带预编译的 Windows/Linux/macOS 发布包、示例画廊和在线 Web 查看器，并包含数据集创建、训练、网格化等模块。
zh.stack: 核心用 C++ 编写，通过 Vulkan 计算着色器实现跨厂商 GPU 支持，也提供 CUDA 路径；不依赖 Python/PyTorch，采用 GPLv3 许可。
zh.hot: 上线不久即获约 981 星、单日新增 257 星，登上 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 2，靠的是免配置、跨 GPU 和 8GB 显存训 10M 高斯的高效率。
uses: 3D 重建/NeRF 研究者与工程师，想快速从视频训练高斯泼溅模型
独立开发者或小团队，需要免 Python 环境、跨 NVIDIA/AMD/Intel/Apple GPU 的 3DGS 管线
VR/AR 与数字孪生从业者，处理 360° 或鱼眼相机数据并导出网格
内容创作者，希望把普通视频转成可交互的 3D 场景并在线展示

en.tag: Cross-vendor 3D Gaussian Splatting trainer: video to splat to mesh
en.what: Spirula Studio is a self-contained 3D Gaussian Splatting trainer that takes raw photos or video all the way to splat models and textured meshes. It bundles SfM, AI masking and video frame extraction, so no Python/PyTorch or separate COLMAP install is needed.
en.content: The repo is primarily C++ source code, with prebuilt Windows/Linux/macOS releases, a gallery, an online web viewer, and modules for dataset creation, training and meshing.
en.stack: Written in C++ with Vulkan compute shaders for cross-vendor GPU support and an optional CUDA path; it avoids Python/PyTorch and is GPLv3-licensed.
en.hot: It quickly reached ~981 stars with 257 added in a day, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending's C++ daily list, thanks to zero-config setup, cross-GPU support and training 10M Gaussians in 8GB VRAM.
uses: 3D reconstruction/NeRF researchers and engineers who want to train Gaussian Splatting models from video quickly
Indie developers or small teams needing a Python-free, cross-vendor (NVIDIA/AMD/Intel/Apple) 3DGS pipeline
VR/AR and digital-twin practitioners working with 360° or fisheye footage and exporting meshes
Content creators who want to turn ordinary video into interactive 3D scenes and showcase them online

zh.tag: 开源机器人仿真器，建模、编程与仿真一站式环境
zh.what: Webots 是一个开源机器人仿真器，提供完整开发环境，用于对机器人、车辆和机械系统进行建模、编程与仿真。它面向初学者设计，帮助新手快速进入机器人领域，支持多种传感器与执行器的实时可视化。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 编写的仿真内核、跨平台构建脚本、示例世界与机器人模型，以及用户指南和参考手册等文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，提供 Linux、Windows、macOS 预编译二进制包，并支持从源码编译；依赖图形渲染与物理引擎等组件。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源机器人仿真器，Webots 拥有约 4.7k stars，今日新增 5 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 第 3 名，持续受到机器人教育与研究社区关注。
uses: 机器人初学者与教育工作者，用于教学演示和入门实践
高校与研究机构，用于机器人算法仿真验证与原型开发
自动驾驶与车辆工程团队，用于车辆和机械系统仿真测试
开发者与爱好者，用于构建自定义机器人模型和仿真场景

en.tag: Open-source robot simulator with a complete modeling, programming and simulation environment
en.what: Webots is an open-source robot simulator offering a complete development environment to model, program and simulate robots, vehicles and mechanical systems. It is beginner friendly and designed to introduce newcomers to robotics, with real-time visualization of sensors and actuators.
en.content: The repository contains the C++ simulation core, cross-platform build scripts, sample worlds and robot models, plus user guide and reference documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with pre-compiled binaries for Linux, Windows and macOS and support for building from source; it relies on graphics rendering and physics engine components.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source robot simulator, Webots has about 4.7k stars, gained 5 today and ranks 3rd on GitHub Trending daily for C++, keeping strong attention from robotics education and research communities.
uses: Robotics beginners and educators for teaching demos and hands-on practice
Universities and research institutes for simulating and validating robot algorithms and prototypes
Autonomous driving and vehicle engineering teams for vehicle and mechanical system simulation testing
Developers and hobbyists building custom robot models and simulation scenarios

zh.tag: 自托管 VPN 客户端，一键在自己服务器上部署 VPN
zh.what: Amnezia 是一款开源 VPN 客户端，核心特色是让你把 VPN 服务器部署在自己的服务器上，只需输入 IP、SSH 登录名和密码即可自动安装并连接。它同时支持桌面端和移动端，并提供多种带流量混淆的协议以应对网络封锁。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面端与移动端的客户端源码，以及用于在服务器上自动部署 VPN 容器的脚本与配置，附带多语言 README、构建工作流和发布包。
zh.stack: 主语言为 C++，基于 Qt 构建跨平台客户端，集成 OpenVPN、WireGuard、IKEv2、Cloak、Shadowsocks、AmneziaWG、XRay 等协议，并通过 Docker 在服务器端部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 15199 颗星和今日 +20 的热度，它切中了用户对自托管、抗审查 VPN 的强烈需求，且一键部署大幅降低了自建 VPN 的门槛。
uses: 希望自建 VPN 服务器、掌控数据的隐私敏感用户
身处网络审查环境、需要流量混淆协议绕过封锁的用户
想用 Docker 快速部署 VPN 但不想手动配置的技术爱好者
需要桌面与移动端统一 VPN 方案的个人或小团队

en.tag: Self-hosted VPN client that deploys a VPN server on your own machine
en.what: Amnezia is an open-source VPN client whose key feature is deploying your own VPN server on your own machine—just enter the IP, SSH login and password and it auto-installs and connects. It ships for desktop and mobile and offers several traffic-obfuscation protocols to resist blocking.
en.content: The repo contains the desktop and mobile client source code plus scripts/configs that auto-deploy VPN containers on your server, along with multilingual READMEs, CI workflows and release builds.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++ with Qt for cross-platform clients, integrating OpenVPN, WireGuard, IKEv2, Cloak, Shadowsocks, AmneziaWG and XRay, with Docker-based server-side deployment.
en.hot: With 15,199 stars and +20 today, it hits the strong demand for self-hosted, censorship-resistant VPNs while one-click deployment lowers the barrier to running your own server.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want to self-host a VPN server and own their data
Users in censored regions who need obfuscated protocols to bypass blocking
Tech enthusiasts who want Docker-based VPN deployment without manual setup
Individuals or small teams needing a unified desktop and mobile VPN solution

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 的 JSON 解析与序列化事实标准库
zh.what: nlohmann/json 是一个为现代 C++（C++11 及以上）设计的 JSON 库，提供直观的语法来解析、生成和操作 JSON 数据。它让 JSON 在 C++ 中像使用 STL 容器一样自然，支持序列化、反序列化及与自定义类型的互转。
zh.content: 仓库包含单头文件 include/nlohmann/json.hpp、完整的文档站点（docs/）、测试套件、CMake 构建脚本以及大量示例和第三方集成配置。
zh.stack: 纯 C++11 实现，仅依赖标准库，无外部依赖；提供 CMake 集成，支持包管理器（如 vcpkg、Conan、Homebrew）安装。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 生态中最受欢迎的 JSON 库，已积累超过 5 万 star，今日新增 13 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 7 名，足见其持久影响力和广泛采用。
uses: C++ 开发者需要解析或生成 JSON 数据时
项目中需要轻量级、无依赖的 JSON 处理方案
希望以类似 STL 的语法操作 JSON 的团队
需要跨平台、高可移植性 JSON 库的嵌入式或桌面应用

en.tag: The de facto JSON library for modern C++
en.what: nlohmann/json is a JSON library for modern C++ (C++11 and later) that offers intuitive syntax for parsing, generating, and manipulating JSON. It makes JSON feel as natural as STL containers, supporting serialization, deserialization, and conversion to/from custom types.
en.content: The repository contains a single-header include/nlohmann/json.hpp, a full documentation site (docs/), test suites, CMake build scripts, and numerous examples and third-party integration configs.
en.stack: Pure C++11 implementation with only standard library dependencies; offers CMake integration and is available via package managers like vcpkg, Conan, and Homebrew.
en.hot: As the most popular JSON library in the C++ ecosystem, it has accumulated over 50k stars, with 13 new stars today and ranking 7th on the C++ daily trending list, demonstrating its lasting impact and widespread adoption.
uses: C++ developers who need to parse or generate JSON data
Projects requiring a lightweight, dependency-free JSON solution
Teams wanting STL-like syntax for JSON manipulation
Embedded or desktop applications needing a cross-platform, highly portable JSON library

zh.tag: Windows 平台经典免费开源文本与代码编辑器
zh.what: Notepad++ 是一款运行于 Windows 的免费开源源代码编辑器，也是系统记事本的替代品，支持多种编程语言与自然语言。它基于 GPL 许可证发布，强调「自由言论」与「免费啤酒」双重意义上的自由。
zh.content: 仓库为 Notepad++ 官方源码库，包含 C++ 实现的核心编辑器、构建脚本、GPG 发布公钥、构建指南 BUILD.md、贡献规则 CONTRIBUTING.md 及支持系统说明等文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，面向 MS Windows 环境，依赖 Win32 API 与 Scintilla 编辑组件，通过 GitHub Actions 进行 CI 构建，并使用 GPG 对发布版本签名。
zh.hot: 作为拥有近 3 万 star 的老牌编辑器，它今日仍登上 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 6 名，说明这款经典工具在开发者中保持着长期而稳定的关注度。
uses: Windows 用户需要一个轻量、启动快的记事本替代品
开发者做日常文本编辑、查看日志或临时改代码
学生和运维人员处理配置文件、脚本等纯文本任务
希望使用免费开源软件、可自行编译的进阶用户

en.tag: The classic free, open-source text and code editor for Windows
en.what: Notepad++ is a free, open-source source code editor and Notepad replacement for Windows, supporting many programming and natural languages. Released under the GPL, it is free in both the 'free speech' and 'free beer' senses.
en.content: The repo is the official Notepad++ source tree, containing the C++ editor core, build scripts, the GPG release public key, plus docs like BUILD.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and SUPPORTED_SYSTEM.md.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++ for MS Windows, it relies on the Win32 API and the Scintilla editing component, uses GitHub Actions for CI builds, and signs releases with GPG.
en.hot: With nearly 29.4k stars, this veteran editor still hit #6 on GitHub Trending's daily C++ list, showing the lasting, steady attention a classic tool keeps among developers.
uses: Windows users wanting a lightweight, fast Notepad replacement
Developers doing daily text editing, log viewing, or quick code tweaks
Students and ops staff handling config files, scripts, and plain text
Advanced users who prefer free, open-source software they can build themselves

zh.tag: 明日方舟全日常一键托管助手，基于图像识别
zh.what: MAA 是一款《明日方舟》游戏小助手，基于图像识别技术，一键完成全部日常任务，如理智作战、基建换班、自动公招等。支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 等多个平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 核心代码、多语言接口（C, Python, Java, Rust, Golang 等）、详细的文档（多语言）、资源文件以及构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++20 开发，依赖图像识别库（如 OpenCV），提供多种编程语言接口，支持跨平台构建。
zh.hot: 该项目拥有 23,449 个 Star，今日新增 17 个，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 分类第 7 名，因其强大的自动化功能和活跃的社区而备受关注。
uses: 《明日方舟》玩家 —— 自动化日常任务，节省时间
开发者 —— 通过多语言接口集成或扩展功能
技术爱好者 —— 学习图像识别和自动化技术

en.tag: A one-click daily task assistant for Arknights, powered by image recognition.
en.what: MAA is an assistant tool for the game Arknights, using image recognition to automate daily tasks like sanity farming, base management, and recruitment. It supports Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.content: The repository contains C++ core code, multi-language APIs (C, Python, Java, Rust, Golang, etc.), detailed documentation (multilingual), resource files, and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++20, depends on image recognition libraries (e.g., OpenCV), provides APIs for multiple programming languages, and supports cross-platform builds.
en.hot: With 23,449 stars and 17 new stars today, it ranks 7th on GitHub Trending (C++), gaining popularity for its powerful automation and active community.
uses: Arknights players — automate daily tasks and save time
Developers — integrate or extend functionality via multi-language APIs
Tech enthusiasts — learn about image recognition and automation

zh.tag: 谷歌端侧高性能 ML 与 GenAI 推理运行时，TensorFlow Lite 的继任者
zh.what: LiteRT 是 Google 推出的端侧机器学习运行时，作为 TensorFlow Lite 的继任者，专注于在边缘设备上高效部署 ML 与生成式 AI 模型。它通过模型转换、运行时执行与硬件加速优化，让设备端推理更简单、更快速。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心运行时、Tensor API、LiteRT-LM（端侧大模型推理）、LiteRT.js（Web 端推理）以及 LiteRT CLI 等组件，并提供完整的构建脚本与文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，支持 CMake 构建，提供 Linux/macOS/Windows 的 nightly wheel，并集成 GPU/NPU 加速与 WebGPU/WASM 后端。
zh.hot: 作为 TensorFlow Lite 的官方继任者，LiteRT 凭借 Google 背书和端侧 GenAI 部署能力备受关注，目前获得 3439 颗星，今日新增 4 星，位列 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 8 名。
uses: 移动端与嵌入式 AI 开发者 —— 在 Android/iOS 设备上部署高性能 ML 模型
生成式 AI 应用开发者 —— 利用 LiteRT-LM 在端侧运行大语言模型
Web 前端与全栈工程师 —— 通过 LiteRT.js 在浏览器中实现安全客户端推理
AI 代理与工具链构建者 —— 使用 LiteRT CLI 优化编码代理工作流

en.tag: Google's on-device runtime for high-performance ML & GenAI inference, successor to TensorFlow Lite
en.what: LiteRT is Google's on-device machine learning runtime and the successor to TensorFlow Lite, focused on efficient ML and GenAI deployment on edge devices. It simplifies and accelerates on-device inference through model conversion, runtime execution, and hardware acceleration.
en.content: The repository includes the core runtime, Tensor API, LiteRT-LM for on-device LLM inference, LiteRT.js for web inference, and LiteRT CLI, along with build scripts and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ with CMake build support, offering nightly wheels for Linux/macOS/Windows, and integrating GPU/NPU acceleration with WebGPU/WASM backends.
en.hot: As the official successor to TensorFlow Lite, LiteRT garners attention for its Google backing and on-device GenAI capabilities, with 3,439 stars and 4 new stars today, ranking 8th on GitHub Trending for C++.
uses: Mobile and embedded AI developers — deploy high-performance ML models on Android/iOS devices
Generative AI application developers — run large language models on-device with LiteRT-LM
Web frontend and full-stack engineers — enable secure client-side inference in browsers via LiteRT.js
AI agent and toolchain builders — streamline coding agent workflows with LiteRT CLI

zh.tag: AMD ROCm 系统级项目超级仓库，统一开发与 CI
zh.what: 这是 AMD ROCm 生态的系统级项目超级仓库，把原本分散的多个 ROCm 系统组件合并到单一仓库中，以简化开发、持续集成与整合流程。首批项目聚焦于构建 PyTorch 所需的底层依赖。
zh.content: 仓库以子目录形式收纳 amdsmi、aqlprofile、clr、hip、hipfile、rocdecode、rocjpeg、rocm-core、rocminfo、rocm-smi-lib、rocprofiler 等众多组件，并附有迁移状态与 CI 健康度表格。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主，涉及 HIP、ROCm 运行时与性能分析工具链，依赖 CMake 构建系统与 GitHub Actions 做 CI。
zh.hot: 作为 AMD 官方整合 ROCm 系统组件的超级仓库，它关系到 PyTorch 在 AMD 平台上的构建，今日登上 GitHub C++ 日榜第 17 名，累计 510 星。
uses: AMD GPU 开发者，需要构建或调试 ROCm 底层组件
在 AMD 平台上编译 PyTorch 等框架的工程师
关注 ROCm 性能分析与系统工具链的研究人员

en.tag: AMD's ROCm systems super-repo unifying development and CI
en.what: This is AMD's ROCm systems super-repo, consolidating multiple ROCm system projects into a single repository to streamline development, CI, and integration. The first batch of projects focuses on the requirements for building PyTorch.
en.content: It houses components such as amdsmi, aqlprofile, clr, hip, hipfile, rocdecode, rocjpeg, rocm-core, rocminfo, rocm-smi-lib, and rocprofiler as subdirectories, along with a migration-status and CI-health table.
en.stack: Primarily C++, covering HIP, ROCm runtime, and profiling toolchains, built with CMake and CI via GitHub Actions.
en.hot: As AMD's official super-repo consolidating ROCm system components, it matters for building PyTorch on AMD hardware, landing at #17 on GitHub's daily C++ trending with 510 stars.
uses: AMD GPU developers building or debugging ROCm low-level components
Engineers compiling PyTorch and similar frameworks on AMD platforms
Researchers tracking ROCm profiling and system toolchains

zh.tag: 跨平台开源 SDR 软件，主打轻量无臃肿
zh.what: SDR++ 是一款跨平台的开源软件定义无线电（SDR）接收软件，目标是轻量、简洁、易用。它支持多种 SDR 硬件，提供多 VFO、瀑布图与 SIMD 加速的 DSP 处理能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心应用源码、各硬件专用模块（如 RTL-SDR、Airspy 等）、SoapySDR 支持模块以及可扩展的插件系统，附带构建脚本与多平台打包配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SIMD 指令加速 DSP，通过 SoapySDR 及专用模块对接硬件，采用 CMake 构建，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 与 BSD。
zh.hot: 凭借 6368 颗星与今日 C++ 日榜第 10 的名次，SDR++ 因轻量、跨平台且硬件兼容性广而持续受到无线电爱好者关注。
uses: 无线电爱好者与火腿族，用于接收和解调各类无线信号
SDR 硬件玩家，希望用统一软件驱动不同品牌的接收设备
开发者，想基于其模块化架构编写自定义 DSP 或插件
教学与科研场景，用于信号处理与频谱观测实验

en.tag: Cross-platform, open-source SDR software built to be bloat-free
en.what: SDR++ is a cross-platform, open-source software-defined radio (SDR) application designed to be bloat-free and simple to use. It supports a wide range of SDR hardware and offers multi-VFO, waterfall display, and SIMD-accelerated DSP.
en.content: The repo contains the core application source, dedicated hardware modules (e.g., RTL-SDR, Airspy), a SoapySDR support module, an extensible plugin system, plus build scripts and multi-platform packaging configs.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ with SIMD-accelerated DSP, it interfaces with hardware via SoapySDR and dedicated modules, builds with CMake, and runs on Windows, Linux, macOS, and BSD.
en.hot: With 6,368 stars and a #10 spot on today's C++ trending list, SDR++ stays popular among radio enthusiasts for being lightweight, cross-platform, and broadly hardware-compatible.
uses: Radio amateurs and hobbyists receiving and demodulating wireless signals
SDR hardware users wanting one unified app for different receiver brands
Developers building custom DSP or plugins on its modular architecture
Education and research for signal processing and spectrum observation

zh.tag: 用 C++ 编写的跨平台 PlayStation 4 模拟器
zh.what: shadPS4 是一个用 C++ 编写的早期 PlayStation 4 模拟器，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 FreeBSD。它专注于模拟 PS4 主机核心，让玩家能在 PC 上运行《血源诅咒》《如龙 0》等独占游戏。

en.tag: A cross-platform PlayStation 4 emulator written in C++
en.what: shadPS4 is an early PlayStation 4 emulator written in C++ for Windows, Linux, macOS and FreeBSD. It focuses on emulating the PS4 core, letting players run exclusives like Bloodborne and Yakuza 0 on PC.

Tech enthusiasts curious about console emulator internals
Developers looking to contribute code or test game compatibility

zh.tag: Google 官方 C++ 测试与模拟框架
zh.what: GoogleTest 是 Google 的 C++ 测试框架，用于编写和运行单元测试。它支持自动测试发现、丰富的断言、死亡测试、参数化测试等，并集成了 GoogleMock 用于模拟对象。

en.tag: Google's official C++ testing and mocking framework

Learning best practices of xUnit test framework design

zh.tag: 微软官方 Windows 包管理器命令行工具

en.tag: Microsoft's official Windows Package Manager CLI
en.what: WinGet is Microsoft's official Windows Package Manager, offering a CLI client to search, install, upgrade, and uninstall Windows applications. It also ships PowerShell modules and a COM API for scripting and third-party integration.

zh.tag: 面向 ESP32 的 WiFi/蓝牙攻防工具套件
zh.what: ESP32 Marauder 是一套运行在 ESP32 上的 WiFi 与蓝牙安全测试固件，集成了扫描、嗅探、握手包捕获、去认证攻击以及防御性监测等功能。它把常见的无线攻防操作打包成便携设备，让安全研究者在低成本硬件上完成无线网络评估。

en.tag: A WiFi/Bluetooth offensive and defensive toolkit for ESP32
en.what: ESP32 Marauder is a firmware suite for ESP32 that bundles WiFi and Bluetooth security testing tools, including scanning, sniffing, handshake capture, deauthentication attacks, and defensive monitoring. Red/blue team members conducting on-site wireless monitoring and defense validation

zh.tag: 大规模原子分子并行模拟的开源分子动力学引擎
zh.what: LAMMPS 是经典的分子动力学模拟软件，用于在原子尺度上模拟粒子体系，专为在并行计算机上高效运行而设计。它由美国能源部桑迪亚国家实验室开发，采用 GPLv2 开源协议，广泛用于材料、化学、物理与生物领域的原子级仿真。

zh.stack: 核心以 C++ 编写，使用 CMake 构建，支持 MPI 与 OpenMP 并行，并提供 Python 与 Fortran 2003 接口，可选用 CUDA、KOKKOS 等加速后端。
zh.hot: 作为计算材料与分子动力学领域的基石级工具，LAMMPS 拥有约 3070 颗星，此次登上 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 15 名，反映出科研计算社区对开源仿真基础设施的持续关注。

在纳米、生物或软物质领域开展仿真教学与实验的师生

en.tag: Open-source molecular dynamics engine for massively parallel atomistic simulation
en.what: LAMMPS is a classical molecular dynamics simulation code for modeling particle systems at the atomic scale, designed to run efficiently on parallel computers. Developed at Sandia National Laboratories with DOE funding, it is open-source under GPLv2 and widely used for atomistic simulation in materials, chemistry, physics, and biology.
en.content: The repo contains C++ source (src), CMake build files, full documentation (doc), extensive example inputs (examples), interatomic potential files (potentials), Python and Fortran interface modules, bundled third-party libraries, pre/post-processing tools, and CTest-based unit tests.
en.stack: Core is written in C++ and built with CMake, supporting MPI and OpenMP parallelism, with Python and Fortran 2003 interfaces and optional acceleration backends such as CUDA and KOKKOS.
en.hot: As a cornerstone tool in computational materials science and molecular dynamics, LAMMPS has about 3,070 stars and ranked 15th on GitHub Trending's daily C++ list, reflecting sustained interest in open-source simulation infrastructure.
uses: Researchers in computational materials, chemistry, and physics running atomistic simulations
HPC users needing large-scale parallel molecular dynamics
Developers extending LAMMPS with new potentials or commands
Students and instructors teaching nanoscale, biological, or soft-matter simulation

zh.tag: 纯 C++ 音频模型推理引擎，覆盖 TTS/STT/VAD 等
zh.what: audio.cpp 是一个基于 ggml 的高性能纯 C++ 音频推理框架，把 TTS、语音识别、VAD、变声、音乐生成等现代本地音频模型统一到一个原生运行时里。它不依赖 Python，目标是让这些模型在本地跑得又快又便携。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 推理核心、各音频模型家族的 GGUF 支持、WebUI（含 Arena 对比页与 LiveAvatar）、Colab Notebook，以及 GGUF 指南和 Q8 性能报告等文档。
zh.stack: 核心用 C++ 编写，构建在 ggml 之上，支持 CUDA、ROCm、Apple Silicon 与纯 CPU 后端，模型以 GGUF 格式分发。
zh.hot: 它用纯 C++ 替代了动辄几十个 Python 依赖的音频推理栈，CUDA 下部分 TTS 路径比 Python 参考实现快 1.8–8 倍，GGUF Q8 还能提速并省显存，因而快速积累 3030 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 16。

想横向对比多个本地音频模型效果的评测与研究人员

en.tag: A pure C++ inference engine for audio models: TTS, STT, VAD and more
en.what: audio.cpp is a high-performance, pure C++ audio inference framework built on ggml, unifying modern local audio models such as TTS, STT, VAD, voice conversion and music generation into one native runtime. It removes Python dependencies to make these models fast and portable on local machines.
en.content: The repo contains the C++ inference core, GGUF support for multiple model families, a WebUI with an Arena comparison tab and LiveAvatar, a Colab notebook, plus docs such as the GGUF guide and Q8 performance report.
en.stack: Written in C++ on top of ggml, it supports CUDA, ROCm, Apple Silicon and CPU-only backends, with models distributed in GGUF format.
en.hot: It replaces Python-heavy audio inference stacks with pure C++, running some TTS paths 1.8–8x faster than Python references on CUDA while GGUF Q8 cuts VRAM, helping it reach 3,030 stars and rank 16th on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Developers who want to run TTS/ASR/voice-conversion models locally without Python environment hassles
Engineering teams deploying low-latency audio inference on CUDA, Apple Silicon or CPU-only machines
Researchers and evaluators comparing multiple local audio models side by side

zh.tag: NVIDIA 官方高性能 CUDA 线性代数模板库与 Python DSL
zh.what: CUTLASS 是 NVIDIA 官方维护的 CUDA C++ 模板抽象集合，用于在 GPU 上实现高性能矩阵乘法（GEMM）及相关线性代数计算。它把数据搬运与分层并行分解拆解为可复用的模块化组件，支持自定义 tiling、数据类型与算法策略。4.x 版本新增 Python 原生的 CUTLASS DSL（CuTe DSL），让开发者无需深厚 C++ 功底即可编写高性能 CUDA 内核。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 模板头文件库、CuTe 布局与张量抽象、大量示例（examples/）与测试，以及新增的 Python DSL 实现和文档、媒体示意图。
zh.stack: 核心为 C++/CUDA 模板元编程，依赖 CUDA Toolkit 与 CMake 构建；Python DSL 基于 Python 与 CuTe 概念，支持与深度学习框架原生集成。
zh.hot: 作为 NVIDIA 官方 GEMM 基石，它支撑着从 Volta 到 Blackwell 全架构的混合精度与低精度计算，累计 star 已破万（10487），今日再登 C++ 日榜第 12，是 GPU 高性能计算领域的长期刚需项目。
uses: GPU 性能工程师：手写或调优接近 cuBLAS 极限的 GEMM 内核
深度学习框架与算子开发者：为自定义算子接入高效张量核心实现
科研人员与学生：借助 Python DSL 低门槛学习并快速原型化 GPU 内核
量化与低精度推理团队：使用 NVFP4/MXFP 等块缩放数据类型做高效推理

en.tag: NVIDIA's official CUDA template library and Python DSLs for high-performance linear algebra
en.what: CUTLASS is NVIDIA's official collection of CUDA C++ template abstractions for implementing high-performance matrix multiplication (GEMM) and related linear algebra on GPUs. It decomposes data movement and hierarchical parallelization into reusable, modular components tunable via custom tiling, data types, and algorithmic policy. Version 4.x adds CUTLASS DSLs, Python-native interfaces (starting with CuTe DSL) for writing high-performance CUDA kernels without deep C++ expertise.
en.content: The repo contains the C++ template header library, CuTe layout/tensor abstractions, extensive examples and tests, plus the new Python DSL implementation, docs, and media diagrams.
en.stack: Core is C++/CUDA template metaprogramming built with CUDA Toolkit and CMake; the Python DSL builds on Python and CuTe concepts with native deep-learning framework integration.
en.hot: As NVIDIA's official GEMM foundation, it powers mixed- and low-precision compute across Volta through Blackwell; with 10,487 stars and a #12 spot on today's C++ trending list, it remains a long-term staple of GPU HPC.
uses: GPU performance engineers hand-tuning GEMM kernels near cuBLAS limits
DL framework and operator developers integrating efficient tensor-core kernels
Researchers and students prototyping GPU kernels via the low-barrier Python DSL
Quantization and low-precision inference teams using NVFP4/MXFP block-scaled types

zh.tag: 将编码代理转变为多阶段安全审计员的技能

安全研究人员 —— 基于此技能构建自定义漏洞挖掘工具链。

en.tag: A coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a multi-phase security auditor
en.what: This is a coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a security auditor by orchestrating isolated agents through six phases: reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting. It produces machine-readable findings with independently verified claims.
en.content: The repo contains SKILL.md as the main skill file, along with phase-specific prompt files like RECONNAISSANCE.md, HUNTING.md, ATTACK-CLASSES.md, and domain-specific files such as MEMORY-SAFETY-AND-BINARY.md, AI-AND-LLM.md, WEB-PROTOCOL-AND-AUTH.md, and CLIENT-SIDE.md.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, it relies on Node.js for validation scripts (e.g., validate-coverage-ledger.cjs and validate-findings.cjs) and uses JSON schemas for structured output.
en.hot: It gained 1,434 stars today, reaching 5,126 total, and ranked 9th on GitHub Trending (JavaScript). It originated from Cloudflare's vulnerability discovery harness, offering a reusable security audit skill that has attracted significant attention.
uses: Security engineers and penetration testers — automate multi-phase security audits with agents to improve vulnerability discovery efficiency.
AI agent developers — integrate this skill into coding agents to enhance their security auditing capabilities.
DevSecOps teams — automate security audits in CI/CD pipelines and generate structured reports.
Security researchers — build custom vulnerability hunting harnesses based on this skill.

zh.tag: 终端里的智能体编程助手，用自然语言写代码

zh.tag: 阿里内部验证的混合架构 AI 代码审查 CLI 工具

en.tag: Alibaba's battle-tested hybrid-architecture AI code review CLI

en.stack: Primary language is Go, distributed via the npm package @alibaba-group/open-code-review, compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, and integrates with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
