uses: Engineering teams wanting AI code review in CI/CD
Developers using Claude Code, Codex or Cursor agents
Go and multi-language projects needing NPE, thread-safety and SQL injection checks
AI tool builders studying hybrid architecture and ruleset design

zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理打造的性能优化与安全增强系统
zh.what: ECC 是一个代理工具链（harness）优化系统，为 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理提供技能、直觉、记忆、安全与研究优先的开发能力。它通过统一的配置与插件机制，增强代理在复杂任务中的表现与可控性。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 JavaScript 库、CLI 工具、GitHub App（ecc-tools）、文档（多语言 README）以及示例配置，支持通过 npm 包（ecc-universal）集成。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js，依赖 npm 生态，提供 CLI 与 GitHub App 集成，支持多代理框架（Claude Code、Codex 等）。
zh.hot: 凭借 24.4 万 Star 和今日新增 235 星，ECC 成为 AI 代理工具链领域的明星项目，其跨代理兼容性和性能优化特性吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: AI 编码代理用户：希望增强 Claude Code、Codex 等代理的记忆、安全与技能，提升开发效率。
团队与组织：需要统一管理多个 AI 代理的配置、权限与安全策略，确保合规与可控。
开发者工具链爱好者：对代理性能优化、插件机制和 GitHub App 集成感兴趣，可扩展自定义功能。

en.tag: Performance optimization and security enhancement system for AI coding agents like Claude Code
en.what: ECC is an agent harness optimization system that provides skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development capabilities for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and Cursor. It enhances agent performance and control through unified configuration and plugin mechanisms.
en.content: The repository includes core JavaScript libraries, CLI tools, a GitHub App (ecc-tools), multi-language documentation, and example configurations, integrable via the npm package (ecc-universal).
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, leveraging the npm ecosystem, offering CLI and GitHub App integration, compatible with multiple agent frameworks (Claude Code, Codex, etc.).
en.hot: With 244k stars and 235 new stars today, ECC has become a star project in the AI agent toolchain space, attracting developers with its cross-agent compatibility and performance optimization features.
uses: AI coding agent users: Enhance memory, security, and skills for agents like Claude Code and Codex to boost development productivity.
Teams and organizations: Need unified management of configurations, permissions, and security policies across multiple AI agents for compliance and control.
Developer toolchain enthusiasts: Interested in agent performance optimization, plugin mechanisms, and GitHub App integration for custom extensions.

zh.tag: 把文档变成可查询RAG、自主推理Agent和自维护Wiki的LLM知识平台
zh.what: WeKnora是腾讯开源的LLM知识平台，将原始文档转化为可查询的RAG、自主推理的Agent和自维护的Wiki。它支持多源数据导入、树状文件夹视图、块编辑与版本回滚，并提供交互式知识图谱。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、架构文档、API参考、开发者指南，以及多语言README（中英日韩）。核心功能包括RAG快速问答、ReAct Agent、Wiki模式、知识图谱、多源导入（飞书、Notion、语雀、RSS等）和网站嵌入组件。
zh.stack: 主语言为Go，基于LLM能力构建，涉及RAG、ReAct Agent、MCP工具集成、向量检索等技术。支持多种文档格式和外部服务（如飞书、Notion、RSS）。
zh.hot: 上线后迅速获得2万+星标，今日新增105星，位列GitHub Go语言日榜第5。其将文档自动转化为可交互知识图谱和自维护Wiki的能力，解决了企业知识管理的痛点，备受开发者关注。
uses: 企业知识库建设：将内部文档自动整理为可查询的RAG和自维护Wiki，提升员工检索效率。
智能客服与问答系统：利用RAG快速问答能力，构建基于私有知识的对话机器人。
复杂任务自动化：通过ReAct Agent编排检索、工具调用和网络搜索，完成多步骤分析。
个人知识管理：导入个人文档，生成知识图谱和Wiki，辅助学习和研究。

en.tag: Open-source LLM knowledge platform turning documents into queryable RAG, autonomous agent, and self-maintaining Wiki
en.what: WeKnora is an open-source LLM knowledge platform from Tencent that transforms raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki. It supports multi-source ingestion, tree-structured folder views, chunk editing with revision history, and an interactive knowledge graph.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, architecture docs, API reference, developer guide, and multi-language READMEs (EN, CN, JA, KO). Key features include RAG-based Q&A, ReAct Agent, Wiki mode, knowledge graph, multi-source ingestion (Feishu, Notion, Yuque, RSS, etc.), and website embed widgets.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built on LLM capabilities, incorporating RAG, ReAct Agent, MCP tool integration, and vector retrieval. Supports various document formats and external services like Feishu, Notion, and RSS.
en.hot: Quickly gained over 20k stars with 105 new stars today, ranking #5 on GitHub Go daily trending. Its ability to auto-convert documents into interactive knowledge graphs and self-maintaining wikis addresses enterprise knowledge management pain points, drawing significant developer attention.
uses: Enterprise knowledge base: Automatically organize internal documents into queryable RAG and self-maintaining Wiki to boost employee retrieval efficiency.
Intelligent customer service and Q&A systems: Leverage RAG-based quick Q&A to build chatbots grounded in private knowledge.
Complex task automation: Use ReAct Agent to orchestrate retrieval, tool calls, and web search for multi-step analysis.
Personal knowledge management: Import personal documents to generate knowledge graphs and wikis for learning and research.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编程代理提供生产级工程技能包
zh.what: 这是一套面向 AI 编程代理的工程技能库，把资深工程师的工作流、质量门禁和最佳实践编码成可复用的技能。它覆盖从需求定义到上线的完整开发生命周期，让代理在每个阶段都遵循一致的标准。
zh.content: 仓库以技能包形式组织，包含 25 个技能和 9 个斜杠命令（如 /spec、/plan、/build、/test、/review、/ship），每个命令会自动激活对应技能。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，通过开放的 skills CLI（npx skills add）安装，可接入 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Copilot、Cline 等 70 多个代理。
zh.hot: 凭借 Addy Osmani 的影响力与 AI 编程代理热潮，项目已获 94,344 颗星，今日新增 354 星，位列 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第 3 名。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理的开发者，希望代理遵循统一工程规范
团队想为 AI 辅助开发引入质量门禁与标准化工作流
个人开发者需要从需求到上线的结构化开发流程模板
对 AI 代理技能包设计感兴趣、想学习或二次开发的人

en.tag: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents
en.what: A collection of engineering skills that encode the workflows, quality gates, and best practices senior engineers use, packaged so AI coding agents follow them consistently. It spans the full development lifecycle from defining requirements to shipping to production.
en.content: The repo is organized as skill packages, offering 25 skills and 9 slash commands (e.g. /spec, /plan, /build, /test, /review, /ship), each automatically activating the relevant skills.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, installed via the open skills CLI (npx skills add) and compatible with 70+ agents including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, and Cline.
en.hot: Backed by Addy Osmani's reputation and the AI coding agent boom, it has reached 94,344 stars with 354 added today, ranking #3 on GitHub Trending (JavaScript) daily.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor who want consistent engineering standards
Teams looking to add quality gates and standardized workflows to AI-assisted development
Individual developers wanting a structured spec-to-ship development process
Anyone curious about designing AI agent skill packages or wanting to extend them

zh.tag: 面向知识工作者的 Claude 插件集，按职能定制 AI 工作流
zh.what: 这是 Anthropic 开源的一套 Claude 插件，旨在将 Claude 转变为特定角色、团队和公司的专家。每个插件捆绑了技能、连接器、斜杠命令和子代理，覆盖销售、产品、营销、法律等 11 种职能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 11 个职能插件目录（如 productivity、sales、customer-support 等），每个目录内有技能定义、连接器配置、斜杠命令和子代理。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，依赖 Claude Cowork 和 Claude Code 平台，并集成 Slack、Notion、Jira 等第三方连接器。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 110 星，总星数达 24287，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 7 名，反映出知识工作者对 AI 提效工具的强烈需求。
uses: 知识工作者：通过插件快速获得角色专属的 AI 助手，提升日常工作效率。
团队负责人：定制插件以统一团队工作流程和术语，确保输出一致性。
企业开发者：基于开源插件进行二次开发，集成内部工具和数据源。
Claude 用户：利用现成插件扩展 Claude 功能，无需从零构建。

en.tag: Claude plugins for knowledge workers, customizing AI workflows by job function
en.what: Anthropic open-sources a set of Claude plugins designed to turn Claude into a specialist for your role, team, and company. Each plugin bundles skills, connectors, slash commands, and sub-agents for specific job functions like sales, product, marketing, legal, and more.
en.content: The repo contains 11 job-function plugin directories (e.g., productivity, sales, customer-support), each with skill definitions, connector configurations, slash commands, and sub-agents.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, it relies on Claude Cowork and Claude Code platforms, and integrates third-party connectors like Slack, Notion, and Jira.
en.hot: With 110 stars added today and a total of 24,287 stars, it ranks 7th on GitHub Trending daily, reflecting strong demand for AI productivity tools among knowledge workers.
uses: Knowledge workers: get role-specific AI assistance to boost daily productivity.
Team leads: customize plugins to unify workflows and terminology for consistent output.
Enterprise developers: extend open-source plugins to integrate internal tools and data.
Claude users: leverage ready-made plugins to expand Claude's capabilities without building from scratch.

zh.tag: 深度学习框架标杆，张量计算与动态神经网络
zh.what: PyTorch 是一个 Python 深度学习框架，提供类似 NumPy 的张量计算并支持强大的 GPU 加速，同时基于磁带式自动微分构建动态神经网络。它让研究者可以用纯 Python 命令式地定义、调试和训练模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 torch 库、torch.autograd 自动微分、torch.jit 编译器等组件，以及完整的 C++/CUDA 内核、构建脚本、测试与文档。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主，底层大量使用 C++ 与 CUDA，支持 NVIDIA CUDA、AMD ROCm 和 Intel GPU，可复用 NumPy、SciPy、Cython 等生态。
zh.hot: 作为 AI 领域最主流的框架之一，PyTorch 拥有超 10.3 万 star，本周新增 205 星并登上 GitHub Trending Python 周榜第 17 名，持续受益于大模型与生成式 AI 热潮。
uses: AI 研究者与工程师，用于训练和部署深度学习模型
学生与转行者，学习张量计算和神经网络基础
企业团队，构建计算机视觉、NLP 等生产级 AI 应用
开源贡献者，参与框架内核、算子与生态工具开发

en.tag: The de facto deep learning framework: tensor computing with dynamic neural networks
en.what: PyTorch is a Python deep learning framework offering NumPy-like tensor computation with strong GPU acceleration, plus dynamic neural networks built on a tape-based autograd system. It lets researchers define, debug and train models imperatively in pure Python.
en.content: The repo contains the core torch library, torch.autograd, torch.jit and more, along with C++/CUDA kernels, build scripts, tests and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily Python with heavy C++ and CUDA under the hood; supports NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm and Intel GPUs, and interoperates with NumPy, SciPy and Cython.
en.hot: As one of the dominant AI frameworks, PyTorch has over 103k stars, gained 205 this week and ranked 17th on GitHub Trending's Python weekly list, riding the LLM and generative AI wave.
uses: AI researchers and engineers training and deploying deep learning models
Students and career switchers learning tensor math and neural networks
Enterprise teams building production AI apps in vision, NLP and beyond
Open-source contributors working on kernels, operators and ecosystem tooling

zh.tag: 腾讯云开源的自托管多用户多智能体 AI 助手
zh.what: Octop 是腾讯云开源的自托管 AI 助手，主打多用户与多智能体并行协作，可为团队、家庭和个人搭建独立又协同的智能环境。它完全运行在本地，隐私不外泄，单进程启动即可用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 3.12+ 的完整实现，提供 Web 控制台、CLI 与 IM 集成，并有专家库、Connectors（OAuth + MCP）和 ACP 等扩展模块，附中英文 README 与路线图。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.12+，采用 Ruff 代码风格，通过 PyPI 分发，支持 HTTP/SSE/WebSocket 接口，并集成 MCP、OAuth 与 ACP 协议。
zh.hot: 上线即冲上 GitHub Trending Python 日榜第 6，累计约 2950 star、单日新增 396，腾讯云背书加上自托管多智能体定位正好切中隐私与协作需求。
uses: 注重数据隐私、希望本地自托管 AI 助手的团队与个人
需要多用户共享、多智能体协作的家庭或小型组织
想通过飞书、钉钉、QQ、Discord、企业微信等 IM 接入 AI 的用户
希望用专家库、Connectors 与 ACP 扩展 IDE 工作流的开发者

en.tag: Tencent Cloud's self-hosted multi-user, multi-agent AI assistant
en.what: Octop is an open-source, self-hosted AI assistant from Tencent Cloud built around multi-user and multi-agent parallelism, creating an intelligent environment that is both independent and collaborative for teams, families, and individuals. It runs entirely on your own machine, so privacy is never compromised, and a single process brings up the whole stack.
en.content: The repo ships a full Python 3.12+ implementation with a web console, CLI and IM integrations, plus extension modules such as an expert library, Connectors (OAuth + MCP) and ACP, along with bilingual READMEs and a roadmap.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.12+, styled with Ruff and distributed via PyPI, it exposes HTTP/SSE/WebSocket interfaces and integrates MCP, OAuth and ACP protocols.
en.hot: It hit No.6 on GitHub Trending's Python daily list with roughly 2,950 stars and 396 gained in a single day, as Tencent Cloud's backing plus a self-hosted multi-agent angle taps straight into privacy and collaboration needs.
uses: Teams and individuals who value privacy and want a self-hosted AI assistant
Families or small organizations needing multi-user sharing and multi-agent collaboration
Users who want AI access via Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, Discord or WeCom
Developers extending IDE workflows with the expert library, Connectors and ACP

zh.tag: Cloudflare 出品的 Rust QUIC 传输协议与 HTTP/3 实现
zh.what: quiche 是 Cloudflare 用 Rust 编写的 QUIC 传输协议与 HTTP/3 实现，遵循 IETF 规范。它提供处理 QUIC 数据包和连接状态的底层 API，由应用层自行负责 I/O、事件循环与定时器。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 quiche 库、提供命令行客户端与服务端的 quiche-apps crate，以及示例证书和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，发布在 crates.io 上，依赖 Rust 生态的加密与网络库，并提供 C 语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为 Cloudflare 边缘网络 HTTP/3 的底层引擎，并被 Android DNS 解析器和 curl 采用，凭借 11847 颗星稳居 Rust 日榜第 8。
uses: 网络协议开发者，需要实现或研究 QUIC/HTTP/3 底层逻辑
希望为服务端或客户端添加 HTTP/3 支持的 Rust 工程师
想将 QUIC 集成进 curl、DNS 解析器等现有工具的项目维护者
关注高性能传输层与拥塞控制的研究与教学人员

en.tag: Cloudflare's Rust implementation of the QUIC transport protocol and HTTP/3
en.what: quiche is Cloudflare's Rust implementation of the QUIC transport protocol and HTTP/3 as specified by the IETF. It offers a low-level API for processing QUIC packets and managing connection state, leaving I/O, event loops and timers to the application.
en.content: The repo contains the core quiche library, a quiche-apps crate with command-line client and server, plus sample certificates and build scripts.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust and published on crates.io, it relies on Rust crypto and networking crates and also ships C bindings.
en.hot: As the engine behind Cloudflare's edge HTTP/3 and adopted by Android's DNS resolver and curl, it holds 11,847 stars and ranks 8th on the Rust daily trending list.
uses: Network protocol developers implementing or studying QUIC/HTTP/3 internals
Rust engineers adding HTTP/3 support to servers or clients
Maintainers integrating QUIC into tools like curl or DNS resolvers
Researchers and educators focused on high-performance transport and congestion control

zh.tag: 为 AI 编程助手打造的规格驱动开发框架
zh.what: OpenSpec 是一套规格驱动开发（SDD）框架，让 AI 编程助手在动手写代码前先生成提案、规格、设计与任务清单。它把模糊的想法转成结构化产物，再驱动 AI 逐步实现并归档，避免直接让模型改代码带来的失控。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 实现的 CLI 与工作流文档为主，核心是 /opsx:explore、/opsx:propose、/opsx:apply、/opsx:archive 等命令，以及 openspec/changes/ 下的提案、规格、设计与任务产物模板。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，通过 npm 包 @fission-ai/openspec 分发，MIT 许可，配有 CI 与 Discord 社区。
zh.hot: AI 编程助手普及后，如何约束模型行为成为痛点，OpenSpec 以轻量、迭代、面向存量代码库的理念切中需求，已积累约 6.9 万 star，今日再增 296 并登上日榜第 8。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程助手的开发者，希望先规划再让 AI 写代码
需要为存量项目引入规格化流程、减少 AI 随意改动的团队
想把需求、设计与任务沉淀为可追溯文档的个人或企业项目

en.tag: Spec-driven development framework for AI coding assistants
en.what: OpenSpec is a spec-driven development (SDD) framework that makes AI coding assistants produce proposals, specs, designs and task lists before writing any code. It turns vague ideas into structured artifacts, then drives the AI through implementation and archiving instead of letting it edit code blindly.
en.content: The repo centers on a TypeScript CLI plus workflow docs, with commands like /opsx:explore, /opsx:propose, /opsx:apply and /opsx:archive, along with templates for proposals, specs, designs and tasks under openspec/changes/.
en.stack: Built in TypeScript and distributed as the npm package @fission-ai/openspec under the MIT license, with CI and a Discord community.
en.hot: As AI coding assistants spread, constraining their behavior became a real pain point; OpenSpec's lightweight, iterative, brownfield-friendly philosophy hits the mark, reaching ~69k stars with 296 added today and the #8 spot on the daily trending list.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Cursor who want planning before code generation
Teams needing spec-driven workflows for brownfield projects to curb uncontrolled AI edits
Individuals or enterprises wanting requirements, design and tasks captured as traceable documents

zh.tag: 开源自主编码代理，覆盖 IDE、终端与桌面
zh.what: Cline 是一个开源的自主编码代理，能读写文件、执行命令、浏览网页并调用工具，全程可人工审批。它以 VS Code/JetBrains 插件、CLI、桌面应用和 SDK 多种形态提供同一套代理引擎。
zh.content: 仓库按产品线组织：sdk/ 提供 Node.js 编程式代理 API，apps/cli/ 是终端 UI 与无头模式，另有 VS Code 扩展、JetBrains 插件和 macOS/Windows 桌面应用。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，基于 Node.js 生态；CLI 通过 npm 全局安装，SDK 以 @cline/sdk 包发布，支持 MCP 服务器与自定义工具。
zh.hot: 68,377 颗星、日增 112 并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 20，说明多形态统一代理引擎的定位持续吸引开发者。
uses: 想在 VS Code 或 JetBrains 里获得可审批自主编码助手的开发者
需要在 CI/CD 或脚本中使用无头编码代理的工程团队
希望基于同一引擎构建自定义 AI 代理与集成的开发者
偏好桌面应用管理模型、插件与 MCP 服务器的进阶用户

en.tag: Open-source autonomous coding agent for IDE, terminal, and desktop
en.what: Cline is an open-source autonomous coding agent that can create files, run commands, browse the web, and use tools with human-in-the-loop approval. It ships the same agent engine as VS Code/JetBrains extensions, a CLI, a desktop app, and an SDK.
en.content: The repo is organized by product line: sdk/ offers a Node.js programmatic agent API, apps/cli/ holds the terminal UI and headless mode, plus VS Code extension, JetBrains plugin, and macOS/Windows desktop app.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript on the Node.js ecosystem; the CLI installs globally via npm and the SDK ships as @cline/sdk, with support for MCP servers and custom tools.
en.hot: With 68,377 stars, +112 today, and a #20 spot on GitHub Trending daily, its multi-surface unified agent engine keeps drawing developers.
uses: Developers wanting an approval-gated autonomous coding assistant in VS Code or JetBrains
Engineering teams needing a headless coding agent for CI/CD or scripting
Developers building custom AI agents and integrations on the same engine
Power users preferring a desktop app to manage models, plugins, and MCP servers

zh.tag: 开源企业级应用套件，一站式满足业务增长需求
zh.what: Odoo 是一套基于 Web 的开源企业应用套件，涵盖 CRM、网站构建、电子商务、库存管理、项目管理、会计、POS、人力资源、营销、制造等众多模块。这些应用既可独立使用，也能无缝集成，组合后形成功能完整的开源 ERP 系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Odoo 核心框架及所有官方模块的源代码，按功能划分为不同目录（如 addons 下的各应用模块），并附有构建状态、文档、帮助等徽章链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 语言开发，基于 PostgreSQL 数据库，前端采用 JavaScript 和 OWL 框架，依赖 Werkzeug、lxml 等库。
zh.hot: Odoo 拥有超过 54,000 颗星，本周新增 165 星，位列 GitHub Trending 周榜（Python）第 8 名，作为老牌开源 ERP 项目持续受到关注。
uses: 中小企业寻求低成本、可定制的 ERP 解决方案
开发者学习企业级应用架构和 Python 全栈开发
业务人员快速搭建 CRM、电商、库存等管理系统
集成商为客户部署和定制 Odoo 模块

en.tag: Open source business apps suite to grow your business
en.what: Odoo is a suite of web-based open source business apps, including CRM, Website Builder, eCommerce, Warehouse Management, Project Management, Billing & Accounting, Point of Sale, Human Resources, Marketing, Manufacturing, and more. Apps can be used standalone or integrated seamlessly to form a full-featured open source ERP.
en.content: The repository contains the source code for the Odoo core framework and all official modules, organized into directories by function (e.g., various app modules under addons), along with badges for build status, docs, and help.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Python, using PostgreSQL as the database, with JavaScript and the OWL framework on the frontend, and dependencies like Werkzeug and lxml.
en.hot: With over 54,000 stars and 165 new stars this week, Odoo ranks 8th on GitHub Trending (Python weekly), showing sustained interest in this veteran open source ERP project.
uses: SMBs looking for a low-cost, customizable ERP solution
Developers learning enterprise application architecture and Python full-stack development
Business users quickly setting up CRM, eCommerce, inventory, etc.
Integrators deploying and customizing Odoo modules for clients

zh.tag: 开源 AI Agent 教材：10 章正文 + 109 个配套实验
zh.what: 这是一本系统讲解 AI Agent 设计原理与工程实践的开源书籍，围绕「Agent = LLM + 上下文 + 工具」这一核心公式，从基础概念一路讲到生产级工程落地。全书正文、配图与配套实验代码全部开放，读者可以边读边动手复现。
zh.content: 仓库包含 10 章正文、109 个配套实验（含本地项目与外部复现轨道）、编译好的 PDF/EPUB，以及 15 种语言的翻译版本和在线阅读站点。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主要语言，配套实验代码基于主流 LLM 与 Agent 工具链；文档采用 Markdown 编写，通过 Astro 构建多语言在线阅读站点，并以 Apache-2.0 协议开源。
zh.hot: 作为少见的成体系中文 AI Agent 开源教材，它把原理与 109 个可运行实验结合，加上 15 种语言翻译和持续更新的 2.0 版内容，本周新增 2485 star、总量突破 5 万，冲上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 21 名。
uses: AI 应用开发者：想系统掌握 Agent 架构、上下文管理与工具调用工程实践
算法与后端工程师：希望从原理到代码补齐 LLM Agent 知识体系
高校师生与自学者：需要一本可离线阅读、带实验的中文教材
技术团队负责人：用于内部培训、技术选型与团队能力建设参考

en.tag: Open-source AI Agent textbook: 10 chapters plus 109 hands-on labs
en.what: This is an open-source book that systematically explains AI Agent design principles and engineering practice, built around the core formula 'Agent = LLM + context + tools' and spanning from fundamentals to production-grade engineering. The full text, figures, and companion lab code are all open, so readers can read and reproduce the experiments hands-on.
en.content: The repo contains 10 chapters of main text, 109 companion labs (local projects plus external reproduction tracks), compiled PDF/EPUB builds, translations in 15 languages, and an online reading site.
en.stack: Python is the primary language, with lab code built on mainstream LLM and agent toolchains; docs are written in Markdown, published as a multilingual Astro site, and released under Apache-2.0.
en.hot: As a rare systematic open-source Chinese textbook on AI Agents, it pairs theory with 109 runnable labs, adds 15 language translations and an actively updated 2.0 edition, gaining 2,485 stars this week to pass 50k total and rank 21st on GitHub Trending weekly.
uses: AI application developers who want a systematic grasp of agent architecture, context management, and tool-use engineering
Algorithm and backend engineers looking to fill in LLM agent knowledge from theory to code
Students, teachers, and self-learners who need an offline-readable Chinese textbook with labs
Tech leads using it for internal training, technology selection, and team capability building

zh.tag: 统一 100+ LLM 的开源 AI 网关，Rust 内核配 Python SDK
zh.what: LiteLLM 是一个开源的 AI 网关，让你用 OpenAI 或各家原生格式调用 100 多个 LLM API。它提供成本追踪、护栏、负载均衡和日志记录，可自托管也可用托管版，面向企业级生产环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python SDK（litellm 包）和 LiteLLM Proxy Server（AI 网关）两大形态，附带 Terraform 部署模板（AWS/GCP）、Docker 配置和完整文档。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写以追求性能，对外提供 Python SDK；支持 Bedrock、Azure、OpenAI、Anthropic、VertexAI、vLLM、Nvidia NIM 等 100+ 提供商，可通过 pip 安装或 Docker/Render/Railway 一键部署。
zh.hot: 近 6 万 star 且本周再涨 597，正值企业多模型接入与成本治理需求爆发，LiteLLM 作为统一网关成为事实标准，Y Combinator W23 背景也增加了信任度。
uses: 需要统一接入多家 LLM 并做成本核算的工程团队
想用 OpenAI 格式快速切换模型的 AI 应用开发者
需要负载均衡、限流与日志的企业平台/运维人员
做多模型对比评测或代理服务的研究者

en.tag: Open-source AI gateway unifying 100+ LLMs, Rust core with Python SDK
en.what: LiteLLM is an open-source AI gateway that lets you call 100+ LLM APIs in OpenAI or native format. It adds cost tracking, guardrails, load balancing, and logging, and can be self-hosted or used as a hosted proxy for enterprise production.
en.content: The repo ships a Python SDK (the litellm package) plus the LiteLLM Proxy Server (AI gateway), along with Terraform deploy templates for AWS/GCP, Docker configs, and full documentation.
en.stack: A Rust core for speed with a Python SDK on top; it supports 100+ providers including Bedrock, Azure, OpenAI, Anthropic, VertexAI, vLLM, and Nvidia NIM, installable via pip or one-click deploys on Docker/Render/Railway.
en.hot: With nearly 60k stars and +597 this week, LiteLLM rides the surge in enterprise multi-model adoption and cost governance, becoming a de facto standard gateway; its Y Combinator W23 backing adds trust.
uses: Engineering teams needing unified multi-LLM access with cost accounting
AI app developers wanting to switch models via OpenAI format
Platform/ops teams needing load balancing, rate limits, and logging
Researchers benchmarking or proxying across many models

zh.tag: 移动设备取证工具，用于检测 iOS/Android 是否被间谍软件入侵
zh.what: MVT（Mobile Verification Toolkit）是一套用于移动设备取证的命令行工具集，可自动化采集并分析 Android 与 iOS 设备中的取证痕迹，帮助判断设备是否遭到入侵。它由国际特赦组织安全实验室于 2021 年 7 月随 Pegasus 项目发布，至今仍由该组织及社区维护。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 包形式发布，包含针对 iOS 与 Android 的多个取证模块（如备份解析、文件系统提取、IOC 扫描等），并配有完整文档、测试与 CI 配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，可通过 PyPI 或源码安装，依赖若干解析库并支持命令行调用，文档托管在 Read the Docs。
zh.hot: 凭借 Amnesty 与 Pegasus 项目的背景，MVT 一直是数字取证领域的标杆工具；目前累计 13594 颗星，今日新增 169 星并登上 GitHub 日榜第 8 名，说明隐私与间谍软件检测话题持续受到关注。
uses: 安全研究人员与数字取证分析师，用于调查设备是否被间谍软件感染
记者、人权工作者等高风险人群，在专家协助下进行设备安全评估
移动安全爱好者与开发者，学习 iOS/Android 取证方法与 IOC 扫描流程

en.tag: Mobile forensics toolkit for detecting spyware compromise on iOS and Android devices
en.what: MVT (Mobile Verification Toolkit) is a collection of command-line utilities that automate the gathering and analysis of forensic traces from Android and iOS devices to identify signs of compromise. It was released by Amnesty International's Security Lab in July 2021 alongside the Pegasus Project and is still maintained by Amnesty and contributors.
en.content: The repo ships as a Python package with separate forensic modules for iOS and Android (backup parsing, filesystem extraction, IOC scanning, etc.), plus full documentation, tests, and CI configuration.
en.stack: Written primarily in Python, installable via PyPI or from source, relies on several parsing libraries and exposes a CLI; documentation is hosted on Read the Docs.
en.hot: Backed by Amnesty and the Pegasus Project, MVT remains a benchmark tool in digital forensics; with 13,594 stars and 169 added today, ranking 8th on GitHub Trending, it reflects sustained interest in privacy and spyware detection.
uses: Security researchers and digital forensics analysts investigating potential spyware infections
Journalists, human rights defenders, and high-risk individuals conducting device assessments with expert help
Mobile security enthusiasts and developers learning iOS/Android forensics and IOC scanning workflows

zh.tag: AI 驱动的视频高光切片与二创工具
zh.what: AutoClip 能自动从 YouTube、B 站等平台下载视频，用通义千问大模型理解内容并提取精彩片段，再智能生成合集。它把下载、AI 分析、自动切片、合集编排整合成一条流水线，面向视频二创场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 FastAPI 后端、Celery 异步任务队列、React + TypeScript 前端，以及 Docker 一键启动脚本和详细中英文文档。
zh.stack: 后端用 Python 3.8+、FastAPI、Celery、Redis、SQLite 与 yt-dlp，AI 部分接入通义千问；前端为 React 18、TypeScript、Ant Design、Vite 和 Zustand，视频处理依赖 FFmpeg。
zh.hot: 它把大模型内容理解与视频切片工作流打通，正好踩中短视频二创的高频需求，今日新增 395 star、总数 7894，冲上 Python 日榜第 7。
uses: 短视频二创作者：批量从长视频中自动提取高光片段
内容运营与 MCN 团队：快速生成多平台可发布的切片合集
AI 应用开发者：参考 LLM + 异步任务队列的视频处理架构
自媒体学习者：本地或 Docker 部署，体验自动化剪辑流水线

en.tag: AI-powered video highlight clipping and remix tool
en.what: AutoClip downloads videos from YouTube, Bilibili and other platforms, uses the Qwen LLM to understand content and extract highlights, then intelligently assembles them into compilations. It bundles downloading, AI analysis, auto-clipping and collection editing into one pipeline for video remixing.
en.content: The repo contains a FastAPI backend, a Celery async task queue, a React + TypeScript frontend, plus one-click Docker scripts and detailed bilingual docs.
en.stack: Backend is Python 3.8+ with FastAPI, Celery, Redis, SQLite and yt-dlp, with Qwen powering the AI analysis; frontend is React 18, TypeScript, Ant Design, Vite and Zustand, with FFmpeg for video processing.
en.hot: It connects LLM content understanding with a video clipping workflow, hitting the high demand for short-video remixing; it gained 395 stars today to reach 7,894, ranking 7th on the Python daily trending list.
uses: Short-video creators: auto-extract highlights from long videos in bulk
Content ops and MCN teams: quickly produce cross-platform clip compilations
AI app developers: study an LLM + async task queue video pipeline
Self-media learners: deploy locally or via Docker to try automated editing

zh.tag: 从零手写 Transformer 训练 LLM 全流程教程
zh.what: 该项目用纯 PyTorch 从零实现 Transformer，并覆盖从原始文本到对齐推理模型的完整训练流程。你可以用单张 GPU 训练百万到十亿参数级别的 LLM。
zh.content: 仓库包含分步教程、模块化代码（数据准备、模型构建、预训练、生成、SFT、奖励模型、PPO/DPO/GRPO 等）以及文档和示例输出。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 Python 3.9+ 和 PyTorch，不依赖 transformers、trl 或 peft 等高级库，所有算法手写实现。
zh.hot: 该项目因提供从零训练 LLM 的完整、透明教程而受欢迎，本周新增 1294 stars，总 stars 达 10925，位列 GitHub Trending Python 周榜第 11 名。
uses: 适合想深入理解 LLM 训练原理的机器学习初学者和研究者。
适合需要在单 GPU 上训练小规模 LLM 的开发者。
适合作为高校课程或自学项目的实践教材。

en.tag: Handwritten Transformer LLM training from scratch, end to end
en.what: This project implements a Transformer from scratch in pure PyTorch and covers the full pipeline from raw text to an aligned reasoning model. You can train million- to billion-parameter LLMs on a single GPU.
en.content: The repo contains step-by-step tutorials, modular code (data prep, model building, pretraining, generation, SFT, reward model, PPO/DPO/GRPO, etc.), docs, and example outputs.
en.stack: Tech stack: Python 3.9+ and PyTorch, with no dependencies on transformers, trl, or peft; all algorithms are handwritten.
en.hot: It's popular for offering a complete, transparent tutorial on training LLMs from scratch, gaining 1,294 stars this week for a total of 10,925, ranking #11 on GitHub Trending Python weekly.
uses: For ML beginners and researchers wanting a deep understanding of LLM training.
For developers needing to train small-scale LLMs on a single GPU.
For use as a hands-on textbook in university courses or self-study projects.

zh.tag: 面向微型设备的 2-bit 自动化基础模型，主打工具调用与结构化抽取
zh.what: Needle 是一个专为手机、可穿戴设备、机器人、智能家居、汽车和微控制器设计的基础模型，整模型仅 8-29 MB 单文件二进制。它牺牲通用聊天能力，换取在移动端工具调用上超越 10 倍大小模型、在结构化抽取上匹敌 2-3 倍大模型的表现。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型权重与各平台推理引擎（托管在 Hugging Face）、Python 包 cactus-needle、架构与基准测试图表，以及工具设计、微调等使用指南。
zh.stack: 主语言 Python，通过 pip install cactus-needle 安装；模型基于 Laddered Simple Attention Network，采用 Monarch Hadamard MLP、GQA 注意力、engram n-gram 记忆与字节级语法约束解码。
zh.hot: 上线即获 12540 stars、今日新增 141，登上 GitHub Trending Python 日榜第 18 名，凭借「端侧小模型 + 精准工具调用」的差异化定位吸引大量关注。
uses: 移动/可穿戴/机器人等端侧应用的开发者，需要在本地做工具调用与意图路由
智能家居、汽车、微控制器等资源受限场景的嵌入式与 IoT 工程师
需要把杂乱文本抽取为结构化字段（发票、预订、通知、表单）的后端与数据团队
希望在本地做语义搜索、匹配与路由，而不依赖云端大模型的产品团队

en.tag: A 2-bit automation foundation model for tiny devices, built for tool calls and structured extraction
en.what: Needle is a foundation model designed for phones, wearables, robots, smart homes, cars and microcontrollers, shipped as a single 8-29 MB binary. It trades general chat capacity to beat models 10x its size on mobile tool calls and match 2-3x bigger models on structured extraction.
en.content: The repo ships model weights and per-platform inference engines (hosted on Hugging Face), the cactus-needle Python package, architecture and benchmark diagrams, plus guides on tool design and fine-tuning.
en.stack: Primarily Python, installed via pip install cactus-needle; the model is a Laddered Simple Attention Network using a Monarch Hadamard MLP, GQA attention, engram n-gram memory and byte-level grammar-constrained decoding.
en.hot: It has quickly reached 12,540 stars with 141 added today, ranking 18th on GitHub Trending's Python daily list, drawing attention for its differentiated on-device small-model plus precise tool-calling positioning.
uses: Developers of mobile, wearable and robotics apps needing on-device tool calling and intent routing
Embedded and IoT engineers working on resource-constrained smart home, automotive and microcontroller scenarios
Backend and data teams extracting messy text into typed fields such as invoices, bookings, notifications and forms
Product teams wanting local semantic search, matching and routing without relying on cloud LLMs

zh.tag: 开源免费的实时行情追踪与公司洞察平台
zh.what: OpenStock 是昂贵金融行情平台的开源替代品，支持追踪实时股价、设置个性化提醒，并查看详细的公司信息。项目由 Open Dev Society 公开构建，承诺永久免费，面向所有投资者开放。
zh.content: 仓库为 TypeScript 前端项目，包含仪表盘等界面资源（如 public/assets/images/dashboard.png），并配有 Star History、Trendshift 等徽章展示热度。整体以 Web 应用形态呈现，采用 AGPL-3.0 许可。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，属于前端/全栈 Web 应用，依赖现代 JS 生态构建界面与数据展示。采用 AGPL-3.0 许可，修改或部署为服务需开源并署名。
zh.hot: 已获约 16,050 颗星，今日新增 472 星，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜第 6。免费替代付费行情平台的定位切中痛点，加上开源社区运营，推动其快速走红。
uses: 个人投资者：免费追踪实时股价并设置价格提醒
开发者：基于 TypeScript 二次开发或自建行情看板
开源爱好者：参与 Open Dev Society 的公开协作项目
预算有限的小团队：替代昂贵的商业行情平台

en.tag: A free, open-source alternative to pricey market data platforms
en.what: OpenStock is an open-source alternative to expensive market platforms, letting users track real-time prices, set personalized alerts, and explore detailed company insights. Built openly by Open Dev Society, it is promised to stay free forever for everyone.
en.content: The repo is a TypeScript web app containing UI assets such as the dashboard screenshot in public/assets/images, plus Star History and Trendshift badges. It ships as a web application under the AGPL-3.0 license.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, it is a front-end/full-stack web app built on the modern JS ecosystem for UI and data display. Licensed AGPL-3.0, requiring source release and attribution if modified or deployed as a service.
en.hot: It has around 16,050 stars with 472 added today, ranking #6 on GitHub Trending daily. Its pitch as a free replacement for paid market platforms hits a real pain point, and open community building fuels the surge.
uses: Individual investors: track real-time prices and set alerts for free
Developers: fork or extend the TypeScript codebase for custom dashboards
Open-source enthusiasts: contribute to Open Dev Society's public project
Budget-limited small teams: replace costly commercial market platforms

zh.tag: 用数学证明拦截 AI 编码错误的快速语言
zh.what: Bend 2 是一门面向后 AGI 时代的编程语言：人类不再直接读写代码，而是用无歧义的语言向 AI 表达意图。它通过 LAWS.bend 声明不可破坏的规则，并用数学证明机械地验证 AI 是否忠实实现了需求。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Bend 2 编译器与运行时、LAWS.bend 证明检查机制、GPU 并行执行支持，以及对比 C、CUDA、Lean、Agda、Isabelle 的基准测试与演示 GIF。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，编译目标追求单核媲美 C、GPU 媲美 CUDA，并依赖强类型、纯函数与线性类型实现自动并行与证明检查。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1530 star，总 star 达 22806，登上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 周榜第 7 名。它切中 AI 生成代码难以信任的痛点，用证明检查给出可验证答案，加上一键安装脚本降低了尝鲜门槛。
uses: 想让 AI 写代码但不敢直接合并的工程团队，用 LAWS.bend 强制证明正确性
研究形式化验证与证明助手的开发者，可对比其检查速度
需要 GPU 大规模并行计算但不想写 CUDA 内核的科研与工程场景
对后 AGI 编程范式、意图驱动语言感兴趣的语言设计与 AI 研究者

en.tag: A fast language that blocks AI mistakes via mathematical proof
en.what: Bend 2 is a programming language for the post-AGI era, where humans express intent to AI instead of reading code. It uses LAWS.bend to declare inviolable rules and mechanically verifies via mathematical proof that AI implemented the prompt correctly.
en.content: The repo contains the Bend 2 compiler and runtime, the LAWS.bend proof-checking mechanism, GPU-parallel execution support, and benchmarks plus demo GIFs comparing against C, CUDA, Lean, Agda, and Isabelle.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, it targets C-level single-core and CUDA-level GPU performance, relying on strong types, purity, and linearity for automatic parallelism and proof checking.
en.hot: It gained 1,530 stars this week for a total of 22,806, ranking 7th on GitHub Trending's TypeScript weekly chart. It hits the pain point of untrustworthy AI-generated code with verifiable proof checking, while a one-line install script lowers the barrier to try it.
uses: Engineering teams that want AI-written code but dare not merge it, using LAWS.bend to enforce correctness proofs
Developers researching formal verification and proof assistants, who can compare its checking speed
Scientific and engineering workloads needing large-scale GPU parallelism without writing CUDA kernels
Language designers and AI researchers interested in post-AGI, intent-driven programming paradigms

zh.tag: 面向创作者的本地开源 AI 工作台，用 Codex 驱动视频图像语音智能体
zh.what: OpenCreator（原 KrillinAI）是一个面向创作者的本地 AI 工作台，把视频、图像、语音、数字人、翻译和剪辑等创作工具与可复用 Skills、Agents 整合到同一处。它不自己重写 Agent 循环，而是以 Codex CLI 作为执行引擎，外加稳定的本地 Runtime、可视化工作区和桌面端宿主。
zh.content: 仓库包含可视化内容工作区、创作模板、Skills 体系、会话与工作区模块，以及桌面端应用和系统架构文档，另附多语言 README 与示例素材。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，核心依赖 Codex CLI 作为 Agent 执行引擎，采用 Apache 2.0 许可，支持本地 Runtime 与桌面宿主，并接入多种模型。
zh.hot: 作为原 KrillinAI 的升级版，它曾拿下 Trendshift 日榜第一，如今已积累近 1.2 万 star，今日再涨 263，说明创作者对本地化、一体化 AI 工作流需求旺盛。
uses: 内容创作者：想用 AI 一站式完成脚本、视频、配音与剪辑
独立开发者与小型团队：希望本地运行、数据自控的创作流水线
AI 工具爱好者：想体验基于 Codex CLI 的 Agent 工作台与 Skills 体系
多语言内容团队：需要翻译、数字人与多语种视频本地化能力

en.tag: Open-source local AI workspace for creators, powered by Codex agents
en.what: OpenCreator (formerly KrillinAI) is a local-first AI workspace that unifies visual creator tools, reusable Skills, and Agents for video, images, voice, avatars, translation, and editing. Rather than reimplementing an agent loop, it uses Codex CLI as its execution engine and wraps it with a stable local runtime, a visual workspace, and a desktop host.
en.content: The repo ships a visual content workspace, creation templates, a Skills system, conversation/workspace modules, a desktop app, and architecture docs, plus multilingual READMEs and example assets.
en.stack: Primary language is TypeScript, with Codex CLI as the agent execution engine under Apache 2.0, supporting a local runtime, desktop host, and multiple model providers.
en.hot: As the rebranded KrillinAI, it once hit #1 on Trendshift and now sits near 12k stars, gaining 263 today—showing strong demand for a local, all-in-one AI creation workflow.
uses: Content creators wanting one AI place for scripts, video, voice, and editing
Indie devs and small teams needing a local, self-controlled creation pipeline
AI tool enthusiasts curious about a Codex CLI-based agent workspace and Skills
Multilingual content teams doing translation, avatars, and video localization

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理借用你已登录的真实浏览器，不打断你的工作
zh.what: BrowserSkill 通过 CLI 加浏览器扩展，把 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等任意能调用 shell 的 AI 代理连接到你已经登录的浏览器。代理需要操作某个已打开的标签页时必须显式借用，任务完成后归还，不影响你其余浏览。
zh.content: 仓库包含 bsk CLI/守护进程与浏览器扩展两部分运行时，以及安装文档、全页截图指南、沙箱代理配置等 docs 目录。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，支持 macOS、Linux、Windows，浏览器端支持 Chrome 与 Edge 等 Chromium 内核扩展。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1302 star、总数 4149，冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 4，切中了代理复用真实登录态与人工接管的刚需。
uses: 用 Cursor、Claude Code 等代理自动操作已登录网站的个人开发者
需要代理处理验证码、登录等人工步骤并随时接管的团队
希望避免维护独立测试账号与登录态的自动化工程师
在沙箱环境中运行代理、需要持久守护进程的进阶用户

en.tag: Let AI agents borrow your real, logged-in browser without interrupting your work
en.what: BrowserSkill connects shell-capable AI agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex to your already logged-in browser via a CLI plus extension. Agents must explicitly borrow an open tab, return it when done, and leave the rest of your browser untouched.
en.content: The repo ships two local runtimes — the bsk CLI/daemon and a browser extension — plus docs for installation, full-page screenshots, and sandboxed agent setup.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript; runs on macOS, Linux, and Windows, with Chrome and Edge (Chromium-based) extension support.
en.hot: With 1,302 stars added today and 4,149 total, it hit #4 on GitHub Trending, tapping the real need for agents to reuse live login state with human-in-the-loop handoff.
uses: Individual developers automating logged-in sites with Cursor, Claude Code, or similar agents
Teams needing agents to pause for captcha or login and hand control back to a human
Engineers who want to avoid maintaining separate test accounts and login states
Advanced users running agents in sandboxes who need a persistent daemon

zh.tag: 离线优先的知识与教育服务器，断网也能用
zh.what: Project NOMAD 是一个自包含的离线优先知识与教育服务器，把维基百科、数千本书籍、课程、地图和可选的本地 AI 打包在一起。它运行在你自己拥有的硬件上，完全不需要联网即可访问。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个基于浏览器的管理界面「Command Center」和 API，通过 Docker 编排各类容器化工具与资源，并提供安装脚本、Docker Compose 模板和文档。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，依赖 Docker 容器化运行，本地 AI 可选 Ollama 或 OpenAI API 兼容方案（如 LM Studio、llama.cpp），支持 Debian/Ubuntu 系统。
zh.hot: 凭借「断网也能用的知识服务器」这一刚需场景，项目已获 37862 星，今日新增 394 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 11 名。
uses: 适合需要离线知识库的偏远地区、应急场景或旅行者
适合注重数据主权、想自托管 AI 与资料的极客和家庭用户
适合学校、图书馆等教育机构搭建本地学习资源服务器
适合在无网络或弱网环境下需要查阅百科与课程的人群

en.tag: An offline-first knowledge and education server that works without internet
en.what: Project NOMAD is a self-contained, offline-first knowledge and education server bundling Wikipedia, thousands of books, courses, maps, and optional local AI. It runs on hardware you own and requires no internet connection to use.
en.content: The repo contains a browser-based management UI called Command Center plus an API that orchestrates containerized tools and resources via Docker, along with install scripts, a Docker Compose template, and documentation.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript, it relies on Docker containers, with optional local AI via Ollama or OpenAI-compatible tools like LM Studio and llama.cpp, and supports Debian/Ubuntu systems.
en.hot: With its must-have pitch of a knowledge server that works offline, it has reached 37,862 stars, gaining 394 today and ranking 11th on GitHub Trending's daily list.
uses: Ideal for remote areas, emergency scenarios, or travelers needing offline knowledge
Suits geeks and families who value data sovereignty and self-hosted AI and resources
Great for schools and libraries building local learning resource servers
For anyone needing encyclopedias and courses in no-network or weak-network environments

zh.tag: 开源可自托管的增强版 ChatGPT 替代品，支持多模型与 Agent
zh.what: LibreChat 是一个开源、可自托管的 ChatGPT 增强替代品，聚合 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、DeepSeek、Groq 等多家模型。它提供 Agent、MCP、Skills、代码解释器、Artifacts、多用户安全认证等企业级功能，让团队在自有服务器上统一使用 AI。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编写的前端 client 与后端 api，配套文档、部署模板（Railway/Zeabur/Sealos）和 Discord/YouTube 社区资源，支持 Docker 一键自托管。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，前端基于 React，后端 Node.js/Express，集成 LangChain、MCP、OpenAPI Actions，并支持多种数据库与 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 44,898 颗星和本周新增 743 星登上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 18 名，其多模型聚合、Agent 与自托管能力正好切中企业与开发者对数据隐私和灵活性的需求。
uses: 希望自托管 AI 聊天平台、保障数据隐私的企业与团队
需要在一个界面切换多种大模型（OpenAI、Claude、Gemini 等）的开发者
想搭建内部 AI 助手并集成 MCP、代码解释器等工具的技术团队
关注开源 AI 应用、希望快速部署体验的独立开发者与爱好者

en.tag: Open-source, self-hostable enhanced ChatGPT clone with multi-model and Agent support
en.what: LibreChat is an open-source, self-hostable enhanced ChatGPT alternative that aggregates models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq and more. It offers Agents, MCP, Skills, Code Interpreter, Artifacts and secure multi-user auth, letting teams run AI on their own servers.
en.content: The repo contains a TypeScript frontend (client) and backend (api), plus docs, deploy templates (Railway/Zeabur/Sealos) and Discord/YouTube community resources, with Docker-based self-hosting.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript with a React frontend and Node.js/Express backend, integrating LangChain, MCP and OpenAPI Actions, with multi-database support and Docker deployment.
en.hot: With 44,898 stars and 743 added this week, it ranks #18 on GitHub Trending weekly, as its multi-model aggregation, Agents and self-hosting hit the demand for privacy and flexibility among enterprises and developers.
uses: Enterprises and teams wanting a self-hosted AI chat platform with data privacy
Developers needing to switch between multiple LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, etc.) in one UI
Tech teams building internal AI assistants with MCP, Code Interpreter and other tools
Indie developers and enthusiasts eager to deploy and explore open-source AI apps quickly

zh.tag: 给 Claude 装上终端与文件系统的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: Desktop Commander MCP 是一个基于 Model Context Protocol 的服务器，让 Claude 等 AI 客户端能够直接执行终端命令、搜索和管理文件、进行 diff 式文件编辑。它构建在官方 MCP Filesystem Server 之上，扩展了搜索替换、进程控制、内存中运行代码等能力，把 AI 变成能操作本地开发环境的代理。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含 TypeScript 源码、npm 包配置、安装脚本和文档，提供文件预览 UI、Markdown 编辑器、长时命令处理、Excel/PDF 支持等模块，并附有详细的安装与使用说明。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 TypeScript 和 Node.js 为主，依赖 @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 实现 MCP 协议，通过 npm 分发，可集成到 Claude Desktop 等支持 MCP 的客户端。
zh.hot: 凭借近 9.8k 星标和本周 121 新增，登上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 周榜第 13 名，反映出开发者对让 AI 直接操控本地终端与文件系统的强烈需求，以及 MCP 生态的快速升温。
uses: 希望让 Claude 等 AI 助手直接操作本地终端和文件的开发者
需要自动化代码搜索、批量替换和文件管理的工程师
想用 AI 进行数据分析（CSV/JSON/Excel）而无需编写脚本的用户
探索 MCP 协议、构建 AI 代理工具链的技术爱好者

en.tag: MCP server giving Claude terminal control and filesystem access
en.what: Desktop Commander MCP is a Model Context Protocol server that lets Claude and other AI clients run terminal commands, search and manage files, and perform diff-based file editing. Built on top of the official MCP Filesystem Server, it adds search-and-replace editing, process control, and in-memory code execution, turning AI into an agent that can operate a local dev environment.
en.content: The repo contains TypeScript source code, npm package configuration, install scripts, and documentation, offering modules for file preview UI, Markdown editing, long-running command handling, and Excel/PDF support, along with detailed setup and usage guides.
en.stack: Built primarily with TypeScript and Node.js, it relies on the @modelcontextprotocol/sdk for the MCP protocol, is distributed via npm, and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Claude Desktop.
en.hot: With nearly 9.8k stars and 121 added this week, it ranks 13th on GitHub Trending's weekly TypeScript list, reflecting strong developer demand for AI that directly controls local terminals and filesystems, and the rapid growth of the MCP ecosystem.
uses: Developers who want AI assistants like Claude to directly operate local terminals and files
Engineers needing automated code search, bulk replacement, and file management
Users who want AI-driven data analysis (CSV/JSON/Excel) without writing scripts
Tech enthusiasts exploring the MCP protocol and building AI agent toolchains

zh.tag: 受约束的生成式 UI 框架，让 AI 安全可控地生成界面
zh.what: json-render 是一个生成式 UI 框架，让 AI 根据自然语言提示生成动态、个性化的界面，同时不牺牲可靠性。它通过预定义的组件与动作目录约束模型输出，保证结果安全且可预测。
zh.content: 仓库以 monorepo 形式提供核心包 @json-render/core 及多平台适配包，覆盖 React、Vue、Svelte、Solid、React Native、Next.js、Remotion、PDF、邮件、终端 Ink 和 3D 场景，并内置 36 个 shadcn/ui 组件。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 与 Zod 做 schema 校验，核心为 JSON 输出协议，前端适配 React/Vue/Svelte/Solid 等，并集成 shadcn/ui、react-three-fiber、react-email 等生态。
zh.hot: 由 Vercel Labs 出品，主打「护栏式」生成式 UI 这一热门方向，加上跨平台与开箱即用的组件库，今日新增 585 star，冲上 TypeScript 日榜第 4，累计 16853 star。
uses: 希望用 AI 动态生成界面但要求输出可控可靠的前端开发者
需要在 React、Vue、Svelte 或 React Native 等多端复用同一组件目录的团队
想快速搭建生成式 UI 原型或 AI 驱动应用的独立开发者与产品经理
对生成式 UI、LLM 结构化输出与安全护栏感兴趣的技术研究者

en.tag: A guardrailed Generative UI framework for safe, predictable AI-generated interfaces
en.what: json-render is a Generative UI framework that lets AI generate dynamic, personalized interfaces from natural language prompts without sacrificing reliability. It constrains model output to predefined components and actions for safe, predictable results.
en.content: The repo is a monorepo shipping the core @json-render/core package plus adapters for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, React Native, Next.js, Remotion, PDF, email, terminal Ink, and 3D scenes, with 36 pre-built shadcn/ui components included.
en.stack: Built in TypeScript with Zod schema validation, a JSON output protocol at its core, and frontend adapters for React/Vue/Svelte/Solid plus integrations like shadcn/ui, react-three-fiber, and react-email.
en.hot: Backed by Vercel Labs and riding the hot Generative UI trend, it offers cross-platform support and a batteries-included component library, gaining 585 stars today to rank #4 on the TypeScript daily chart with 16,853 total.
uses: Frontend developers who want AI-generated UIs with reliable, constrained output
Teams needing one component catalog reused across React, Vue, Svelte, or React Native
Indie developers and PMs prototyping Generative UI or AI-driven apps quickly
Researchers exploring Generative UI, structured LLM output, and safety guardrails

zh.tag: 面向一人公司的 AI 内容营销与多平台变现智能体
zh.what: AiToEarn 是一个一站式 AI 内容营销平台，通过 AI Agent 自动化帮助一人公司、创作者和品牌构建、分发并变现内容。它打通抖音、小红书、B站、TikTok、YouTube、X 等十余个主流平台，覆盖创作、发布、互动与变现全流程。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 源码为主体，包含 Web 端、Docker 部署方案、API Key 与开放平台文档，并提供网站、OpenClaw、Claude/Cursor、Docker、源码五种使用方式。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，要求 Node.js 20.18.x，采用 MIT 许可，支持 Docker 私有化部署，并集成多家 AI 图片/视频生成 API。
zh.hot: 项目已获 26281 颗星，今日新增 92，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜 TypeScript 第 7 名，切中创作者用 AI 做内容变现的刚需。
uses: 一人公司/独立创作者：用 AI 批量生成并分发内容到多平台
品牌与中小企业：统一管理跨平台内容营销与互动
开发者/团队：通过 Docker 或源码私有化部署并接入自有模型
AI 工具用户：在 Claude、Cursor 或 OpenClaw 中直接调用其能力

en.tag: An AI content-marketing and monetization agent for one-person companies
en.what: AiToEarn is an all-in-one AI content-marketing platform that uses AI agents to automate building, distributing and monetizing content for one-person companies, creators and brands. It connects over a dozen major platforms such as Douyin, Rednote, Bilibili, TikTok, YouTube and X, covering creation, publishing, engagement and monetization.
en.content: The repo is mainly TypeScript source, including a web app, Docker deployment, API Key and open-platform docs, and offers five usage paths: website, OpenClaw, Claude/Cursor, Docker and source.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript, requires Node.js 20.18.x, is MIT-licensed, supports Docker self-hosting, and integrates multiple AI image/video generation APIs.
en.hot: It has 26,281 stars with 92 added today, ranking 7th on GitHub Trending's daily TypeScript list, hitting the real demand for AI-driven content monetization.
uses: One-person companies and solo creators: batch-generate and distribute content across platforms with AI
Brands and SMBs: centrally manage cross-platform content marketing and engagement
Developers/teams: self-host via Docker or source and plug in their own models
AI tool users: call its capabilities directly inside Claude, Cursor or OpenClaw

zh.tag: AI 驱动的英语学习工具与开源方法论
zh.what: 这是一个结合 AI 助教与开源英语学习方法的项目，提供网页版、浏览器插件和桌面应用，帮助用户通过视频、电子书、闪卡和课程等功能高效学习英语。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Enjoy 应用（网页版、浏览器插件、桌面版）的源代码，以及《人人都能用英语》电子书和《一千小时》训练体系的文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，依赖现代前端框架和 AI 服务，支持多平台部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 AI 外语学习的热门趋势和实用的开源工具，该项目已获得 37798 颗星，今日新增 48 星，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜第 12 名。
uses: 英语学习者 —— 利用 AI 助教和丰富资源提升英语能力
开发者 —— 学习 TypeScript 和 AI 集成，或贡献代码
教育工作者 —— 参考开源方法论设计课程

en.tag: AI-powered English learning tool and open-source methodology
en.what: This project combines an AI teaching assistant with open-source English learning methods, offering a web app, browser extension, and desktop app to help users learn English efficiently through videos, e-books, flashcards, and courses.
en.content: The repository contains the source code for the Enjoy app (web, browser extension, desktop), along with the e-book 'Everyone Can Use English' and documentation for the '1000 Hours' training system.
en.stack: Primarily built with TypeScript, relying on modern frontend frameworks and AI services, supporting multi-platform deployment.
en.hot: With the trending popularity of AI language learning and its practical open-source tools, the project has gained 37,798 stars, adding 48 today, ranking 12th on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: English learners — leverage AI assistant and rich resources to improve English skills
Developers — learn TypeScript and AI integration, or contribute to the code
Educators — refer to the open-source methodology for course design

zh.tag: 基于 P2P 的开源端到端加密文件传输工具
zh.what: DashBeam 是一款免费开源的文件传输工具，基于 iroh 的现代点对点网络技术，让文件直接在设备间传输而不经过云服务器存储。它支持链接、二维码、配对设备和局域网三种发送方式，全程端到端加密且无需账号。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编写的跨平台客户端（桌面、Android、CLI、浏览器）源码、多语言 README 文档（含中、日、韩等 12 种语言）、演示 GIF 与头图资源，以及发布配置和 Discord 社区入口。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，底层依赖 iroh 的 P2P 网络栈，使用 BLAKE3 做文件校验、TLS 1.3 实现端到端加密，并支持自建中继服务器。
zh.hot: 凭借近 9.8k star 和本周 191 新增登上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 周榜第 17 名，其免安装、免账号、直连加密的体验切中了用户对 WeTransfer 等云盘中转方案的不满。
uses: 需要频繁在设备间传输大文件的开发者和运维人员
注重隐私、不想把文件上传到第三方云盘的用户
在局域网内多设备协作、希望免安装快速传文件的团队
想自建中继、完全掌控传输链路的自托管爱好者

en.tag: Open-source P2P end-to-end encrypted file transfer tool
en.what: DashBeam is a free and open-source file transfer tool built on iroh's cutting-edge peer-to-peer networking, moving files directly between devices without cloud storage. It supports link, QR code, paired-device, and LAN sending routes, all end-to-end encrypted with no account required.
en.content: The repo contains TypeScript source for cross-platform clients (desktop, Android, CLI, browser), multilingual README docs in 12 languages, demo GIF and header assets, plus release configuration and a Discord community link.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, it relies on iroh's P2P networking stack, uses BLAKE3 for file verification and TLS 1.3 for end-to-end encryption, and supports self-hosted relays.
en.hot: With nearly 9.8k stars and 191 added this week, it ranks 17th on GitHub Trending's TypeScript weekly chart, resonating with users frustrated by cloud-broker services like WeTransfer thanks to its no-install, no-account, direct encrypted transfers.
uses: Developers and ops staff who frequently move large files between devices
Privacy-conscious users who don't want files stored on third-party clouds
Teams collaborating across multiple devices on a LAN needing quick no-install transfers
Self-hosting enthusiasts who want to run their own relay and control the transfer path

zh.tag: 把任意 GitHub 仓库变成交互式架构图与一分钟讲解视频
zh.what: GitDiagram 能把任意公开或私有 GitHub 仓库自动转成可交互的架构图，并附上 AI 流式讲解。它还能生成约一分钟的旁白讲解视频，把项目做什么、主要模块如何组合讲清楚。
zh.content: 核心是一个 Next.js Web 应用，包含图表生成、视频讲解、私有仓库接入与导出等模块，另有 docs 目录存放架构与开发配置说明。
zh.stack: 基于 Next.js、React、TypeScript、Tailwind CSS 和 Mermaid 构建，视频脚本用 Claude、配音用 ElevenLabs，部署在 Vercel，本地需 Bun、Cloudflare R2、Upstash Redis 与 OpenAI/OpenRouter 密钥。
zh.hot: 它把「读代码」变成「看图看视频」，只需把 URL 里的 hub 换成 diagram 即可使用，本周新增 930 star、总数突破 1.7 万，冲上 TypeScript 周榜第 13。
uses: 刚接手陌生代码库、需要快速理解整体架构的开发者
做技术分享或新人 onboarding、想用视频讲解项目的团队
需要给私有仓库生成架构图并导出 PNG/Mermaid 的工程师

en.tag: Turn any GitHub repo into an interactive architecture diagram and a one-minute explainer video
en.what: GitDiagram turns any public or private GitHub repository into an interactive architecture diagram with a streamed AI explanation. It can also generate a roughly one-minute narrated video covering what the project does and how its main parts fit together.
en.content: It is a Next.js web app with modules for diagram generation, video explainers, private-repo access, and exports, plus a docs folder with architecture and dev-setup guides.
en.stack: Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Mermaid; videos use Claude for scripts and ElevenLabs for voice, deployed on Vercel, with local setup needing Bun, Cloudflare R2, Upstash Redis, and an OpenAI/OpenRouter key.
en.hot: It turns code reading into watching a diagram or video, and works by swapping 'hub' for 'diagram' in any repo URL; it gained 930 stars this week to pass 17k, ranking 13th on the TypeScript weekly trending list.
uses: Developers who just inherited an unfamiliar codebase and need a quick architecture overview
Teams doing tech talks or onboarding who want a narrated video of a project
Engineers who need architecture diagrams of private repos exported as PNG or Mermaid

zh.tag: 免费无广告追剧资源人工精选指南，每日自动检测可用性
zh.what: 这是一个免费无广告的追剧资源导航项目，人工精选并分类收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕等资源。它通过 GitHub Actions 每天自动检测资源是否可用，并完全开源由社区共同维护。
zh.content: 仓库以 Markdown 清单为主体，配套 resources/resources.json 结构化数据，并包含 check-availability.yml 与 validate-data.yml 两个工作流脚本，以及 zhuiju.me 网站入口。

基于 Axum、Hyper、Tonic 等框架开发应用的团队

en.tag: The dominant asynchronous runtime and I/O platform for Rust
en.what: Tokio is an asynchronous runtime for Rust, offering event-driven non-blocking I/O, networking, task scheduling and timers. It lets developers write highly concurrent, reliable and slim applications with async/await, forming the foundation of Rust's async ecosystem.
en.content: The repository contains the main tokio crate plus sub-crates such as tokio-util, tokio-stream and tokio-macros, along with extensive examples, benchmarks, CI configuration and full documentation.

en.tag: A developer control plane to deploy, route, secure and observe A2A agents with one command
en.what: Nasiko is a developer control plane for AI agents that deploys, routes, secures and observes them with a single command. It natively speaks the A2A protocol, so any A2A-compatible agent can go to production without a gateway, sidecar or glue code.

zh.tag: 本地优先的多设备编码代理控制平面
zh.what: Zeron 是一个面向 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Devin 等编码代理的原生控制平面。它默认在本地运行，每台设备上的小型引擎把会话存在本机，无需账号或联网即可使用，并可选开启多设备同步。

en.tag: A local-first control plane for coding agents across devices
en.what: Zeron is a native control plane for coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Devin. It runs locally by default, with each device storing sessions on-device and no account or network required, plus optional multi-device sync.

zh.tag: 基于 GPUI 的 Rust 跨平台桌面 UI 组件库
zh.what: GPUI Kit 是一个用于构建高性能跨平台桌面应用的 Rust 框架，提供 60+ 生产级 UI 组件和完整的数据、布局、编辑能力。它基于 Zed 编辑器使用的 GPUI 构建，并支持 JavaScript 扩展。

zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 GPUI（Zed 编辑器使用的 GPU 加速 UI 框架），支持 macOS、Windows、Linux，集成 Tree-sitter、LSP 等。
zh.hot: 凭借 13.9K stars 和日增 179 登顶 Rust 日榜，因为它是首个将 GPUI 从 Zed 中解耦并打包成通用组件库的项目，填补了 Rust 桌面 UI 生态的空白。
uses: Rust 开发者希望用 Rust 构建跨平台桌面应用，并追求高性能和原生体验。
需要数据表格、虚拟列表、代码编辑器等复杂组件的桌面应用开发场景。

en.tag: Rust desktop UI component library built on GPUI for cross-platform apps
en.what: GPUI Kit is a Rust framework for building high-performance cross-platform desktop apps, offering 60+ production-ready UI components and full data, layout, and editing capabilities. It is built on GPUI, the UI framework used by Zed editor, and supports JavaScript extensions.
en.content: The repo contains three sub-crates: gpui-base (unstyled behavior, state, and infrastructure), gpui-shell (JavaScript extensions), and gpui-component (complete styled UI system). The main crate re-exports all layers, so apps only need to depend on gpui-kit.
en.stack: Built on Rust and GPUI (GPU-accelerated UI framework used by Zed editor), supports macOS, Windows, Linux, integrates Tree-sitter, LSP, etc.
en.hot: With 13.9K stars and +179 today, it tops the Rust daily chart as the first project to decouple GPUI from Zed and package it as a general-purpose component library, filling a gap in the Rust desktop UI ecosystem.

Desktop app development requiring complex components like data tables, virtual lists, and code editors.
Teams that want to reuse Zed's UI capabilities without depending on Zed directly.

zh.tag: 面向自主智能体的高密度安全沙箱运行时
zh.what: Agent Substrate 是一个默认安全的智能体执行运行时，能在标准容器运行时基础上以 10 倍密度运行数百万个沙箱。它把大量「actor」（如智能体应用）映射到少量就绪的「worker」上，利用智能体大部分时间空闲的特性实现重度多路复用，并支持 microVM、gVisor 等多种沙箱技术。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 Go 编写的核心系统，提供 actor 生命周期管理（创建/销毁、挂起/恢复）、实时调度到 worker 以及流量路由；还附带演示视频和集群复现指南，展示约 250 个有状态 actor 在 8 个物理 Pod 上的多路复用。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，底层依赖 Kubernetes 进行基础设施供给和 worker（Pod）生命周期管理，并集成 microVM、gVisor 等沙箱技术，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。
zh.hot: 今日新增 498 星、总星数 2606，登上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 4 名；其「10 倍密度、亚 500ms 恢复、每秒 500+ 挂起/恢复」的指标切中了智能体规模化运行的基础设施痛点。
uses: 需要大规模运行自主智能体、追求高密度与低延迟的 AI 基础设施团队
在 Kubernetes 上构建端到端智能体部署、希望统一调度与隔离的平台工程师
研究 RL 场景中智能体、推理与训练循环协同优化的研究人员
关注零信任内核与网络隔离、需要安全沙箱运行不可信代码的开发者

en.tag: A secure-by-default, high-density sandbox runtime for autonomous agents
en.what: Agent Substrate is a secure-by-default agent execution runtime engineered to run millions of sandboxes at 10x the density of standard container runtimes. It maps many 'actors' (agent-like applications) onto a smaller pool of ready 'workers', exploiting the fact that agents are idle most of the time to achieve heavy multiplexing, and supports multiple sandbox technologies including microVMs and gVisor.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based core system offering actor lifecycle management (create/destroy, suspend/resume), real-time assignment to workers, and traffic routing, plus a demo video and cluster walkthrough showing ~250 stateful actors multiplexed across 8 physical pods.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it builds on Kubernetes for infrastructure provisioning and worker (Pod) lifecycle management, integrates sandbox technologies like microVMs and gVisor, and is licensed under Apache 2.0.
en.hot: It gained 498 stars today (2,606 total) and ranked #4 on GitHub Trending's Go daily list; its metrics—10x density, sub-500ms resume, and 500+ suspend/resume activations per second—hit the infrastructure pain point of running agents at scale.
uses: AI infrastructure teams needing to run autonomous agents at scale with high density and low latency
Platform engineers building end-to-end agent deployments on Kubernetes who want unified scheduling and isolation
Researchers optimizing RL scenarios that span agentic, inference, and training cycles
Developers needing secure sandboxes with zero-trust kernel and network isolation for untrusted code

en.what: Caddy is a modern web server written in Go that supports HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3, and automatically provisions and renews TLS certificates by default. en.tag: Open-source, self-hostable board where AI coding agents work like teammates
en.what: Multica is an open-source, self-hostable workspace where you assign issues to AI coding agents the way you would to a teammate. Agents pick up work, report progress, raise blockers, and hand it back for review, with support for 26 agent CLIs and no vendor lock-in.
en.content: The repo ships a Go-based server and board app, an apps/docs documentation site, self-hosting scripts (SELF_HOSTING.md), and vision docs such as VISION.md — a complete, locally deployable product.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, with a docs site and frontend app, CI workflows, release pipelines, and self-hosting support; it connects to many agent tools through a CLI adapter layer.

Open-source enthusiasts studying multi-agent task assignment and state synchronization

zh.tag: 用一份 YAML 定义并一键运行多容器 Docker 应用
zh.what: Docker Compose 是 Docker 官方的多容器编排工具，通过 Compose 文件格式（compose.yaml）声明式地定义应用所需的多个容器及其配置。写好文件后，一条 `docker compose up` 命令即可创建并启动整个应用，无需手动逐个运行容器。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Compose 的 Go 实现源码、CLI 插件入口、compose-spec 规范对接、测试用例与 CI 配置，并提供各平台发布二进制。
zh.stack: 主要用 Go 编写，依赖 Docker Engine API 与 compose-spec 规范，作为 Docker CLI 插件分发，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
zh.hot: 作为容器编排的事实标准工具，Compose 已积累 38,215 颗星，本周仍新增 79 星并登上 Go 周榜第 15 名，说明其在开发与 CI 场景中持续刚需。
uses: 本地开发多服务应用（如 Web + 数据库 + 缓存）的开发者
需要在 CI/CD 中快速拉起完整测试环境的工程团队
学习容器编排与微服务架构的初学者和教学场景
希望用声明式配置替代冗长 docker run 命令的运维人员

en.tag: Define and run multi-container Docker apps with a single YAML file
en.what: Docker Compose is Docker's official tool for orchestrating multi-container applications, using the Compose file format (compose.yaml) to declaratively define how one or more containers are configured. Once the file is written, a single `docker compose up` command creates and starts the entire application without manually running each container.
en.content: The repo contains the Go implementation of Compose, the CLI plugin entry point, integration with the compose-spec, tests and CI configs, plus release binaries for multiple platforms.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, it relies on the Docker Engine API and the compose-spec, ships as a Docker CLI plugin, and supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: As the de facto standard for container orchestration, Compose has accumulated 38,215 stars, adding 79 this week and ranking 15th on the Go weekly trending list, showing its enduring demand in dev and CI workflows.
uses: Developers running multi-service apps locally (e.g., web + database + cache)
Engineering teams needing to spin up full test environments in CI/CD
Beginners and educators learning container orchestration and microservices
Ops engineers wanting declarative configs instead of long docker run commands

zh.tag: 基于eBPF的云原生网络、安全与可观测性平台
zh.what: Cilium 是一个基于 eBPF 数据平面的网络、可观测性和安全解决方案。它提供简单的扁平三层网络，支持多集群原生路由或覆盖模式，并具备 L7 协议感知能力，可基于身份模型实施 L3-L7 网络策略。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Cilium 核心组件（如 agent、operator、CNI 插件）、eBPF 数据平面代码、文档、测试和部署清单。主要目录有 daemon、pkg、bpf、Documentation、operator 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Linux 内核 eBPF 技术，需要较新内核版本（通常 4.19+）。项目使用 Kubernetes 作为主要编排平台，并集成 Prometheus、Envoy 等生态组件。
zh.hot: Cilium 是 CNCF 毕业项目，拥有 25k+ stars，今日新增 20 stars，位列 Go 趋势榜第 20 名。作为 Kubernetes 网络、安全和可观测性的领先方案，它持续受到云原生社区的高度关注。
uses: Kubernetes 集群管理员：需要高性能、可扩展的网络方案来替代 kube-proxy。
云原生安全工程师：希望实施基于身份的网络策略和 L7 层安全控制。
平台运维团队：需要深度网络可观测性和故障排查能力。
服务网格架构师：寻求集成 ingress/egress 网关和带宽管理的一体化方案。

en.tag: eBPF-based networking, security, and observability for cloud native
en.what: Cilium is a networking, observability, and security solution with an eBPF-based dataplane. It provides a simple flat Layer 3 network that can span multiple clusters in native routing or overlay mode, and is L7-protocol aware, enforcing network policies on L3-L7 using an identity-based security model.
en.content: The repository contains Cilium core components (such as agent, operator, CNI plugin), eBPF dataplane code, documentation, tests, and deployment manifests. Main directories include daemon, pkg, bpf, Documentation, operator, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on Linux kernel eBPF technology and requiring a relatively new kernel (typically 4.19+). The project uses Kubernetes as the main orchestration platform and integrates with ecosystem components like Prometheus and Envoy.
en.hot: Cilium is a CNCF graduated project with 25k+ stars, gaining 20 stars today and ranking 20th on the Go trending list. As a leading solution for Kubernetes networking, security, and observability, it continues to attract significant attention from the cloud native community.
uses: Kubernetes cluster administrators: need a high-performance, scalable networking solution to replace kube-proxy.
Cloud native security engineers: want to implement identity-based network policies and L7 security controls.
Platform operations teams: require deep network observability and troubleshooting capabilities.
Service mesh architects: seek an integrated solution with ingress/egress gateways and bandwidth management.

zh.tag: 把本地或私有 MCP 服务器安全接入 OpenAI 产品的客户端
zh.what: tunnel-client 是 Secure MCP Tunnel 的客户侧代理，运行在用户自己的环境里，把私有或本地 localhost 上的 MCP 服务器通过 OpenAI 托管的隧道端点连到 ChatGPT、Codex、Responses API 和 AgentKit。它让 MCP 服务器无需暴露到公网，也无需新增入站防火墙规则。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的守护进程本体，以及 onboarding、architecture、permissions、deployment、troubleshooting、protocol 等文档和 openapi.json 规范，还提供 Go SDK 内存传输示例与内置 demo 工具。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，提供 /healthz、/readyz、/metrics、/ui 等运维端点，支持 Docker、Kubernetes、VM 部署，并通过 OpenAPI 与 X-Tunnel-Client-Capabilities 头支持多语言兼容客户端。
zh.hot: MCP 生态正热，而企业普遍不愿为本地 MCP 服务器开放公网入口，这个官方客户端正好解决安全接入痛点；今日新增 10 star，累计 433，登上 Go 日榜第 16 名。
uses: 在笔记本、VM、K8s 或私有网络中运行 MCP 服务器，需要让 ChatGPT/Codex 访问的开发者
安全团队不批准新增入站防火墙规则或公网端点的企业团队
需要可观测守护进程（健康检查、指标、UI）再接入连接器的运维人员
想用其他语言实现兼容客户端或把 MCP 嵌入 Go 进程的工程师

en.tag: Customer-run client bridging private or localhost MCP servers to OpenAI products
en.what: tunnel-client is the customer-run agent behind Secure MCP Tunnel. It connects a private or localhost MCP server to ChatGPT, Codex, the Responses API, and AgentKit through an OpenAI-hosted tunnel endpoint, keeping the MCP server off the public internet and avoiding new inbound firewall rules.
en.content: The repo contains the Go daemon itself plus docs for onboarding, architecture, permissions, deployment, troubleshooting, and protocol, along with an openapi.json spec, a Go SDK in-memory transport example, and built-in demo tools.
en.stack: Written in Go, it exposes /healthz, /readyz, /metrics, and /ui operational endpoints, supports Docker, Kubernetes, and VM deployment, and enables compatible clients in other languages via OpenAPI and the X-Tunnel-Client-Capabilities header.
en.hot: With MCP booming yet enterprises reluctant to expose local MCP servers publicly, this official client solves the secure-access pain point; it gained 10 stars today for 433 total, ranking 16th on the Go daily trending list.
uses: Developers running MCP servers on laptops, VMs, K8s, or private networks who need ChatGPT/Codex to reach them
Enterprise teams whose security won't approve new inbound firewall rules or public endpoints
Operators wanting an observable daemon with health checks, metrics, and UI before wiring up connectors
Engineers building compatible clients in other languages or embedding MCP directly in a Go process

zh.tag: 全能开源安全扫描器，覆盖容器、K8s、代码与云
zh.what: Trivy 是一款综合性的安全扫描工具，通过「目标 + 扫描器」的组合发现安全问题。它可扫描容器镜像、文件系统、Git 仓库、虚拟机镜像和 Kubernetes 集群，检测 CVE 漏洞、IaC 错误配置、敏感信息泄露、软件许可证以及生成 SBOM。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 Go 编写的 CLI 工具源码，包含 docs 文档与图片资源，并提供丰富的安装方式（brew、Docker、二进制）以及与 GitHub Actions、Kubernetes Operator、VS Code 插件等生态集成。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，以单二进制形式分发，可通过 Homebrew、Docker 镜像、GitHub Releases 及各大云市场安装，并支持 canary 构建。
zh.hot: 作为云原生安全领域的标杆工具，Trivy 已积累 38065 颗星，本周再增 116 星并登上 Go 周榜第 14 名，持续受益于 DevSecOps 与供应链安全的刚需。
uses: DevSecOps 工程师在 CI/CD 流水线中自动扫描镜像与代码
安全团队对 Kubernetes 集群和云环境做合规与漏洞巡检
开发者本地用 CLI 快速检查依赖漏洞、密钥泄露与许可证
平台团队集成 GitHub Actions 或 Operator 实现持续安全监控

en.tag: All-in-one open-source security scanner for containers, K8s, code and cloud
en.what: Trivy is a comprehensive security scanner built around the combination of targets and scanners. It scans container images, filesystems, Git repositories, VM images and Kubernetes clusters to detect CVEs, IaC misconfigurations, secrets, software licenses and to generate SBOMs.
en.content: The repo contains the Go source of the CLI tool, docs and image assets, plus many installation channels (brew, Docker, binaries) and ecosystem integrations such as GitHub Actions, a Kubernetes Operator and a VS Code plugin.
en.stack: Written in Go and shipped as a single binary, installable via Homebrew, Docker images, GitHub Releases and major cloud marketplaces, with canary builds on every main-branch push.
en.hot: As a flagship tool in cloud-native security, Trivy has reached 38,065 stars, adding 116 this week and ranking 14th on the Go weekly trending list, driven by the ongoing demand for DevSecOps and supply-chain security.

Security teams auditing Kubernetes clusters and cloud environments for compliance and vulnerabilities
Developers using the CLI locally to check dependency CVEs, leaked secrets and licenses
Platform teams integrating GitHub Actions or the Operator for continuous security monitoring

zh.tag: 基于自研 Xray 内核的 Web 代理客户端，支持全平台透明代理
zh.what: v2rayA 是一个以服务形式运行、通过浏览器操作的代理客户端，内置自研的 Xray 内核。它支持导入 VMess、VLESS、Shadowsocks、Trojan、Hysteria2、TUIC、WireGuard 等订阅与分享链接，按延迟自动选节点，并用 RoutingA 规则做流量分流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Web GUI 前端（gui/public 等静态资源）、平台安装包与 systemd 服务定义，以及 geoip.dat/geosite.dat 规则数据说明。
zh.stack: 主语言 Go，前端为 Web GUI；依赖自研 v2raya_core（Xray 内核）、geoip/geosite 规则数据，Linux 下需 iptables/nftables 或 tun 设备。
zh.hot: 作为老牌跨平台代理面板，v2rayA 累积了 15613 颗星，本周再增 54 星并登上 Go 周榜第 14 名，说明网络代理与透明代理需求持续旺盛。
uses: 需要在 Linux、Windows 或 macOS 上搭建透明代理的个人用户
在路由器或 NAS 上以服务方式运行代理并远程管理的玩家
希望用订阅链接统一管理多协议节点并自动测速选优的用户
想通过 RoutingA 规则实现精细流量分流的进阶用户

en.tag: A web client for its own Xray-based core with transparent proxy on Linux, Windows and macOS
en.what: v2rayA is a browser-operated proxy client that runs as a service and ships its own Xray-based core. It imports subscriptions and share links for VMess, VLESS, Shadowsocks, Trojan, Hysteria2, TUIC, WireGuard and more, picks the lowest-latency node, and splits traffic with RoutingA rules.
en.content: The repo contains a Go backend service, a web GUI frontend (static assets under gui/public), platform installers and systemd service definitions, plus docs for geoip.dat/geosite.dat rule data.
en.stack: Mainly Go with a web GUI frontend; depends on the bundled v2raya_core (Xray core), geoip/geosite rule data, and on Linux needs iptables/nftables or a tun device.
en.hot: As a long-standing cross-platform proxy panel, v2rayA has accumulated 15,613 stars, adding 54 this week and ranking 14th on the Go weekly trending list, showing steady demand for proxy and transparent-proxy tooling.
uses: Individuals who need transparent proxy on Linux, Windows or macOS
Enthusiasts running the proxy as a service on a router or NAS and managing it remotely
Users who want to manage multi-protocol nodes from subscriptions with automatic latency-based selection
Advanced users who want fine-grained traffic splitting via RoutingA rules

zh.tag: MCP 官方 Go SDK，与 Google 协作维护
zh.what: 这是 Model Context Protocol（MCP）的官方 Go 语言 SDK，用于构建 MCP 服务端与客户端。它力求完整实现 MCP 规范，让 Go 开发者能方便地把工具、资源接入 AI 应用生态。

想用 Go 构建 MCP 服务器并支持 OAuth 授权的工程师

en.tag: The official Go SDK for Model Context Protocol, built with Google
en.what: This is the official Go SDK for the Model Context Protocol (MCP), used to build MCP servers and clients. It aims to implement the full MCP spec, letting Go developers expose tools and resources to AI applications.
en.content: The repo is organized into packages: mcp for core client/server APIs, jsonrpc for custom transports, auth and oauthex for OAuth support, plus a docs/ directory mapping the spec to packages.
en.stack: Written in pure Go under the module github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk, relying on the standard library and OAuth components, with an OpenSSF Scorecard badge.

AI agent platform developers needing a standard server/client protocol implementation
Engineers building MCP servers in Go with OAuth authorization support

zh.tag: 云原生监控系统与时序数据库，指标采集、查询与告警一体化
zh.what: Prometheus 是一个开源的系统与服务监控系统，同时也是时序数据库。它按固定间隔从配置的目标拉取指标，评估规则表达式，展示结果，并在满足条件时触发告警。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Prometheus 服务端核心代码、PromQL 查询引擎、告警规则管理、服务发现集成、内置 Web UI 以及完整的文档和部署配置示例。

zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目，Prometheus 是云原生监控的事实标准，拥有超过 6.6 万颗星，本周新增 127 星，持续受到关注。

开发人员集成 Prometheus 客户端库以暴露自定义指标

en.tag: Cloud-native monitoring system and time series database for metrics collection, querying, and alerting
en.what: Prometheus is an open-source systems and service monitoring system that also functions as a time series database. It collects metrics from configured targets at given intervals, evaluates rule expressions, displays results, and triggers alerts when specified conditions are observed.
en.content: The repository contains the core Prometheus server, the PromQL query engine, alert rule management, service discovery integrations, a built-in web UI, and comprehensive documentation and deployment configuration examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go with minimal dependencies, featuring a single-node autonomous architecture and support for various service discovery mechanisms and remote storage integrations.

zh.tag: 比 LiteLLM 快 50 倍的企业级 AI 网关，统一接入 1000+ 模型

Ops teams wanting enterprise AI infra with monitoring and guardrails fast

zh.tag: 轻量级服务器监控平台，支持 Docker 统计、历史数据与告警
zh.what: Beszel 是一个轻量级的服务器监控平台，提供 Docker 统计、历史数据和告警功能。它拥有友好的 Web 界面，配置简单，开箱即用，并支持自动备份、多用户、OAuth 认证和 API 访问。

en.tag: Lightweight server monitoring with Docker stats, history, and alerts

en.tag: A Go-based multi-platform music search and download tool with 10+ sources and multiple clients
en.what: Go Music DL is a Go-based music search and download tool that aggregates over 10 major platforms including NetEase Cloud, QQ Music, Kugou, Bilibili, and Soda Music. It supports searching and parsing of songs, playlists, and albums, with lossless audio downloads, and offers Web, TUI, and desktop app modes.

zh.tag: 任天堂 Switch 定制固件，实现自定义系统与虚拟 NAND
zh.what: Atmosphère 是一个针对任天堂 Switch 的开源定制固件项目，通过替换和修改系统各个组件（如引导加载器、TrustZone、系统模块等）来实现自定义功能。它允许用户运行自制软件、备份和虚拟化 NAND 等。

en.tag: Custom firmware for Nintendo Switch enabling custom OS and emuNAND
en.what: Atmosphère is an open-source custom firmware for the Nintendo Switch that replaces and modifies various system components (such as bootloader, TrustZone, sysmodules) to enable custom features. It allows users to run homebrew, backup and virtualize NAND, and more.

zh.tag: 底层芯片级模拟经典 VA 合成器与效果器，直接跑原厂固件
zh.what: Gearmulator 通过模拟 90 年代末至 2000 年代经典虚拟模拟（VA）合成器与效果器所使用的 DSP 芯片，让原厂固件（ROM）以音频插件形式运行。它不重采样、不采样音色，而是逐指令模拟硬件芯片，从而还原真实音质与行为。
zh.content: 仓库包含针对多款设备的模拟核心与插件封装，如 Osirus（Access Virus A/B/C）、OsTIrus（Virus TI/TI2/Snow）、Vavra（Waldorf microQ）、Xenia（Microwave II/XT）、Nodal Red 2x（Nord Lead/Rack 2x）、JE-8086（Roland JP-8000）和 88emu（Roland CM/Sound Canvas 系列）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++17 编写，构建系统为 CMake，插件基于 JUCE 框架，支持 FST、VST3、AU、CLAP 和 LV2 格式，可在 64 位 x86 与 ARM aarch64（树莓派、Apple Silicon）上运行。
zh.hot: 本周新增 73 颗星，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜 C++ 第 12 名，总星数达 1387。复古硬件合成器价格高昂且难维护，这种能直接跑原厂 ROM 的底层模拟方案对音乐制作人和硬件爱好者极具吸引力。
uses: 音乐制作人与声音设计师，希望在 DAW 中免费获得经典硬件合成器的原厂音色

音频插件开发者，可参考其底层 DSP 芯片模拟与 JUCE 插件封装架构
Raspberry Pi 或 Apple Silicon 用户，可在 ARM 设备上运行这些插件

en.tag: Low-level IC emulation of classic VA synths and effects, running original firmware
en.what: Gearmulator emulates the DSP ICs used in classic late-90s/2000s virtual analog synths and effects, letting the original firmware (ROM) run as audio plugins. Instead of sampling or modeling, it emulates the hardware chips instruction by instruction to reproduce authentic sound and behavior.
en.content: The repo contains emulation cores and plugin wrappers for several devices: Osirus (Access Virus A/B/C), OsTIrus (Virus TI/TI2/Snow), Vavra (Waldorf microQ), Xenia (Microwave II/XT), Nodal Red 2x (Nord Lead/Rack 2x), JE-8086 (Roland JP-8000), and 88emu (Roland CM/Sound Canvas family).
en.stack: Written mainly in C++17 with CMake as the build system, plugins are built on the JUCE framework and support FST, VST3, AU, CLAP, and LV2 formats, running on 64-bit x86 and ARM aarch64 (Raspberry Pi, Apple Silicon).
en.hot: It gained 73 stars this week, ranking 12th on GitHub Trending's weekly C++ list, with 1,387 stars total. Vintage hardware synths are expensive and hard to maintain, so a low-level emulation that runs original ROMs is highly appealing to music producers and hardware enthusiasts.
uses: Music producers and sound designers who want authentic hardware synth sounds in their DAW for free
Vintage synth enthusiasts who want to experience Access Virus, Nord Lead, etc. without buying expensive hardware
Audio plugin developers interested in its low-level DSP chip emulation and JUCE plugin architecture
Raspberry Pi or Apple Silicon users who want to run these plugins on ARM devices

zh.tag: 纯C/C++的高性能LLM推理引擎
zh.what: llama.cpp 是一个用纯 C/C++ 编写的高性能大语言模型推理引擎，支持在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行。它针对本地部署和资源受限环境进行了优化，无需依赖庞大的深度学习框架。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理库 libllama、命令行工具、REST API 服务器（llama-server）以及 WebUI。支持多种量化格式（如 GGUF）和模型架构（如 LLaMA、GPT-OSS）。
zh.stack: 纯 C/C++ 实现，依赖 ggml 张量库，可选支持 CUDA、Vulkan、Metal 等 GPU 加速后端。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的本地 LLM 推理方案之一，llama.cpp 持续获得社区关注，今日新增 159 星，总星数突破 12 万。其高性能、跨平台和易用性使其成为 AI 开发者和爱好者的首选。
uses: AI 开发者：在本地或边缘设备上运行和测试大语言模型
隐私敏感用户：无需联网即可使用 LLM，数据完全本地化
研究人员：探索模型量化、推理优化和自定义模型架构

en.tag: High-performance LLM inference engine in pure C/C++
en.what: llama.cpp is a high-performance LLM inference engine written in pure C/C++, optimized for CPU and GPU execution. It enables efficient local deployment without heavy deep learning frameworks.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference library libllama, CLI tools, a REST API server (llama-server), and a WebUI. It supports various quantization formats (e.g., GGUF) and model architectures (e.g., LLaMA, GPT-OSS).
en.stack: Pure C/C++ implementation, relies on the ggml tensor library, with optional GPU backends like CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal.
en.hot: As one of the most popular local LLM inference solutions, llama.cpp continues to gain community traction with 159 new stars today, surpassing 120K total. Its performance, cross-platform support, and ease of use make it a top choice for AI developers and enthusiasts.
uses: AI developers: run and test LLMs locally or on edge devices
Privacy-conscious users: use LLMs offline with full data locality
Researchers: explore quantization, inference optimization, and custom model architectures

en.tag: Microsoft's official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs, running ternary models efficiently on CPUs

Students reproducing the BitNet paper and exploring GPU kernel extensions

zh.tag: 跨平台开源密码管理器，离线加密存储敏感信息

en.what: KeePassXC is a community-driven, cross-platform port of the Windows KeePass Password Safe, built to securely store and manage sensitive data such as usernames, passwords, URLs, attachments, and notes. zh.tag: 专为 RTX 5090 打造的单卡 C++/CUDA 推理引擎
zh.what: NInfer 是一个从零编写的 C++/CUDA 推理引擎，专门针对单张 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 上的特定 Qwen 检查点进行极致优化。它支持文本、图像和视频输入，可通过本地 CLI 或兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic 的 HTTP API 调用。运行时高度特化：单 GPU、单常驻模型、启动时固定 1 到 8 个并发请求容量。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++/CUDA 源码、CMake 构建系统，以及五个预注册的模型工件（Qwen3.6-27B、Qwen3.8-27B、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 groupwise-int 与 nvfp4 版本）。每个工件内嵌 tokenizer、聊天模板和媒体前端资源，需从 Hugging Face 单独下载。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 C++20、CUDA 13.1+（仅支持 sm_120a 架构）、CMake 3.28+、Ninja，并依赖 FFmpeg 开发库（libavformat/libavcodec/libavutil/libswscale）和 libcurl。要求 64 位 Linux 系统。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1306 颗星，总星数达 1600，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 C++ 第 10 名。它精准切中了 RTX 5090 用户对本地高性能单卡推理的需求，且以极致特化换取性能，在 AI 推理社区引发关注。
uses: 拥有 RTX 5090 并希望在本地运行 Qwen 大模型的开发者
需要低延迟、高吞吐单卡推理服务的 AI 应用部署者
