Game and visualization teams needing a plugin-free, cross-device 3D publishing solution
AR/VR developers building immersive web experiences with WebXR
Education or product demo scenarios that use 3D interaction to enhance engagement

zh.tag: 让 AI 写作更像人：检测并改写 AI 腔的智能体技能
zh.what: 这是一个可移植的 AI 代理技能，用于审计和重写内容，去除常见的 AI 写作模式（如“Certainly!”、空洞的修饰语等）。它支持重写、检测和原地编辑三种模式，并可选语音风格（casual/professional 等），兼容 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex 等主流代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个可安装的 skill 定义（SKILL.md）、检测引擎（JavaScript 实现）、演示 GIF 和文档。核心是一个规则驱动的检测器，可标记 13 类 AI 写作模式，并执行多轮重写以彻底清除残留。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，采用规则/模式匹配而非机器学习，轻量且可嵌入任何 agentskills.io 兼容的代理。无外部依赖，MIT 许可。
zh.hot: 3,598 星且单日新增 133，登上 JavaScript 趋势榜第 8。AI 生成内容泛滥，开发者急需让输出“去 AI 味”的工具，而它恰好以 agent skill 形式即插即用。
uses: 内容创作者：用 Claude Code 等代理批量改写文章，去除 AI 腔，提升可读性。
开发者：在 CI 或本地用 Detect 模式审计 AI 生成的文档/提交信息，避免机械感。
团队：统一内容风格，通过 voice profile 定制专业、轻松或温暖等语气。
AI 代理开发者：集成此 skill 到自定义代理，增强文本后处理能力。

en.tag: Audit & rewrite AI-sounding text into natural prose, as a portable agent skill
en.what: A portable skill for AI agents that audits and rewrites content to remove common AI writing patterns ('AI-isms'). It offers three modes—rewrite, detect, and edit-in-place—plus optional voice profiles, and works with agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Codex.
en.content: The repo contains a portable skill definition (SKILL.md), a JavaScript-based detection engine, a demo GIF, and docs. The core is a rule-driven detector that flags 13 categories of AI patterns and performs multi-pass rewriting to catch leftovers.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, using rule/pattern matching rather than ML, so it's lightweight and embeddable in any agentskills.io-compatible agent. No external dependencies, MIT licensed.
en.hot: With 3,598 stars and +133 today, it hit #8 on the JavaScript trending list. As AI-generated content floods the web, developers crave tools to make output sound human, and this skill plugs directly into their favorite agents.
uses: Content creators: use with Claude Code to rewrite articles in bulk, removing AI-isms for better readability.
Developers: run Detect mode in CI or locally to audit AI-generated docs/commit messages for robotic tone.
Teams: standardize content tone via voice profiles (casual, professional, warm, etc.).
Agent builders: integrate this skill into custom agents to enhance text post-processing.

zh.tag: 自托管监控工具，界面美观，功能强大
zh.what: Uptime Kuma 是一个易于使用的自托管监控工具，用于监控 HTTP(s)、TCP、Ping、DNS 等服务的在线状态。它提供美观、响应式的界面，并支持多种通知方式，如 Telegram、Discord 等。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的监控工具源代码，包括前端界面（Vue.js）、后端服务（Node.js）、Docker 部署配置，以及多语言翻译文件和通知组件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，前端基于 Vue.js，后端使用 Node.js，支持 Docker 部署，并集成了多种通知服务。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 9 万 star，因其自托管、开源免费且功能丰富而广受欢迎，今日新增 51 星，持续活跃。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队自建监控服务，无需依赖第三方平台
需要监控多个网站或 API 并希望自定义通知方式的用户
对数据隐私敏感，希望数据完全掌握在自己手中的用户

en.tag: A fancy self-hosted monitoring tool with a beautiful UI
en.what: Uptime Kuma is an easy-to-use self-hosted monitoring tool for tracking the uptime of HTTP(s), TCP, Ping, DNS, and other services. It features a fancy, reactive UI and supports notifications via Telegram, Discord, and 90+ other services.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the monitoring tool, including the frontend UI (Vue.js), backend service (Node.js), Docker deployment configs, and translation files and notification components.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, with a Vue.js frontend and Node.js backend, Docker deployment support, and integration with numerous notification services.
en.hot: With over 90k stars, it's popular for being self-hosted, open-source, and feature-rich, gaining 51 stars today and remaining highly active.
uses: Individual developers or small teams who want to self-host monitoring without third-party dependencies
Users who need to monitor multiple websites or APIs and want customizable notifications
Users who are privacy-conscious and want full control over their data

zh.tag: 英国 GCHQ 出品的浏览器端网络数据处理瑞士军刀
zh.what: CyberChef 是一个纯浏览器运行的网络数据处理工具，把编码、加密、压缩、哈希、解析等数百种操作组合成可视化「配方」流水线。用户无需编写代码，即可对文本、十六进制、二进制数据做复杂的转换与分析。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心操作库（src/core/operations）、Web 前端界面、Node.js API、CLI 以及完整的测试与构建脚本，可 Docker 部署或从源码构建。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，依赖 Node.js v24 构建，前端基于 Web 技术，提供 Docker 镜像和 npm 包，遵循 Apache 2.0 许可。
zh.hot: 作为 GCHQ 开源的经典安全工具，它凭借 35,944 颗星和本月 331 新增星，持续吸引安全分析师和开发者，位列 JavaScript 月榜第 18 名。
uses: 网络安全分析师用于快速解码、解密和取证分析
CTF 参赛者处理编码、加密和隐写挑战
开发人员调试数据格式与协议解析问题
非技术用户通过可视化界面完成复杂数据转换

en.tag: GCHQ's browser-based Cyber Swiss Army Knife for data manipulation
en.what: CyberChef is a browser-based tool that chains hundreds of cyber operations—encoding, encryption, compression, hashing, parsing—into visual 'recipes'. Users can perform complex data transformations and analysis on text, hex, or binary without writing code.
en.content: The repo contains the core operation library (src/core/operations), the web frontend, a Node.js API, a CLI, plus full test and build scripts, deployable via Docker or from source.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, built with Node.js v24, frontend uses web technologies, ships as a Docker image and npm package under Apache 2.0.
en.hot: As a classic open-source security tool from GCHQ, it holds 35,944 stars with 331 added this month, continuously attracting security analysts and developers, ranking 18th on the JavaScript monthly trending list.
uses: Security analysts for quick decoding, decryption, and forensic analysis
CTF players tackling encoding, encryption, and steganography challenges
Developers debugging data formats and protocol parsing
Non-technical users performing complex data transformations via a visual interface

zh.tag: 一条命令为你的硬件找到最合适的 LLM 模型
zh.what: llmfit 是一个终端工具，能根据你的系统 RAM、CPU 和 GPU 自动检测硬件，并为数百个模型和提供商评分，告诉你哪些模型能在你的机器上流畅运行。它提供交互式 TUI 和经典 CLI 两种模式，支持多 GPU、MoE 架构、动态量化选择、速度估算以及本地运行时提供商（如 Ollama、llama.cpp 等）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、TUI 和 CLI 实现、基准测试指南（docs/benchmarking.md）、TUI 指南（docs/tui.md），以及用于演示的 demo.gif 和图标资源。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和模型推理后端（Ollama、llama.cpp、MLX 等），通过 crates.io 分发。
zh.hot: 星标数达 32k，今日新增近 200，因其解决了本地 LLM 选型的痛点，且新版本支持基准测试并贡献结果，让用户获得真实硬件上的实测数据，迅速走红。
uses: 本地 LLM 爱好者：快速找到适合自己电脑配置的模型，避免下载后跑不动的尴尬。
开发者：在开发环境中评估不同模型的性能，优化推理速度和资源占用。
硬件评测者：通过基准测试功能，分享自己机器上的实测数据，帮助社区完善模型适配信息。

en.tag: One command to find the right LLM for your hardware
en.what: llmfit is a terminal tool that detects your hardware and scores hundreds of models across quality, speed, fit, and context dimensions, telling you which ones will run well on your machine. It features an interactive TUI and classic CLI mode, supporting multi-GPU setups, MoE architectures, dynamic quantization, speed estimation, and local runtime providers like Ollama and llama.cpp.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, TUI and CLI implementations, benchmarking guide (docs/benchmarking.md), TUI guide (docs/tui.md), plus demo.gif and icon assets.
en.stack: Built with Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and model inference backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, etc.), distributed via crates.io.
en.hot: With 32k stars and ~200 new today, it solves the pain point of choosing the right local LLM, and the new benchmarking feature lets users contribute real measured data, driving its popularity.
uses: Local LLM enthusiasts: quickly find models that fit your hardware, avoiding downloads that won't run.
Developers: evaluate model performance in dev environments to optimize inference speed and resource usage.
Hardware reviewers: use benchmarking to share real measured data and improve community model-fit information.

zh.tag: 为无服务器计算打造的安全高速 microVM 虚拟化技术
zh.what: Firecracker 是 AWS 开源的轻量级虚拟化技术，用 microVM 运行容器与函数工作负载。它把硬件虚拟化的安全隔离性与容器的速度、灵活性结合起来，专为多租户无服务器场景设计。
zh.content: 核心是一个基于 Linux KVM 的虚拟机监控器（VMM），采用极简设计，剔除多余设备与 guest 功能以缩小内存占用和攻击面；仓库还包含构建工具链、快速入门与生产主机配置文档。
zh.stack: 主要用 Rust 编写，依赖 Linux KVM 与 Unix/Linux 主机环境，可通过 Docker 开发容器和 bash 脚本构建。
zh.hot: 作为 AWS Lambda 与 Fargate 的底层虚拟化引擎，Firecracker 是云原生安全隔离的事实标准之一，本月新增 707 star、总数达 36739，稳居 Rust 月榜第 12 名。
uses: 云平台与无服务器服务商：需要安全多租户隔离的容器/函数运行环境
容器运行时开发者：如 Kata Containers、Flintlock 等集成 microVM 隔离
基础设施与安全工程师：评估轻量虚拟化的启动速度、内存开销与攻击面
学习虚拟化与 KVM 的 Rust 开发者：研究生产级 VMM 实现

en.tag: Secure and fast microVMs for serverless computing
en.what: Firecracker is an open-source virtualization technology from AWS that runs container and function workloads inside lightweight microVMs. It combines the security and isolation of hardware virtualization with the speed and flexibility of containers, purpose-built for multi-tenant serverless services.
en.content: At its core is a minimalist KVM-based virtual machine monitor (VMM) that strips out unnecessary devices and guest-facing features to cut memory footprint and attack surface; the repo also ships a build toolchain, quickstart guide, and production host setup docs.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it relies on Linux KVM and a Unix/Linux host, and can be built via a Docker dev container and bash scripts.
en.hot: As the virtualization engine behind AWS Lambda and Fargate, Firecracker is a de facto standard for secure cloud-native isolation, gaining 707 stars this month for a total of 36,739 and ranking 12th on the monthly Rust trending list.
uses: Cloud and serverless providers needing secure multi-tenant isolation for containers and functions
Container runtime developers integrating microVM isolation, such as Kata Containers and Flintlock
Infrastructure and security engineers evaluating lightweight virtualization for boot speed, memory overhead, and attack surface
Rust developers learning virtualization and KVM by studying a production-grade VMM

zh.tag: Rust 开源 CAD，支持 2D/3D 与 DWG/DXF 原生读写
zh.what: Open CAD Studio 是一个用 Rust 构建的开源 CAD 应用，提供 2D 绘图和 3D 建模功能，支持桌面端和 Web 端。它能够原生读写 DWG 和 DXF 文件，无需转换服务，并利用 GPU 加速渲染。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 CAD 应用源码，涵盖桌面端和 Web 端，提供统一的编辑核心。项目包含多语言 README、资源文件（如 logo）、示例工作区截图，以及用于 Web 部署的站点目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，并可能涉及 WebAssembly（用于 Web 端）、GPU 渲染库（如 wgpu）以及 DWG/DXF 解析库。具体依赖需查看 Cargo.toml。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，今日新增 46 星，总星数达 1166，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 6。其亮点在于用 Rust 实现 CAD，提供原生 DWG/DXF 支持，填补了开源 CAD 领域的空白。
uses: 工程师和设计师需要免费、跨平台的 CAD 工具进行 2D 制图或 3D 建模。
开发者希望研究或扩展一个基于 Rust 的现代 CAD 应用，或贡献代码。
教育机构或学生需要学习 CAD 概念，并希望使用开源软件进行实践。
需要处理 DWG/DXF 文件但不想依赖商业软件或在线转换服务的用户。

en.tag: Open-source CAD in Rust: 2D/3D drawing, native DWG/DXF, GPU rendering
en.what: Open CAD Studio is an open-source CAD application built with Rust, offering 2D drafting and 3D modeling for desktop and web. It natively reads and writes DWG and DXF files without conversion services, with GPU-accelerated rendering.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the CAD app, covering desktop and web with a shared editing core. It includes multi-language READMEs, assets like logo, workspace screenshots, and a site directory for web deployment.
en.stack: Primarily built with Rust, likely using WebAssembly for the web version, GPU rendering libraries like wgpu, and DWG/DXF parsing crates. Specific dependencies are in Cargo.toml.
en.hot: The project is gaining traction on GitHub, with 46 stars today and 1166 total, ranking #6 on the Rust trending list. Its novelty lies in a Rust-based CAD with native DWG/DXF support, filling a gap in open-source CAD.
uses: Engineers and designers needing a free, cross-platform CAD tool for 2D drafting or 3D modeling.
Developers interested in studying or extending a modern Rust-based CAD application or contributing code.
Educational institutions or students learning CAD concepts with open-source software.
Users who need to handle DWG/DXF files without relying on commercial software or online conversion services.

zh.tag: 纯 Rust 的即时模式 GUI 库，Web 与原生通吃
zh.what: egui 是一个用纯 Rust 编写的简单、快速、高度可移植的即时模式 GUI 库。它既能跑在 Web 上，也能原生运行于 Linux、Mac、Windows、Android，还能嵌入各种游戏引擎。官方框架 eframe 让开发者用同一套代码构建跨平台应用。
zh.content: 仓库以 Rust crate 形式组织，核心是 egui 库，配套官方框架 eframe，另有 examples/ 示例目录、集成适配层以及文档与 Discord 社区。
zh.stack: 纯 Rust 实现，禁止 unsafe，依赖极少；通过 eframe 支持 Web（WASM）、桌面与 Android，可对接 wgpu/glow 等渲染后端。
zh.hot: 已积累约 30,602 颗星，本月新增 573，位列 GitHub Trending 月榜 Rust 第 23 名；Rust GUI 生态长期缺位，egui 以易用和跨平台成为热门选择。
uses: Rust 开发者想快速给自己的工具或原型加上图形界面
需要一套代码同时发布 Web 与桌面应用的团队
游戏或引擎开发者想在渲染循环里嵌入调试/编辑器 UI
对 unsafe 敏感、追求内存安全 GUI 方案的项目

en.tag: An easy-to-use immediate mode GUI in pure Rust, running on both web and native
en.what: egui is a simple, fast and highly portable immediate mode GUI library written in pure Rust. It runs on the web, natively on Linux/Mac/Windows/Android, and inside your favorite game engine. The official eframe framework lets you build cross-platform apps from a single codebase.
en.content: The repo is organized as Rust crates: the core egui library, the official eframe framework, an examples/ folder, integration adapters, plus docs and a Discord community.
en.stack: Pure Rust with unsafe forbidden and minimal dependencies; eframe targets Web (WASM), desktop and Android, and can plug into renderers like wgpu/glow.
en.hot: It has around 30,602 stars with 573 added this month, ranking 23rd on GitHub Trending's monthly Rust list; with Rust's GUI ecosystem long underserved, egui stands out for ease of use and portability.
uses: Rust developers who want to quickly add a GUI to tools or prototypes
Teams that need one codebase shipping both web and desktop apps
Game or engine developers embedding debug/editor UI in the render loop
Projects sensitive to unsafe code that want a memory-safe GUI solution

zh.tag: 谷歌开源的 AI 文件类型识别工具，毫秒级精准检测
zh.what: Magika 是谷歌开源的 AI 文件内容类型检测工具，利用深度学习模型识别文件真实格式，而非仅依赖扩展名。它基于约 1 亿样本、200 多种内容类型训练，平均准确率约 99%，单 CPU 即可毫秒级完成识别。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心实现与预训练模型，并提供 Python、Node.js、Go 等多语言绑定、命令行工具及测试数据集。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写以保证性能，模型体积仅几 MB，通过 PyPI、NPM、Go module 等渠道分发，并提供 Python/JS/Go 接口。
zh.hot: 作为谷歌安全团队实际用于 Gmail、Drive、Safe Browsing 的成熟工具，且已集成 VirusTotal 与 abuse.ch，本月新增 703 star，累计 18.6k，热度持续。
uses: 安全工程师：用于恶意文件检测与内容策略路由
开发者：在应用中集成精准的文件类型识别能力
数据平台团队：清洗和分类海量异构文件
研究人员：研究 AI 文件类型检测与模型优化

en.tag: Google's AI-powered file type detection, accurate in milliseconds
en.what: Magika is Google's open-source AI-powered file content type detection tool that identifies a file's true format using deep learning rather than relying on extensions. Trained on ~100M samples across 200+ content types, it reaches ~99% average accuracy and runs in milliseconds even on a single CPU.
en.content: The repo ships a Rust core with a pretrained model, plus Python, Node.js, and Go bindings, a CLI, and test datasets.
en.stack: The core is written in Rust for performance, with a model of only a few MB, distributed via PyPI, NPM, and Go modules with Python/JS/Go APIs.
en.hot: As a mature tool actually used by Google security for Gmail, Drive, and Safe Browsing, and integrated with VirusTotal and abuse.ch, it gained 703 stars this month, reaching 18.6k total.
uses: Security engineers: malware detection and content policy routing
Developers: integrate accurate file type identification into apps
Data platform teams: clean and classify massive heterogeneous files
Researchers: study AI file type detection and model optimization

zh.tag: 用 Rust 写的本地优先罗技 Options+ 替代品
zh.what: OpenLogi 是一个开源的罗技外设配置工具，通过 HID++ 协议直接与设备通信，支持按键重映射、DPI 调节和 SmartShift 等功能。它无需罗技账号，不收集遥测数据，所有配置以本地 TOML 文件保存，强调隐私和本地优先。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个组件：OpenLogi GUI（GPUI 桌面应用，提供交互式鼠标图示、按键动作选择器、DPI 预设、SmartShift、RGB 键盘灯效、按应用配置文件等）、OpenLogi agent（后台服务，负责输入钩子和设备 I/O）以及相关的文档和配置示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，GUI 基于 GPUI（Zed 编辑器所用的框架），通过 HID++ 协议与罗技设备通信，支持 Logi Bolt、Unifying 接收器、蓝牙直连和 USB 连接。
zh.hot: 作为罗技官方 Options+ 的开源替代品，它解决了用户对官方软件臃肿、遥测和账号要求的痛点，在 Rust 社区和追求隐私的用户中迅速走红，GitHub 星标已超 8600，今日新增 115。
uses: 罗技外设用户：希望摆脱官方 Options+ 的臃肿和遥测，获得本地优先的配置体验
Rust 开发者：对 GPUI 桌面应用开发或 HID++ 协议实现感兴趣的开发者
隐私倡导者：拒绝账号绑定和数据收集，偏好开源软件的用户

en.tag: A native, local-first Logitech Options+ alternative in Rust
en.what: OpenLogi is an open-source Logitech peripheral configuration tool that communicates directly with devices via HID++, supporting button remapping, DPI adjustment, and SmartShift. It requires no Logitech account, collects no telemetry, and stores all configuration in local TOML files, emphasizing privacy and local-first principles.
en.content: The repository contains three components: OpenLogi GUI (a GPUI desktop app with interactive mouse diagram, per-button action picker, DPI presets, SmartShift, RGB keyboard lighting, per-application profiles), OpenLogi agent (background service owning input hook and device I/O), plus documentation and config examples.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, the GUI is built with GPUI (the framework used by Zed editor), communicates with Logitech devices via HID++ protocol, supporting Logi Bolt, Unifying receivers, Bluetooth-direct, and USB connections.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Logitech's official Options+, it addresses user pain points with bloat, telemetry, and account requirements, quickly gaining popularity in the Rust community and among privacy-conscious users, with over 8.6k stars and 115 added today.
uses: Logitech peripheral users who want a local-first config experience without bloat and telemetry
Rust developers interested in GPUI desktop app development or HID++ protocol implementation
Privacy advocates who reject account requirements and data collection, preferring open-source software

zh.tag: 不发送邮件即可验证邮箱是否真实存在的 Rust 工具
zh.what: 通过 SMTP 握手、MX 记录查询、语法与域名校验等方式，判断一个邮箱地址是否真实可投递，全程不发送任何邮件。提供 Rust 库、CLI 和 Docker 化的 HTTP 后端三种使用形态。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Rust 库（crates.io 发布）、独立 CLI 工具、以及一个基于 Docker 的 HTTP 后端（backend 目录），另有 GitHub Actions 工作流与完整文档。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Tokio 异步运行时与 trust-dns 做 DNS/MX 解析，通过 SMTP 协议探测；后端以 Docker 镜像发布，支持 SOCKS5 代理。

en.tag: Verify if an email address exists without sending any email, in Rust
en.what: It checks whether an email address is real and deliverable by performing SMTP handshakes, MX lookups, syntax and domain validation, all without actually sending any email. It ships as a Rust library, a CLI, and a Dockerized HTTP backend.

en.stack: Written in Rust, it relies on the Tokio async runtime and trust-dns for DNS/MX resolution, probing via the SMTP protocol; the backend ships as a Docker image and supports SOCKS5 proxies.
en.hot: Email verification is a high-frequency need for marketing and signup fraud prevention, and this pure-Rust, self-hostable tool gained 584 stars this month, passing 10k total and ranking 16th on the monthly Rust chart.
uses: Email marketing teams: clean recipient lists to cut bounce rates and protect sender reputation
SaaS signup fraud prevention: validate emails in real time to block fake accounts
Rust developers: embed as a library or self-host the HTTP backend API
Data cleaning: batch-verify the quality of scraped or imported email data

zh.tag: Cloudflare Tunnel 官方命令行客户端，安全连接内网服务
zh.what: cloudflared 是 Cloudflare Tunnel 的守护进程和命令行客户端，它在 Cloudflare 网络与你的源站之间建立加密隧道，将外部请求代理到内部服务，无需在防火墙上开放端口。它还支持通过隧道访问 TCP 服务（如 SSH、RDP），并可与 WARP 客户端配合使用。

uses: 运维工程师：安全地将内部 Web 服务发布到公网，无需开放防火墙端口

en.tag: Official CLI client for Cloudflare Tunnel, securely connecting private services
en.what: cloudflared is the daemon and command-line client for Cloudflare Tunnel, creating a secure tunnel between Cloudflare's network and your origin to proxy traffic without opening firewall ports. en.content: The repository contains the Go source code for cloudflared, build scripts, tests, and documentation links. Main functionalities are divided into tunnel management (cloudflared tunnel) and accessing protected services (cloudflared access).
en.stack: Developed in Go, it depends on Cloudflare's quic-go and other libraries, supporting multiple platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows) and package formats (binary, Docker, Debian, RPM, Homebrew).
en.hot: As Cloudflare's official tunnel client, it addresses the pain point of securely exposing internal services, gaining 446 stars this month and reaching 15,683 total stars, ranking 20th on GitHub Trending monthly (Go).
uses: DevOps engineers: securely expose internal web services to the internet without opening firewall ports
Developers: remotely access SSH, RDP, and other TCP services at home or office via tunnels
Enterprise IT: implement zero-trust access to private applications with Cloudflare Zero Trust

en.tag: A netcat alternative over Tailscale's data plane, without the control plane
en.what: Tailcat is a netcat-like tool that uses Tailscale's data plane (magicsock) to establish WireGuard-encrypted tunnels between two points, without relying on Tailscale's control plane. Connection metadata is exchanged out-of-band, requiring no Tailscale account or admin privileges.
en.content: The repository contains a Go library (github.com/tailscale/tailcat), a CLI tool (cmd/tailcat), and an experimental WebAssembly browser demo.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it relies on Tailscale's magicsock and DERP for NAT traversal and relaying, and uses WireGuard for end-to-end encryption.
en.hot: The project has gained rapid popularity on GitHub, with over 7,800 stars added this month (total 7,728), ranking 11th on the monthly Go trending list, attracting attention for its innovative 'control-plane-free' peer-to-peer connectivity.
uses: Developers and sysadmins needing quick encrypted peer-to-peer connections
Transferring files or data in environments without Tailscale accounts or admin rights
Integrating as a library into Go applications for secure peer-to-peer communication

zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，基于 Bubbletea 和 Lip Gloss 构建 TUI，Beep 处理音频，go-librespot 支持 Spotify。依赖 ALSA（Linux）和 FLAC、Vorbis 等编解码库。
zh.hot: 凭借复古 Winamp 情怀与强大的多平台流媒体支持，cliamp 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 4220 颗星，本月新增 1100 星，位列 Go 趋势月榜第 14 名。
uses: 终端爱好者与复古 UI 粉丝 —— 在命令行中享受 Winamp 风格的播放体验。
需要统一播放多平台音乐的用户 —— 一个播放器搞定本地、流媒体和媒体服务器。
开发者与运维人员 —— 在编码或工作时用终端听音乐，不离开工作流。
Android 用户 —— 通过 cliamp mobile 在手机上收听广播、播客和相同服务器内容。

en.tag: A retro terminal music player inspired by Winamp, supporting local files and many streaming services.
en.what: cliamp is a retro terminal music player inspired by Winamp. It plays local files and streams from YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, Bilibili, NetEase Cloud Music, and many other services, as well as media servers like Navidrome, Plex, and Jellyfin.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based terminal player with a spectrum visualizer, parametric EQ, and playlist manager. It also offers an Android mobile client and multiple installation methods including script, Homebrew, AUR, and Nix.
en.stack: Built in Go with Bubbletea and Lip Gloss for TUI, Beep for audio, and go-librespot for Spotify. Depends on ALSA (Linux) and codec libraries like FLAC and Vorbis.
en.hot: With its retro Winamp nostalgia and extensive streaming support, cliamp has quickly gained popularity on GitHub, earning 4,220 stars with 1,100 added this month, ranking 14th on the Go trending monthly list.
uses: Terminal enthusiasts and retro UI fans — enjoy a Winamp-style player in the command line.
Users needing unified playback across platforms — one player for local, streaming, and media servers.
Developers and sysadmins — listen to music in the terminal without leaving the workflow.
Android users — use cliamp mobile to listen to radio, podcasts, and the same servers on phones.

zh.tag: 下一代高速可配置的 Web 爬虫与蜘蛛框架
zh.what: Katana 是 ProjectDiscovery 推出的下一代爬虫框架，用于对 Web 应用进行高速、可配置的爬取与资产发现。它支持标准与无头浏览器两种模式，能解析 JavaScript、自动填充表单，并借助机器学习对页面类型和表单进行分类。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 语言实现，包含命令行入口 cmd/katana、核心爬虫引擎、无头浏览器集成、过滤器与范围控制模块，以及预训练 ML 模型和 Docker 镜像配置。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 1.26+ 开发，依赖 CGO 与 Chrome/Chromium 实现无头模式，支持 Docker 部署，输出可格式化为 JSON 或纯文本。
zh.hot: 凭借 ProjectDiscovery 在安全工具领域的口碑和高速爬取能力，Katana 已收获 17,570 颗星，本月新增 258 星，位列 GitHub Trending Go 月榜第 13 名。
uses: 安全研究人员和渗透测试人员用于资产发现与攻击面测绘
漏洞赏金猎人批量爬取目标站点以收集 URL 和表单
DevOps 或运维团队监控自身 Web 应用的链接健康度
需要自动化抓取 JavaScript 渲染页面的数据工程师

en.tag: A next-generation, fast and fully configurable web crawling and spidering framework
en.what: Katana is a next-generation crawling and spidering framework by ProjectDiscovery for fast, configurable web crawling and asset discovery. It supports both standard and headless modes, parses JavaScript, auto-fills forms, and uses ML to classify page types and forms.
en.content: The repo is written in Go and includes the CLI entrypoint cmd/katana, the core crawling engine, headless browser integration, filtering and scope-control modules, plus a pre-trained ML model and Docker image configuration.
en.stack: Built with Go 1.26+, relies on CGO and Chrome/Chromium for headless mode, supports Docker deployment, and can output JSON or plain text.
en.hot: Backed by ProjectDiscovery's reputation in security tooling and its high-speed crawling, Katana has earned 17,570 stars, adding 258 this month and ranking 13th on GitHub Trending's monthly Go list.
uses: Security researchers and pentesters for asset discovery and attack surface mapping
Bug bounty hunters crawling target sites in bulk to collect URLs and forms
DevOps or ops teams monitoring link health of their own web apps
Data engineers needing to automate crawling of JavaScript-rendered pages

zh.tag: 开源 Linux 服务器管理面板，兼 AI 管理平台
zh.what: 1Panel 是一个现代开源的 Linux 服务器管理面板，提供直观的 Web 界面来管理服务器、网站、数据库、容器等。它还集成了轻量级 AI 管理功能，支持部署和管理 AI 应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的面板源码、文档（多语言）、安装脚本、Docker 镜像配置等。主要目录包括 cmd、frontend、backend、docs 等。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 语言，前端采用 Vue.js，依赖 Docker 和 Docker Compose 进行容器管理，支持多种数据库（如 MySQL、PostgreSQL）。
zh.hot: 1Panel 拥有超过 250 万自托管用户，GitHub 星标 36,831，本月新增 452，因其功能全面且易用而广受欢迎。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队快速管理多台 Linux 服务器，无需命令行操作。
需要部署和管理 Docker 容器、网站、数据库的系统管理员。
希望轻松运行 AI 应用或模型，并集成到服务器管理中的用户。
教育或学习用途，用于理解服务器管理面板的架构与实现。

en.tag: Open-source Linux server management panel with AI platform capabilities
en.what: 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel offering an intuitive web interface to manage servers, websites, databases, containers, and more. It also integrates lightweight AI management features for deploying and managing AI applications.
en.content: The repository contains full panel source code, multi-language documentation, installation scripts, Docker image configurations, etc. Main directories include cmd, frontend, backend, docs.
en.stack: Backend is written in Go, frontend uses Vue.js, relies on Docker and Docker Compose for container management, supports multiple databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL).
en.hot: With over 2.5M self-hosters and 36,831 GitHub stars (452 added this month), 1Panel is popular for its comprehensive features and ease of use.
uses: Individual developers or small teams quickly manage multiple Linux servers without CLI operations.
System administrators needing to deploy and manage Docker containers, websites, and databases.
Users who want to easily run AI applications or models integrated into server management.
Educational or learning purposes to understand the architecture of a server management panel.

zh.tag: 自托管信息聚合仪表盘，把所有订阅源集中到一个页面
zh.what: Glance 是一个轻量、高度可定制的自托管仪表盘，把 RSS、Reddit、Hacker News、YouTube、Twitch、天气、股价、Docker 状态和服务器指标等各类信息流汇聚到统一界面。它通过 YAML 配置文件定义页面与小组件，支持多标签页、自定义 CSS 和主题，并针对移动端做了优化。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的服务端源码、docs 下的配置与主题文档、预配置页面示例、Logo 与截图资源，以及社区小组件仓库的链接。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，前端使用极简的原生 JavaScript，配置采用 YAML，可编译为小于 20MB 的单文件二进制，并提供同样小巧的 Docker 镜像。
zh.hot: 凭借 37090 颗星和本月新增 756 星登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Go 语言第 4 名，其低内存占用、少依赖和高度可定制的特性正好契合自托管社区对轻量聚合面板的需求。
uses: 自托管爱好者：想把 RSS、社交动态和服务器状态集中到一个私人主页
家庭实验室与 Homelab 用户：需要监控 Docker 容器和服务器指标
注重隐私的用户：不希望依赖第三方在线仪表盘服务
移动端用户：希望在手机上随时查看个性化信息流

en.tag: A self-hosted dashboard that puts all your feeds in one place
en.what: Glance is a lightweight, highly customizable self-hosted dashboard that aggregates RSS, Reddit, Hacker News, YouTube, Twitch, weather, market prices, Docker container status, and server stats into one unified interface. It uses YAML configuration to define pages and widgets, supports multiple tabs, custom CSS and themes, and is optimized for mobile devices.
en.content: The repo contains the Go server source code, configuration and theme docs under docs/, preconfigured page examples, logo and screenshot assets, plus links to the community widgets repository.
en.stack: Written in Go with minimal vanilla JavaScript on the frontend, configured via YAML, and shipped as a single sub-20MB binary plus an equally small Docker image.
en.hot: With 37,090 stars and 756 added this month, it ranks 4th on the GitHub Trending monthly Go list, as its low memory usage, few dependencies, and high customizability match the self-hosting community's demand for a lightweight aggregation panel.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts who want RSS, social feeds, and server status on one private homepage
Homelab users who need to monitor Docker containers and server metrics
Privacy-conscious users who prefer not to rely on third-party online dashboards
Mobile users who want to check a personalized feed on the go

zh.tag: 为 Web 应用提供单点登录与多因素认证的门户
zh.what: Authelia 是一个开源的身份认证服务器，为 Web 应用提供单点登录（SSO）和多因素认证（MFA）功能。它可作为反向代理的认证层，支持 LDAP、OIDC 等集成，并已通过 OpenID 认证，且为后量子密码学做好准备。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 语言编写的核心服务、命令行工具、配置示例、文档站点（authelia.com）以及用于构建和测试的 CI/CD 配置。代码结构清晰，包含认证、授权、会话管理等模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种 Go 库，支持 LDAP、OIDC、TOTP、U2F 等协议。前端可能涉及少量 JavaScript，用于登录页面。
zh.hot: 本月新增 359 星，总星数达 2.88 万，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 10。其安全性和对现代认证标准的支持吸引了大量自托管和隐私敏感用户。
uses: 自托管服务（如 Nextcloud、Grafana）的统一登录与二次验证
企业或团队内部应用的单点登录，集成现有 LDAP 或 OIDC
希望为 Web 应用添加安全认证层，但不希望使用商业 SSO 的开发者
对后量子密码学感兴趣，希望提前适配未来安全标准的技术团队

en.tag: Single Sign-On and Multi-Factor Authentication portal for web apps
en.what: Authelia is an open-source authentication server providing Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for web applications. It acts as an authentication layer for reverse proxies, integrates with LDAP and OIDC, and is OpenID Certified and Post-Quantum Cryptography Ready.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based core service, command-line tools, configuration examples, documentation site (authelia.com), and CI/CD setup for building and testing. The code is well-organized into modules for authentication, authorization, session management, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging various Go libraries. Supports LDAP, OIDC, TOTP, U2F, and other protocols. The frontend may include minimal JavaScript for the login page.
en.hot: With 359 new stars this month and a total of 28.8k stars, it ranks 10th on the Go trending list. Its security focus and support for modern auth standards attract many self-hosters and privacy-conscious users.
uses: Centralized login and 2FA for self-hosted services like Nextcloud and Grafana
SSO for internal enterprise apps, integrating with existing LDAP or OIDC
Developers wanting to add secure auth to web apps without commercial SSO
Tech teams interested in post-quantum cryptography readiness

zh.tag: 自主AI渗透测试代理系统
zh.what: PentAGI 是一个全自主的 AI 代理系统，能够执行复杂的渗透测试任务。它利用先进的人工智能技术，为信息安全专业人员、研究人员和爱好者提供强大且灵活的安全测试解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的系统代码、架构文档、快速入门指南、LLM 提供商配置（如 OpenAI、Anthropic、Ollama 等）、Docker 镜像配置、开发与测试工具（如 ftester）以及社区链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，支持多种 LLM 提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、AWS Bedrock 等），集成 Docker 进行隔离，并支持 Langfuse 监控和知识图谱（Graphiti）。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 与网络安全结合的热度上升，PentAGI 作为自动化渗透测试的领先项目，在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，今日新增 89 星，总星数达 22519，位居 Go 语言趋势榜第一。
uses: 安全研究人员：利用 AI 代理自动执行渗透测试，提高效率。
红队与蓝队：在授权环境中进行自动化安全评估。
AI 爱好者：探索 AI 在网络安全领域的实际应用。

en.tag: Autonomous AI agent system for complex penetration testing
en.what: PentAGI is a fully autonomous AI agent system capable of performing complex penetration testing tasks. It leverages advanced AI technologies to provide a powerful and flexible security testing solution for infosec professionals, researchers, and enthusiasts.
en.content: The repository includes full system code, architecture docs, quick start guides, LLM provider configurations (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama), Docker image setup, development and testing tools (like ftester), and community links.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, supports multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, AWS Bedrock, etc.), integrates Docker for isolation, and supports Langfuse monitoring and knowledge graph (Graphiti).
en.hot: With the rising intersection of AI and cybersecurity, PentAGI as a leading autonomous pentesting project has gained rapid traction on GitHub, adding 89 stars today to reach 22,519 total, ranking #1 in Go trending.
uses: Security researchers: leverage AI agents to automate penetration testing and improve efficiency.
Red and blue teams: conduct automated security assessments in authorized environments.
AI enthusiasts: explore practical applications of AI in cybersecurity.

zh.tag: 本地化光伏充电与家庭能源管理系统
zh.what: evcc 是一个可扩展的电动汽车充电控制器与家庭能源管理系统，核心目标是在不依赖云服务的前提下实现本地能源管理。它能根据光伏发电、电价与电池状态智能调节充电功率，让电动车尽量用太阳能充电。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 Go 编写的核心程序，附带 Web UI 截图与配置示例，支持 Docker 镜像、Home Assistant 集成以及 Weblate 多语言翻译。文档站 docs.evcc.io 单独维护，涵盖充电桩、智能开关、热泵等设备支持列表。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，提供 Docker 镜像与 Home Assistant 插件，支持 OCPP、EEBus、Modbus 等协议，通过 MQTT/REST 与各类充电桩、逆变器、智能开关和热泵通信。
zh.hot: 凭借 7235 颗星与今日新增 6 星登上 Go 日榜第 17 名，反映出欧洲能源价格高企下，用户对本地化、免云的光伏充电方案需求旺盛。
uses: 拥有光伏与电动车的家庭用户，希望最大化自用太阳能充电
智能家居玩家，想用 Home Assistant 统一管理充电与用电
充电桩厂商或集成商，需要开源、可扩展的充电控制方案
关注能源独立与隐私、不愿依赖云服务的极客用户

en.tag: Local solar charging and home energy management system
en.what: evcc is an extensible EV charge controller and home energy management system designed to run locally without relying on cloud services. It intelligently adjusts charging power based on solar generation, electricity prices, and battery state so EVs charge primarily on solar energy.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based core application, a web UI, configuration examples, Docker images, Home Assistant integration, and Weblate translations. Documentation lives separately at docs.evcc.io, covering supported chargers, smart switches, heat pumps, and more.
en.stack: Written in Go, distributed as Docker images and a Home Assistant add-on, supporting OCPP, EEBus, and Modbus protocols. It communicates with chargers, inverters, smart switches, and heat pumps via MQTT/REST.
en.hot: With 7,235 stars and 6 added today, it ranks 17th on the Go daily trending list, reflecting strong demand for local, cloud-free solar charging amid high European energy prices.
uses: Homeowners with solar panels and EVs wanting to maximize self-consumed solar charging
Smart home enthusiasts integrating charging and energy management via Home Assistant
Charger vendors or integrators seeking an open, extensible charging control solution
Privacy-conscious users who want energy independence without cloud dependency

zh.tag: 驱动 E2B 云的开源 Firecracker 微虚拟机运行时
zh.what: E2B Runtime 是支撑 E2B Cloud 的完整后端，包含控制面 API、驱动 Firecracker 的节点编排器、VM 内 agent、边缘路由器和模板构建器。它为每个 AI agent 会话提供独立的隔离 Linux 机器，从快照恢复启动，可随时暂停与恢复。
zh.content: 仓库包含控制面 API、节点编排器、VM 内 agent、边缘路由器与模板构建器等模块，并提供可在单机运行的 Embed 包，以及架构文档和自托管说明。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 1.26 编写，基于 Firecracker microVM、userfaultfd 惰性加载、写时复制 overlay 与对象存储，采用 Apache-2.0 许可。
zh.hot: 作为 E2B 云的开源核心，它切中 AI agent 安全执行不可信代码的刚需，本月新增 404 star、总数 1619，登上 Go 月榜第 22 名。
uses: AI agent 平台开发者，需要安全隔离地执行不可信代码
希望自托管或私有化部署 agent 沙箱基础设施的团队
研究 Firecracker 微虚拟机与快照恢复技术的工程师
需要在单机上快速搭建沙箱运行时的个人开发者

en.tag: The open-source Firecracker microVM runtime powering E2B Cloud
en.what: E2B Runtime is the complete backend powering E2B Cloud: the control-plane API, per-node Firecracker orchestrator, in-VM agent, edge router, and template builder. It gives every AI agent session its own isolated Linux machine that boots from a snapshot and can be paused and resumed at will.
en.content: The repo contains the control-plane API, node orchestrator, in-VM agent, edge router, and template builder, plus an Embed package for single-machine use, along with architecture docs and self-hosting guides.
en.stack: Written in Go 1.26, built on Firecracker microVMs, userfaultfd lazy paging, copy-on-write overlays, and object storage, licensed under Apache-2.0.
en.hot: As the open-source core of E2B Cloud, it targets the pressing need to safely run untrusted agent code, gaining 404 stars this month to reach 1,619 and ranking 22nd on the Go monthly trending list.
uses: AI agent platform developers needing to run untrusted code in secure isolation
Teams wanting to self-host or privately deploy agent sandbox infrastructure
Engineers studying Firecracker microVMs and snapshot-resume techniques
Individual developers needing a quick single-machine sandbox runtime

zh.tag: 用命令行自动化 App Store Connect 全流程的 Go 工具
zh.what: 这是一个用 Go 编写的 App Store Connect 命令行工具，把 TestFlight、构建、提交审核、签名、分析、截图、订阅管理等 iOS/macOS/tvOS/visionOS 发布流程搬到终端里。它面向脚本和 CI/CD 设计，可以在 IDE、流水线或本地一键完成原本要在网页后台反复点击的操作。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 Go 实现的 asc 命令，包含大量子命令与文档；还提供 asc install-skills 安装 25 个 Agent Skills，把常见工作流封装成可复用的技能包，并附带 Homebrew、安装脚本和 WinGet 等分发方式。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，通过 go.mod 管理依赖，提供 Homebrew、curl 安装脚本和 WinGet 等安装方式，并支持作为 Agent Skills 集成到 AI 编码助手。
zh.hot: 本周新增 663 star、总数达 7232，并登上 GitHub Trending Go 周榜第 4 名。它切中了 iOS 开发者对发布流程自动化的刚需，加上 Agent Skills 与 CI/CD 场景的契合，热度快速攀升。
uses: iOS/macOS 开发者：想把 TestFlight、构建和提交审核从网页后台搬到命令行
DevOps/CI 工程师：需要在流水线中自动完成签名、上传和发布
使用 AI 编码助手的团队：通过 asc install-skills 把发布流程变成可复用技能
独立开发者与小团队：希望用脚本减少 App Store Connect 上的重复手工操作

en.tag: A fast, scriptable Go CLI for automating the App Store Connect API
en.what: A Go-based CLI for the App Store Connect API that automates TestFlight, builds, submissions, signing, analytics, screenshots, subscriptions and more across iOS, macOS, tvOS and visionOS. It is built for scripting and CI/CD, letting you run release workflows from a terminal, IDE or pipeline instead of the web dashboard.
en.content: The repo centers on the Go-based asc command with many subcommands and docs, plus asc install-skills which installs 25 agent skills for common workflows. It also ships Homebrew, install-script and WinGet distribution paths.
en.stack: Written in Go with go.mod, distributed via Homebrew, a curl install script and WinGet, and integrable as Agent Skills for AI coding assistants.
en.hot: It gained 663 stars this week for a total of 7,232, ranking 4th on GitHub Trending's weekly Go chart. It hits a real pain point in iOS release automation, and its Agent Skills plus CI/CD fit are driving rapid adoption.
uses: iOS/macOS developers who want TestFlight, builds and submissions in the terminal instead of the web UI
DevOps/CI engineers automating signing, uploads and releases in pipelines
Teams using AI coding assistants that want release workflows as reusable skills via asc install-skills
Indie developers and small teams looking to script away repetitive App Store Connect chores

zh.tag: 高性能内存数据存储，兼容 Redis 与 Memcached
zh.what: Dragonfly 是一个现代化的内存数据存储，专为现代应用负载设计。它完全兼容 Redis 和 Memcached API，无需修改代码即可迁移。相比传统内存存储，吞吐量提升 25 倍，资源消耗降低 80%。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心引擎源码、文档、基准测试、构建指南以及多语言 README。还提供了 Docker 镜像和云服务入口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Linux 内核特性如 epoll 和 io_uring。支持 Docker 部署，并提供 Helm charts 用于 Kubernetes。
zh.hot: 作为 Redis 和 Memcached 的现代替代品，凭借惊人的性能提升和资源节省，在 C++ 社区持续火爆，今日新增 77 星，总星数达 31150。
uses: 需要高吞吐、低延迟缓存服务的后端开发团队，可无缝替代 Redis。
希望在降低基础设施成本的同时提升性能的运维和架构师。
对内存数据库内部实现感兴趣的 C++ 开发者，可阅读源码学习。

en.tag: High-performance in-memory data store, Redis & Memcached compatible
en.what: Dragonfly is a modern in-memory data store built for modern application workloads. It is fully compatible with Redis and Memcached APIs, requiring no code changes to adopt. Compared to legacy in-memory datastores, it delivers 25X more throughput and uses up to 80% less resources.
en.content: The repository contains core engine source code, documentation, benchmarks, build guides, and multi-language READMEs. It also provides Docker images and a cloud service entry point.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, leveraging Linux kernel features like epoll and io_uring. Supports Docker deployment and provides Helm charts for Kubernetes.
en.hot: As a modern replacement for Redis and Memcached, it gains popularity in the C++ community due to its impressive performance gains and resource savings, with 77 new stars today and 31,150 total.
uses: Backend teams needing high-throughput, low-latency caching, seamlessly replacing Redis.
Ops and architects aiming to cut infrastructure costs while boosting performance.
C++ developers interested in the internals of in-memory databases for learning.

zh.tag: 跨平台开源多轨音频编辑器与录音软件
zh.what: Audacity 是一款易用的多轨音频编辑器和录音软件，支持 Windows、macOS、GNU/Linux 等系统。它提供录音、编辑、混音、效果处理等功能，适合播客、音乐制作和音频修复等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Audacity 的完整源代码，包括核心编辑器、音频引擎、效果插件、UI 资源等。当前正在开发 Audacity 4，采用全新 UI 并进行大规模重构，同时保留 3.x 分支供维护。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 wxWidgets（UI）、PortAudio（音频 I/O）等库。构建系统支持 CMake，并提供针对不同平台的构建脚本。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源音频工具，Audacity 长期拥有稳定用户群。近期因 Audacity 4 的 UI 重构和功能更新引发关注，今日新增 272 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第二。
uses: 播客制作者：录制和编辑多轨音频，添加效果和导出播客节目。
音乐爱好者：进行简单的录音、剪辑和混音，或修复老旧录音。
教育场景：用于音频教学、学生录音作业或声音实验。
音频修复：去除噪音、剪辑对话或恢复历史录音。

en.tag: Cross-platform open-source multi-track audio editor and recorder
en.what: Audacity is an easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder for Windows, macOS, GNU/Linux and other operating systems. It provides recording, editing, mixing, and effects processing, suitable for podcasting, music production, and audio restoration.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Audacity, including the core editor, audio engine, effects plugins, and UI resources. It is currently undergoing major structural change for Audacity 4, with a brand-new UI and refactorings, while maintaining the 3.x branch.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on wxWidgets for UI, PortAudio for audio I/O, and other libraries. The build system uses CMake, with platform-specific build scripts.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source audio tool, Audacity has a stable user base. Recent attention is driven by the UI overhaul and updates for Audacity 4, gaining 272 stars today and ranking #2 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Podcasters: record and edit multi-track audio, add effects, and export episodes.
Music enthusiasts: perform simple recording, editing, and mixing, or restore old recordings.
Educational settings: use for audio teaching, student recording assignments, or sound experiments.
Audio restoration: remove noise, edit dialogue, or recover historical recordings.

zh.tag: 自托管游戏串流服务端，配合 Moonlight 使用
zh.what: Sunshine 是一个自托管的游戏串流服务端，兼容 Moonlight 客户端。它允许用户将 PC 上的游戏和应用串流到其他设备，支持低延迟和高画质。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建脚本、文档和图标资源。提供多种安装方式，如 Docker、Flatpak、Windows 安装包等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 FFmpeg、CUDA 等编解码库。支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 平台。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 4 万星标，本月新增 1103 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 22 名。其受欢迎程度源于对 NVIDIA GameStream 的替代需求，以及开源社区对自托管串流方案的青睐。
uses: 游戏玩家：将 PC 游戏串流到局域网内的其他设备，如笔记本、手机或电视。
远程办公或学习：远程访问高性能 PC 上的应用，实现移动办公。
开源爱好者：自建串流服务，摆脱对商业服务的依赖，保障隐私和自由度。

en.tag: Self-hosted game streaming host for Moonlight
en.what: Sunshine is a self-hosted game stream host that works with Moonlight clients. It enables users to stream games and applications from their PC to other devices with low latency and high quality.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, build scripts, documentation, and icon assets. Multiple installation methods are available, including Docker, Flatpak, Windows installers, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, relying on FFmpeg, CUDA, and other codec libraries. Supports Windows, Linux, and macOS platforms.
en.hot: With over 40,000 stars and 1,103 new stars this month, ranking 22nd on the C++ monthly trending list, its popularity stems from the need for a replacement for NVIDIA GameStream and the community's preference for self-hosted streaming solutions.
uses: Gamers: stream PC games to other devices on the local network, such as laptops, phones, or TVs.
Remote work or study: remotely access applications on a high-performance PC for mobile productivity.
Open-source enthusiasts: self-host streaming services to avoid commercial dependencies, ensuring privacy and freedom.

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 格式化库，快速安全的 printf/iostream 替代品
zh.what: {fmt} 是一个开源格式化库，提供快速且安全的 C stdio 和 C++ iostreams 替代方案。它实现了 C++20 的 std::format 和 C++23 的 std::print，并支持类似 Python 的格式字符串语法。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的库源码、文档、示例和测试，核心文件包括 base.h、format.h 等，支持用户自定义类型和可移植的 Unicode。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，依赖少，支持 C++11 及以上标准，使用 Dragonbox 算法进行快速浮点格式化。
zh.hot: 今日新增 963 星，总星数达 25081，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。作为 C++ 标准库格式化功能的基础，其高性能和安全性备受开发者青睐。
uses: C++ 开发者需要比 printf 或 iostream 更安全、更快速的格式化输出时使用
库作者希望实现或扩展 C++20/23 格式化功能，或为自定义类型提供格式化支持
需要高精度浮点格式化且要求正确舍入和往返保证的数值计算场景

en.tag: A modern C++ formatting library, fast and safe alternative to printf and iostreams
en.what: {fmt} is an open-source formatting library providing a fast and safe alternative to C stdio and C++ iostreams. It implements C++20's std::format and C++23's std::print, with a format string syntax similar to Python's.
en.content: The repository contains full library source code, documentation, examples, and tests, with core files like base.h and format.h, supporting user-defined types and portable Unicode.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation with minimal dependencies, supports C++11 and later, uses the Dragonbox algorithm for fast floating-point formatting.
en.hot: With 963 stars added today and 25,081 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. As the foundation for C++ standard formatting, its high performance and safety are widely appreciated.
uses: For C++ developers needing safer and faster formatting than printf or iostreams
For library authors implementing or extending C++20/23 formatting, or adding formatting support for custom types
For numerical computing scenarios requiring high-precision floating-point formatting with correct rounding and round-trip guarantees

zh.tag: 免费开源的 PlayStation 2 模拟器，让 PC 畅玩 PS2 经典游戏
zh.what: PCSX2 是一个免费开源的 PlayStation 2 模拟器，通过 MIPS CPU 解释器、动态重编译器和虚拟机来模拟 PS2 硬件。它让玩家能在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上运行 PS2 游戏，并附带存档、画质增强等额外功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源码，涵盖 CPU 核心、图形与音频插件、GUI 界面以及跨平台构建脚本，并提供稳定版与 nightly 版本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建系统，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 多平台，并集成 Qt 界面与 Vulkan/OpenGL 渲染后端。
zh.hot: 作为拥有 20 多年历史的经典模拟器，PCSX2 已能全速运行《最终幻想 X》等大多数游戏，兼容列表超过 2500 款；本月新增 295 star，总 star 达 15597，稳居 GitHub Trending 月榜 C++ 第 19 名。
uses: 想在 PC 上重温 PS2 经典游戏的老玩家
对游戏主机模拟器技术感兴趣的研究者与开发者
需要跨平台（Windows/Linux/macOS）游玩 PS2 游戏的用户
希望参与开源模拟器项目贡献代码或翻译的志愿者

en.tag: Free and open-source PlayStation 2 emulator that lets you play PS2 classics on PC
en.what: PCSX2 is a free and open-source PlayStation 2 emulator that emulates the PS2's hardware using MIPS CPU interpreters, recompilers and a virtual machine. It lets players run PS2 games on Windows, Linux and macOS with extra features such as save states and visual enhancements.
en.content: The repo holds the full emulator source, including CPU cores, graphics and audio plugins, the GUI, and cross-platform build scripts, with stable and nightly builds available.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++ with CMake as the build system, it supports Windows, Linux and macOS, and integrates a Qt interface with Vulkan/OpenGL rendering backends.
en.hot: As a classic emulator with over 20 years of history, PCSX2 can run most games at full speed, including Final Fantasy X, with over 2,500 titles tested; it gained 295 stars this month, reaching 15,597 total and ranking 19th on GitHub Trending's monthly C++ list.
uses: Retro gamers who want to replay PS2 classics on PC
Researchers and developers interested in console emulation technology
Users who need cross-platform (Windows/Linux/macOS) PS2 gaming
Volunteers who want to contribute code or translations to an open-source emulator project

zh.tag: 英特尔开源深度学习推理优化与部署工具包
zh.what: OpenVINO 是英特尔开源的深度学习推理优化与部署工具包，可将训练好的模型转换并加速到 CPU、GPU、NPU 等硬件上运行。它覆盖计算机视觉、语音识别、生成式 AI 与 NLP 等常见任务，支持从边缘到云端的部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 推理引擎、模型转换与优化工具（如 Model Optimizer、NNCF 量化）、多语言绑定（Python/Node.js/C）、示例教程与文档，并有 openvino.genai 等配套仓库。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为核心，提供 Python、Node.js、C 等绑定，支持 PyTorch、TensorFlow、ONNX、Keras、PaddlePaddle、JAX/Flax 及 Hugging Face 模型，可通过 pip、conda、npm、brew 安装。
zh.hot: 作为英特尔主推的推理部署方案，OpenVINO 在边缘 AI 与本地大模型推理需求增长下持续受关注，本月新增 211 star，累计 10822，位列 GitHub C++ 月榜第 11。
uses: 需要在英特尔 CPU/GPU/NPU 上部署高性能推理的 AI 工程师
希望把 PyTorch/TensorFlow 模型优化并落地到边缘设备的开发者
从事计算机视觉、语音或生成式 AI 应用的产品与研究人员
想学习模型量化、转换与推理加速的学生和爱好者

en.tag: Intel's open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning inference
en.what: OpenVINO is Intel's open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning inference, converting trained models to run fast on CPU, GPU, and NPU hardware. It covers computer vision, speech recognition, generative AI, and NLP, from edge to cloud.
en.content: The repo contains the core C++ inference engine, model conversion and optimization tools (Model Optimizer, NNCF quantization), multi-language bindings (Python/Node.js/C), samples, tutorials, and docs, plus companion repos like openvino.genai.
en.stack: Core in C++ with Python, Node.js, and C bindings; supports PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, Keras, PaddlePaddle, JAX/Flax, and Hugging Face models, installable via pip, conda, npm, and brew.
en.hot: As Intel's flagship inference deployment solution, OpenVINO keeps gaining traction amid rising edge AI and local LLM inference demand, adding 211 stars this month for 10,822 total and ranking 11th on GitHub's monthly C++ trending list.
uses: AI engineers deploying high-performance inference on Intel CPU/GPU/NPU
Developers optimizing and shipping PyTorch/TensorFlow models to edge devices
Product teams and researchers working on vision, speech, or generative AI apps
Students and hobbyists learning model quantization, conversion, and inference acceleration

zh.tag: 强大易用的开源跨平台截图工具
zh.what: Flameshot 是一款开源截图软件，支持截图后直接在图上标注、画箭头、打码、加文字等操作。它跨 Linux、Windows、macOS 平台，可通过命令行或快捷键快速调用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++/Qt 编写的桌面应用源码、图标与预览资源、多语言翻译文件，以及各平台打包脚本和 CI 工作流。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 与 Qt 框架开发，使用 CMake 构建，依赖各平台原生截图与窗口系统（X11/Wayland 等）。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源截图工具，它已积累超 3 万 star，本月新增 267，稳居 C++ 月榜第 23 名，持续受 Linux 用户青睐。
uses: Linux 桌面用户，需要比系统自带截图更强大的标注功能
经常写文档、做教程或提 issue，需要快速截图并标注
开发者与运维，习惯用命令行或快捷键触发截图
追求开源、免费、跨平台工具的效率爱好者

en.tag: Powerful yet simple open-source cross-platform screenshot tool
en.what: Flameshot is an open-source screenshot tool that lets you annotate captures directly with arrows, text, blur and more. It runs on Linux, Windows and macOS, and can be triggered via CLI or keyboard shortcuts.
en.content: The repo contains the C++/Qt desktop app source, icons and preview assets, translation files, plus packaging scripts and CI workflows for each platform.
en.stack: Built with C++ and the Qt framework, using CMake, and relying on native platform capture and window systems (X11/Wayland, etc.).
en.hot: As a veteran open-source screenshot tool, it has over 30k stars, adding 267 this month and ranking 23rd on the C++ monthly chart, staying popular among Linux users.
uses: Linux desktop users who need richer annotation than built-in tools
People writing docs, tutorials or issues who need quick annotated screenshots
Developers and ops who prefer CLI or shortcut-triggered capture
Efficiency fans who want a free, open-source, cross-platform tool

zh.tag: 基于 Vulkan 的 Direct3D 8/9/10/11 翻译层，让 Linux/Wine 运行 3D 应用
zh.what: DXVK 是一个基于 Vulkan 的翻译层，将 Direct3D 8/9/10/11 调用转换为 Vulkan，从而在 Linux 上通过 Wine 运行 3D 应用程序和游戏。它显著提升了兼容性和性能，是 Linux 游戏生态的关键组件。
zh.content: 仓库包含用于替换 Wine 中 d3d8、d3d9、d3d10core、d3d11 和 dxgi 的 DLL 文件（x64 和 x32 版本），以及构建脚本、配置文件和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Vulkan API 和 Wine 环境，需要较新的 GPU 驱动。
zh.hot: 作为 Linux 游戏兼容性的核心项目，DXVK 拥有 18117 颗星，今日新增 5 星，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 第 13 名，持续受到 Linux 游戏玩家和开发者的关注。
uses: Linux 游戏玩家 —— 通过 Wine/Proton 运行 Windows 3D 游戏，提升性能和兼容性
Wine 开发者与打包者 —— 集成 DXVK 以改善 Direct3D 支持
Steam Deck 用户 —— 利用 DXVK 在掌机上畅玩 Windows 游戏

en.tag: Vulkan-based Direct3D 8/9/10/11 translation layer for Linux/Wine
en.what: DXVK is a Vulkan-based translation layer that converts Direct3D 8/9/10/11 calls to Vulkan, enabling 3D applications and games to run on Linux via Wine. It significantly improves compatibility and performance, serving as a key component of the Linux gaming ecosystem.
en.content: The repository contains DLLs (x64 and x32) that replace d3d8, d3d9, d3d10core, d3d11, and dxgi in Wine, along with build scripts, configuration files, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it depends on the Vulkan API and the Wine environment, requiring recent GPU drivers.
en.hot: As a core project for Linux gaming compatibility, DXVK has 18,117 stars with 5 added today, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending daily list for C++, continuously attracting attention from Linux gamers and developers.
uses: Linux gamers — run Windows 3D games via Wine/Proton with improved performance and compatibility
Wine developers and packagers — integrate DXVK to enhance Direct3D support
Steam Deck users — leverage DXVK to play Windows games on the handheld

zh.tag: 进程内分析型 SQL 数据库，极速查询 CSV/Parquet
zh.what: DuckDB 是一个高性能的分析型数据库系统，设计为快速、可靠、可移植且易于使用。它支持丰富的 SQL 方言，包括复杂子查询、窗口函数、复杂类型等，并可直接查询 CSV 和 Parquet 文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DuckDB 的完整源代码、文档、扩展机制以及多种客户端（Python、R、Java、Wasm 等）的集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++17 编写，依赖 CMake 构建系统，支持 Python 3 等开发环境。
zh.hot: 作为进程内分析数据库的标杆，DuckDB 凭借其极简部署和高性能查询，在数据科学领域迅速走红，star 数已突破 4 万，今日新增 69 个。
uses: 数据科学家和分析师，希望在 Python 或 R 环境中快速分析大型数据集，无需单独部署数据库服务器。
数据工程师，需要将 CSV/Parquet 文件直接作为 SQL 查询源，简化数据管道。
应用开发者，希望嵌入分析能力到现有应用中，提供轻量级 OLAP 功能。

en.tag: In-process analytical SQL database, blazing fast queries on CSV/Parquet
en.what: DuckDB is a high-performance analytical database system designed to be fast, reliable, portable, and easy to use. It supports a rich SQL dialect including complex subqueries, window functions, complex types, and can directly query CSV and Parquet files.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, extension mechanisms, and integrations for multiple clients (Python, R, Java, Wasm, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++17, built with CMake, and supports Python 3 for development.
en.hot: As a benchmark for in-process analytical databases, DuckDB has gained rapid popularity in data science due to its minimal deployment and high-performance queries, with over 40k stars and 69 new today.
uses: Data scientists and analysts who want to quickly analyze large datasets in Python or R without deploying a separate database server.
Data engineers who need to query CSV/Parquet files directly as SQL sources to simplify data pipelines.
Application developers who want to embed analytical capabilities into existing applications for lightweight OLAP functionality.

zh.tag: 3D打印切片与G代码生成工具
zh.what: PrusaSlicer 是一款将 3D 模型转换为 3D 打印指令（G-code）的软件，支持 FDM 和 mSLA 打印机。它由 Prusa Research 开发，兼容多种品牌打印机，并提供丰富的打印参数设置和模型编辑功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建文档（doc/Build.md）、资源文件（如图标）以及贡献指南。主要功能包括精确的打印参数设置、模型编辑（如涂色、切割、排列）、多项目多平台支持、多材料打印、3D 预览和命令行接口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，基于 Slic3r 构建，依赖常见的图形和几何库。支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台，Linux 通过 Flathub 分发。
zh.hot: 作为 3D 打印领域的知名开源切片软件，PrusaSlicer 持续获得关注，今日新增 13 颗星，总星数达 9296，位列 C++ 趋势榜第三。其强大的功能和活跃的社区是热度来源。
uses: 3D 打印爱好者：使用 PrusaSlicer 将模型切片并生成打印指令，支持多种打印机。
专业用户：需要精细控制打印参数和进行多材料打印的工程师或设计师。
自动化工作流：通过命令行接口在无 GUI 环境下集成切片功能。

en.tag: 3D printing slicer and G-code generator
en.what: PrusaSlicer is a software that converts 3D models into 3D printing instructions (G-code), supporting FDM and mSLA printers. Developed by Prusa Research, it is compatible with a wide range of printer brands and offers extensive printing parameter settings and model editing features.
en.content: The repository contains the complete C++ source code, build documentation (doc/Build.md), resource files (e.g., icons), and contribution guidelines. Key features include precise printing parameter settings, model editing (painting, cutting, arranging), multi-project and multi-bed support, multi-material printing, 3D preview, and a command-line interface.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, built on Slic3r, and relies on common graphics and geometry libraries. Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux; Linux is distributed via Flathub.
en.hot: As a well-known open-source slicer in 3D printing, PrusaSlicer continues to gain attention, adding 13 stars today, reaching 9296 total, ranking third on the C++ trending list. Its powerful features and active community drive its popularity.
uses: 3D printing enthusiasts: use PrusaSlicer to slice models and generate print instructions for various printers.
Professional users: engineers or designers needing precise control over print parameters and multi-material printing.
Automation workflows: integrate slicing via command-line interface in headless environments.

zh.tag: 全球首个免费开源的 PlayStation 3 模拟器与调试器
zh.what: RPCS3 是一个用 C++ 编写的 PlayStation 3 模拟器与调试器，支持在 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 FreeBSD 上运行 PS3 游戏。它通过动态重编译和硬件抽象层，让现代 PC 能够执行原本为 PS3 定制硬件设计的游戏。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器核心、图形后端（Vulkan/OpenGL）、音频、输入、调试工具以及游戏兼容性数据库。还提供了构建脚本、文档和社区贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Vulkan、OpenGL、Qt、FFmpeg 等库，支持多平台构建。
zh.hot: 作为全球首个免费开源的 PS3 模拟器，RPCS3 拥有近 2 万 star，本月新增 341，持续吸引着模拟器爱好者和开发者。其高兼容性和活跃社区使其成为 GitHub 上最受关注的开源模拟器项目之一。
uses: 想在 PC 上重温 PS3 经典游戏的玩家
对游戏机模拟器开发感兴趣的程序员
需要调试 PS3 游戏或自制软件的开发者
研究硬件虚拟化与动态重编译技术的学者

en.tag: The world's first free and open-source PlayStation 3 emulator and debugger
en.what: RPCS3 is a PlayStation 3 emulator and debugger written in C++, allowing PS3 games to run on Windows, Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD. It uses dynamic recompilation and hardware abstraction to execute games designed for the PS3's custom hardware on modern PCs.
en.content: The repository contains the full emulator core, graphics backends (Vulkan/OpenGL), audio, input, debugging tools, and a game compatibility database. It also includes build scripts, documentation, and community contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it depends on Vulkan, OpenGL, Qt, FFmpeg, and other libraries, with multi-platform build support.
en.hot: As the world's first free and open-source PS3 emulator, RPCS3 has nearly 20k stars with 341 added this month, continuously attracting emulator enthusiasts and developers. Its high compatibility and active community make it one of the most watched open-source emulator projects on GitHub.
uses: Gamers who want to replay classic PS3 games on PC
Programmers interested in console emulator development
Developers needing to debug PS3 games or homebrew
Researchers studying hardware virtualization and dynamic recompilation

zh.tag: 为魔兽世界私服注入真人般AI玩家机器人
zh.what: 这是 AzerothCore 的一个模块，为魔兽世界巫妖王之怒私服添加类似真人的机器人玩家。机器人可以登录你的小号、组队、升级、做任务、打副本和战场，还能随机在世界中游荡，模拟真实 MMO 体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含模块源码、构建工作流（macOS/Windows/Core）、多语言 README（中/英/西）以及安装指南 Wiki 链接，需配合官方定制的 AzerothCore 分支使用。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 AzerothCore 服务端框架与 CMake 构建系统，支持 Ubuntu、Windows 和 macOS 平台。
zh.hot: 本月新增 143 star，总 star 达 1087，登上 GitHub C++ 月榜第 6 名；它让单机私服也能拥有活跃的玩家生态，深受魔兽怀旧玩家与私服开发者欢迎。
uses: 魔兽世界私服管理员，希望为服务器填充活跃的 AI 玩家
单机怀旧玩家，想在没有真人的情况下体验组队、副本和战场
AzerothCore 模块开发者，研究 AI 行为与服务器性能优化
想搭建小型多人服务器但缺少真实玩家的社区运营者

en.tag: Player-like AI bots for AzerothCore WoW servers
en.what: This is an AzerothCore module that adds player-like bots to a World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King server. Bots can log in your alts, form parties, level up, complete quests, run raids and battlegrounds, and wander the world to simulate a real MMO experience.
en.content: The repo contains the module source code, build workflows (macOS/Windows/Core), multilingual READMEs (EN/CN/ES), and links to installation guide wikis; it requires a custom AzerothCore fork.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, built on the AzerothCore server framework with CMake, supporting Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS.
en.hot: It gained 143 stars this month, reaching 1,087 total and ranking #6 on GitHub's monthly C++ trending list; it lets solo private servers feel alive with a thriving player ecosystem, appealing to WoW nostalgia fans and server developers.
uses: WoW private server admins who want to populate their realm with active AI players
Solo nostalgia players who want party, raid, and battleground experiences without real people
AzerothCore module developers researching AI behavior and server performance
Community operators building small servers but lacking real players

zh.tag: 跨显卡厂商的通用超分与帧生成桥接工具
zh.what: OptiScaler 是一款游戏画质增强工具，允许玩家在已支持 DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS 的游戏中替换超分方案，并管理帧生成功能。它还能通过实验性 OptiFG 在 DX12 游戏中启用帧生成，甚至支持 Nukem 模组将 DLSSG 转为 FSR3 帧生成。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 源代码、编译脚本、安装说明、已知问题列表以及详细的 Wiki 文档，并提供稳定版和 nightly 版下载。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 DirectX 12、Vulkan 等图形 API，并涉及 DLSS、FSR、XeSS 等超分技术。
zh.hot: 凭借跨显卡厂商的通用超分与帧生成能力，解决了玩家在非 Nvidia 显卡上无法使用 DLSS 等痛点，已获得 10726 颗星，今日新增 60 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 分类第 13 名。
uses: PC 游戏玩家：希望在非 Nvidia 显卡上使用 DLSS 或启用帧生成功能。
游戏模组爱好者：想要自定义游戏画质设置，替换超分方案。
技术研究者：对超分和帧生成技术跨平台实现感兴趣。
低配置玩家：通过帧生成提升游戏流畅度。

en.tag: Universal upscaling and frame generation bridge across GPU vendors
en.what: OptiScaler is a tool that lets you replace upscalers in games already supporting DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS, and manage frame generation. It can enable frame generation in DX12 games via experimental OptiFG, and supports the Nukem mod to convert DLSSG to FSR3 frame generation.
en.content: The repo contains C++ source code, build scripts, installation instructions, a known issues list, and detailed Wiki documentation, with stable and nightly releases available.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it depends on graphics APIs like DirectX 12 and Vulkan, and integrates upscaling technologies such as DLSS, FSR, and XeSS.
en.hot: With its cross-vendor upscaling and frame generation capabilities, it solves the pain point of using DLSS on non-Nvidia GPUs, earning 10,726 stars with 60 added today, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending daily list for C++.
uses: PC gamers: want to use DLSS or enable frame generation on non-Nvidia GPUs.
Game modding enthusiasts: want to customize graphics settings and replace upscalers.
Tech researchers: interested in cross-platform implementations of upscaling and frame generation.
Low-spec players: improve game smoothness through frame generation.

zh.tag: 谷歌 DeepMind 维护的通用物理仿真引擎
zh.what: MuJoCo 全称 Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact，是一个面向机器人、生物力学、图形动画与机器学习研究的通用物理引擎，专注对关节结构与环境的接触交互做快速而精确的仿真。它由 Google DeepMind 维护，提供 C API 与 Python 绑定，适合研究者与开发者使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 C++ 编写的核心仿真运行时、内置 XML 编译器与预分配数据结构，以及基于 OpenGL 的原生交互式查看器 simulate；此外还有 Python 绑定、Unity 插件、Colab 教程笔记本和完整文档。
zh.stack: 核心用 C++ 实现，依赖 OpenGL 做可视化，提供 C API、Python 绑定和 Unity 插件，配套 CMake 构建与 GitHub Actions 持续集成。
zh.hot: 作为强化学习与机器人仿真的事实标准之一，MuJoCo 长期被学术界广泛采用，本月新增 653 star、总量达 15230，位列 GitHub Trending C++ 月榜第 23 名。
uses: 强化学习与机器人研究者，用于搭建高保真仿真环境训练控制策略
生物力学与动画开发者，需要精确模拟关节与接触动力学
需要 Python 快速上手仿真的工程师，可直接使用绑定与 Colab 教程
游戏或 Unity 开发者，希望通过插件集成物理仿真能力

en.tag: A general-purpose physics simulator maintained by Google DeepMind
en.what: MuJoCo stands for Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact; it is a general-purpose physics engine built for fast, accurate simulation of articulated structures interacting with their environments, serving robotics, biomechanics, graphics, animation and machine learning. Maintained by Google DeepMind, it ships a C API plus Python bindings for researchers and developers.
en.content: The repo holds the C++ simulation runtime with a built-in XML compiler and preallocated low-level data structures, plus the OpenGL-based native interactive viewer simulate. It also includes Python bindings, a Unity plug-in, Colab tutorial notebooks and full documentation.
en.stack: The core is written in C++ with OpenGL for visualization, exposing a C API, Python bindings and a Unity plug-in, built with CMake and continuous integration via GitHub Actions.
en.hot: As a de facto standard for reinforcement learning and robotics simulation, MuJoCo is widely adopted in academia; it gained 653 stars this month for a total of 15,230, ranking 23rd on GitHub's monthly C++ trending list.
uses: Reinforcement learning and robotics researchers building high-fidelity simulation environments to train control policies
Biomechanics and animation developers needing accurate joint and contact dynamics
Engineers who want quick Python-based simulation via the bindings and Colab tutorials
Game or Unity developers looking to integrate physics simulation through the plug-in

zh.tag: 原生高性能桌面启动器，可扩展命令面板
zh.what: Vicinae 是一款面向桌面的高性能原生命令面板，可充当应用搜索、剪贴板历史、文件搜索、计算器、窗口切换等日常工具。它支持通过 React/TypeScript 扩展、脚本命令和 dmenu 风格菜单进行扩展，并兼容 Raycast 生态。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 编写的原生应用源码、extra 目录下的 logo 与截图资源，以及文档站点和扩展相关代码；提供官网、Discord 社区和扩展商店入口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，追求原生性能；扩展层基于 React/TypeScript，并兼容 Raycast 扩展与脚本命令。
zh.hot: 凭借原生高性能、Raycast 生态兼容和丰富开箱功能，本月新增 909 star，总 star 突破 1 万，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 C++ 第 21 名。
uses: 追求快速启动与键盘操作的 Linux/桌面效率用户
希望从 Raycast 迁移或复用其扩展生态的开发者
需要剪贴板历史、文件搜索、窗口切换等一体化工具的人
想用 React/TypeScript 或脚本自定义启动器的进阶用户

en.tag: A native, high-performance desktop launcher and extensible command palette
en.what: Vicinae is a high-performance native command palette for the desktop, doubling as app search, clipboard history, file search, calculator, window switcher and more. It can be extended via React/TypeScript extensions, script commands and dmenu-style menus, with compatibility with the Raycast ecosystem.
en.content: The repo contains the native C++ application source, logo and screenshot assets under extra/, plus documentation and extension-related code, with links to the website, Discord community and extension stores.
en.stack: Primarily built in C++ for native performance; the extension layer uses React/TypeScript and is compatible with Raycast extensions and script commands.
en.hot: With native performance, Raycast ecosystem compatibility and rich out-of-the-box features, it gained 909 stars this month, surpassing 10k total and ranking 21st on the GitHub Trending monthly C++ list.
uses: Linux/desktop power users who want fast keyboard-driven launching
Developers migrating from Raycast or reusing its extension ecosystem
People needing an all-in-one tool for clipboard history, file search and window switching
Advanced users who want to customize a launcher with React/TypeScript or scripts

zh.tag: 把整个项目文件夹变成可查询知识图谱的 AI 技能
zh.what: 给 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手用的 skill：输入 /graphify，它就把整个项目（代码、SQL schema、文档、PDF、图片、视频）映射成一张可查询的知识图谱，代替 grep 翻文件。代码解析走 tree-sitter AST —— 确定性、不用 LLM、完全本地；文档类内容才走模型做语义处理。不是向量索引，是真图谱，每条边标注 EXTRACTED（直接读到）还是 INFERRED（推断出来）。
zh.content: 以 CLI 形式分发（PyPI 包 graphifyy，uv tool install 或 pipx 安装），仓库含 docs/（30 多种语言 README 翻译）和交互式 graph.html 可视化产物；默认分支 v8，迭代很快。
zh.stack: Python + tree-sitter 代码解析，产出力导向 HTML 图；挂到各家 CLI 助手上当 skill 用。
zh.hot: 它用知识图谱补足纯向量检索的局限，直接回应团队构建上下文型 AI 助手时遇到的 RAG 难题。
uses: 接手中大型老项目的开发者 —— 一条命令生成知识图谱，快速搞清代码结构
AI 重度用户 —— 给 agent 换图谱上下文，替代检索不准的向量 RAG
技术文档团队 —— 把文档 / PDF / 图纸一起纳入可查询图谱

en.tag: An AI skill that turns a whole project folder into a queryable knowledge graph
en.what: A skill for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more: type /graphify and your entire project — code, SQL schemas, docs, PDFs, images, videos — is mapped into a queryable knowledge graph, replacing grep-and-scroll. Code parsing uses tree-sitter AST: deterministic, no LLM, fully local; only document content goes through a model. Not a vector index — a real graph, with every edge labeled EXTRACTED (read directly) or INFERRED.
en.content: Distributed as a CLI (PyPI package graphifyy, install via uv tool install or pipx); the repo holds docs/ (README translations in 30+ languages) and interactive graph.html visualizations; default branch v8, iterating fast.
en.stack: Python + tree-sitter, outputting force-directed HTML graphs; hooks into each CLI assistant as a skill.
en.hot: Its knowledge-graph alternative to vector-only retrieval speaks directly to limitations teams encounter when building contextual AI assistants.
uses: Developers inheriting large legacy projects — one command maps the codebase into a knowledge graph
Heavy AI users — swap vector RAG for graph context that retrieves the right thing
Docs teams — fold docs, PDFs and diagrams into one queryable graph

zh.tag: 港大出品的 AI 私人家教：个性化终身学习工作区
zh.what: 香港大学 HKUDS 实验室的「agent 原生」学习平台：聊天辅导、刷题测验、深度研究、可视化、解题、Mastery Path 掌握度练习跑在同一套 agent 循环上。支持多引擎 RAG 知识库（LlamaIndex、PageIndex、GraphRAG、LightRAG，可挂 Obsidian 库），可从任意对话呼叫 Claude Code / Codex 等子 agent；带三层可检查记忆（L1 trace / L2 摘要 / L3 综合）和 Memory Graph 溯源。
zh.content: 完整 Web 应用（Python 后端 + Next.js 16 前端），附 11 种语言 README、Docker 部署、CLI/agent-native 接口、EduHub 社区 skills 生态；发版极勤。
zh.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16，RAG 多引擎 + MCP 工具 + FAISS 向量库，Apache-2.0；2025 年 12 月底创建，有 arXiv 论文背书。
zh.hot: 它把 AI 教育与 Agent 原生工作流结合，并由高校实验室持续维护，概念清晰、可体验性强。
uses: 学生 / 自学者 —— 把教材和论文喂进去，得到 24 小时私人家教
考研 / 考证党 —— 用刷题测验 + 掌握度路径系统备考
知识管理玩家 —— 直接挂 Obsidian 库做 RAG 问答

en.tag: An AI personal tutor from HKU: a lifelong, personalized learning workspace
en.what: An 'agent-native' learning platform from HKU's HKUDS lab: chat tutoring, quizzes, deep research, visualization, problem solving and Mastery-Path practice all run on one agent loop. It supports multi-engine RAG knowledge bases (LlamaIndex, PageIndex, GraphRAG, LightRAG — even your Obsidian vault), lets you call Claude Code / Codex sub-agents from any conversation, and ships three-layer inspectable memory (L1 trace / L2 summary / L3 synthesis) with a Memory Graph for provenance.
en.content: A full web app (Python backend + Next.js 16 frontend) with READMEs in 11 languages, Docker deployment, CLI/agent-native interfaces and the EduHub community skills ecosystem; releases ship very frequently.
en.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16, multi-engine RAG + MCP tools + FAISS; Apache-2.0; created late December 2025 with an arXiv paper behind it.
en.hot: It combines AI education with an agent-native workflow and carries the credibility of a university research lab, making the concept easy to evaluate and share.
uses: Students & self-learners — feed in textbooks and papers, get a 24/7 personal tutor
Exam candidates — prepare systematically with quizzes and the mastery path
PKM enthusiasts — plug your Obsidian vault straight in for RAG Q&A

zh.tag: 专治「AI 味」网页的设计 skill，让 AI 生成的 UI 不像模板货
zh.what: Together AI 出品的设计 skill 包：装进 Claude Code、Cursor 或 Codex 后，AI 生成网页 UI 时会从 20 套主题里选宏观结构，并跑 57 项「anti-slop」检查加自我批判，拒绝 LLM 默认那套千篇一律的渐变卡片风。提供生成、hallmark audit（给现有代码打分）、hallmark redesign（换结构重写）、hallmark study（从截图/URL 提取设计 DNA）四个动词。
zh.content: 核心是 skills/hallmark/ 下的 SKILL.md + references/ 规则文件；docs/ 有 recipes 和示例，site/ 是官网及大量自包含 HTML+CSS 示例页（语言占比因此显示为 CSS）。
zh.stack: Markdown 规则 + 参考文档的 skill 包（符合 Agent Skills 规范），示例为纯 HTML/CSS，MIT，无运行时依赖，一行 npx skills add nutlope/hallmark 安装。
zh.hot: 它直指 AI 生成网站同质化这一普遍痛点，并用在线 Demo 降低验证门槛，定位清晰且易于传播。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 没有设计师，也能让 AI 生成不撞脸的官网和落地页
设计师 —— 用 hallmark study 从优秀网站提取设计 DNA 做参考
前端工程师 —— 用 audit 给存量项目打分，找出「AI 味」重灾区

en.tag: The anti-'AI-slop' design skill — AI-built UIs that don't look like templates
en.what: A design skill pack from Together AI: once installed in Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, your agent picks a macro-structure from 20 themes when generating web UIs, then runs 57 'anti-slop' checks plus self-critique — rejecting the default LLM look of identical gradient cards. Four verbs: generate, hallmark audit (score existing code), hallmark redesign (rewrite with a new structure), hallmark study (extract design DNA from a screenshot or URL).
en.content: The core is SKILL.md plus rule files under skills/hallmark/ and references/; docs/ holds recipes and examples; site/ contains the homepage and many self-contained HTML+CSS example pages (which is why the language stat reads CSS).
en.stack: A Markdown-rules skill pack (Agent Skills compliant) with pure HTML/CSS examples; MIT, zero runtime dependencies; install via npx skills add nutlope/hallmark.
en.hot: Its anti-slop positioning addresses a common complaint about AI-generated websites, while the live demo makes the claim easy to evaluate.
uses: Indie devs & small teams — generate distinctive sites and landing pages without a designer
Designers — extract design DNA from great sites with hallmark study
Frontend engineers — audit existing projects to find the worst 'AI-slop' offenders

zh.tag: 开源版 CapCut（剪映），免费跨平台视频编辑器
zh.what: 免费开源视频编辑器，对标 CapCut，目标覆盖 Web、桌面和移动端。项目正在从零重写：Editor API、插件优先架构、Rust 核心（一套代码跑桌面/移动/浏览器）、供 AI agent 调用的 MCP server、无头批量渲染模式和编辑器内置脚本页。旧版代码已迁至 opencut-classic 继续维护。
zh.content: monorepo：apps/web、apps/desktop、apps/api 三个应用，根目录 Cargo.toml（Rust 核心）；用 moonrepo + proto 管理工具链，moon run web:dev 即可起本地开发。
zh.stack: TypeScript（Web 前端）+ Rust 核心，Bun 包管理，MIT；重写期间暂不接受外部代码贡献。
zh.hot: 「开源视频剪辑工具」满足了广泛需求，Rust 重写与基于 MCP 的 AI 剪辑能力又形成了清晰的技术差异。
uses: 自媒体创作者 —— 免费替代剪映专业版，无水印跨平台剪片
开发者 / 自动化团队 —— 通过 MCP server 让 AI agent 批量剪视频
企业 —— 基于 Editor API 和插件架构搭建内部视频流水线

en.tag: The open-source CapCut alternative — free, cross-platform video editing
en.what: A free, open-source video editor rivaling CapCut, targeting web, desktop and mobile. The project is being rewritten from scratch: an Editor API, plugin-first architecture, a Rust core (one codebase for desktop/mobile/browser), an MCP server so AI agents can edit video, a headless mode for automated batch rendering, and built-in editor scripting. Legacy code lives on in opencut-classic.
en.content: A monorepo: apps/web, apps/desktop and apps/api, with a root Cargo.toml for the Rust core; toolchain managed by moonrepo + proto — `moon run web:dev` starts local dev.
en.stack: TypeScript (web frontend) + Rust core, Bun for packages, MIT; external code contributions are paused during the rewrite.
en.hot: The open-source alternative to CapCut addresses broad latent demand, while the Rust rewrite and MCP-based AI editing story give the project a distinct technical direction.
uses: Content creators — a free, watermark-free CapCut Pro alternative across platforms
Dev & automation teams — batch-edit video via AI agents over the MCP server
Companies — build internal video pipelines on the Editor API and plugin architecture

zh.tag: 开源一体化产品数据平台：分析、回放、实验、LLM 观测全包
zh.what: 知名开源产品数据平台：产品分析、Web 分析、session 回放、feature flag、A/B 实验、错误追踪、日志、问卷、数据仓库、CDP、LLM 可观测性全部集成在一个系统。最新定位「构建自驱动产品（self-driving products）」：把错误、rage click 等产品信号自动转成分析报告和 PR 供你 review 合并，可从 Slack、Web、桌面端或 MCP 操作，支持 Docker 自托管。
zh.content: 超大型 monorepo：posthog/（Django 后端）、frontend/、products/（各产品线）、rust/、services/、ee/（企业版，单独授权），大量 docker-compose 部署文件与全平台 SDK。
zh.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust 服务，底层 ClickHouse；MIT（ee/ 目录除外）。
zh.hot: 它把完整的产品分析套件与面向 Agent 的自动化能力结合，既有成熟开发者用户，也有清晰的新使用场景。
uses: 产品团队 —— 一个平台替代 GA + 回放 + 实验工具的组合订阅
注重数据合规的公司 —— 自托管部署，用户数据不出机房
AI 产品团队 —— 用 LLM 可观测性追踪自家 agent 的成本与质量

en.tag: The open-source all-in-one product data platform
en.what: The well-known open-source product data platform: product analytics, web analytics, session replay, feature flags, A/B experiments, error tracking, logs, surveys, a data warehouse, CDP pipelines and LLM observability in one system. Its latest positioning is 'self-driving products': product signals like errors and rage clicks are automatically turned into analysis reports and PRs for you to review and merge — operable from Slack, web, desktop or MCP, and self-hostable via Docker.
en.content: A huge monorepo: posthog/ (Django backend), frontend/, products/ (each product line), rust/, services/, ee/ (enterprise code, separately licensed), lots of docker-compose files and SDKs for every platform.
en.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust services over ClickHouse; MIT (except ee/).
en.hot: The project combines a broad product-analytics suite with an agent-facing automation narrative, giving an established developer audience a clear reason to revisit it.
uses: Product teams — replace the GA + replay + experimentation stack with one platform
Compliance-sensitive companies — self-host so user data never leaves your infra
AI product teams — track your agents' cost and quality with LLM observability

zh.tag: 1-bit/三值超压缩大模型 Bonsai 的本地运行 demo
zh.what: PrismML 的 Bonsai 系列语言模型官方演示仓库，主打极致量化：1-bit 版每权重约 1.125 bit，27B 模型能塞进现代 iPhone；三值（Ternary）版约 1.7 bit，是质量更高的默认选项。最新 27B 是视觉语言模型，支持看图、tool calling、MCP、256k+ 长上下文和推理努力度调节。
zh.content: 纯 Shell 脚本工程：setup.sh / setup.ps1 一键装依赖下模型，scripts/ 放运行和下载脚本，另有三份白皮书 PDF、AGENTS.md（写给 AI agent 看的配置指南）、VISION/TOOLS 等专题文档与社区 benchmark。
zh.stack: Shell + llama.cpp 服务端，模型托管在 HuggingFace；支持 Mac Metal、CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm 和纯 CPU，Apache-2.0。
zh.hot: 视觉语言模型与 iPhone 端侧演示把技术卖点变得直观，配套脚本也降低了上手与复现实验的门槛。
uses: 手机 / 边缘设备开发者 —— 在 iPhone 上离线跑 27B 视觉语言模型
隐私敏感场景 —— 医疗、法律等数据不出本地的本地 AI 助手
硬件玩家 —— 在树莓派等低功耗设备上体验大模型

en.tag: Local-run demo of Bonsai, the 1-bit / ternary ultra-compressed LLMs
en.what: The official demo repo for PrismML's Bonsai model family, built around extreme quantization: the 1-bit version uses ~1.125 bits per weight so a 27B model fits a modern iPhone; the ternary version (~1.7 bits) is the higher-quality default. The newest 27B is a vision-language model with image input, tool calling, MCP, 256k+ context and adjustable reasoning effort.
en.content: A pure Shell project: setup.sh / setup.ps1 one-liners install dependencies and pull models, scripts/ holds run/download scripts, plus three whitepaper PDFs, an AGENTS.md (a config guide written for AI agents), topical docs (VISION/TOOLS/…) and community benchmarks.
en.stack: Shell + a llama.cpp server, models hosted on HuggingFace; runs on Mac Metal, CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm or plain CPU; Apache-2.0.
en.hot: The vision-language model and on-device iPhone demo make a technically ambitious claim concrete, while the included scripts reduce trial friction.
uses: Mobile / edge developers — run a 27B vision-language model offline on an iPhone
Privacy-sensitive settings — local AI assistants for medical or legal data that can't leave the device
Hardware tinkerers — run LLMs on low-power boards like a Raspberry Pi

zh.tag: 100+ 个能直接跑起来的 AI Agent 和 RAG 应用合集
zh.what: 超大号 LLM 应用模板库：收录 100 多个亲手构建并端到端测试过的 AI agent、agent skill 和 RAG 应用，全部 Apache-2.0 可商用。兼容 Claude、Gemini、GPT、DeepSeek、Llama、Qwen 等主流模型，克隆下来装依赖就能跑，口号「clone, customize, ship」。
